features.title: Tenant administrators can set Feature Management switches with an API

features.title_nl: Tenantbeheerders kunnen schakelopties voor functiebeheer instellen met een API
features.summary_nl: Automatiseer instellingen voor functiewisselingen via API om het beheer tussen bedrijven en omgevingen te stroomlijnen, waardoor handmatige inspanning en fouten worden verminderd.
features.title_fr: Les administrateurs de locataires peuvent définir des commutateurs de gestion des fonctionnalités avec une API
features.summary_fr: Automatisez les paramètres de commutateur de fonctionnalités via l’API pour simplifier la gestion entre les entreprises et les environnements, ce qui réduit les efforts manuels et les erreurs.

features.title: Access open-sourced Power BI apps

features.title_da: Få adgang til Power BI apps med åben kildekode
features.summary_da: Få adgang til Power BI-apps med åben kildekode til salg, køb og projekter for at tilpasse semantiske modeller og rapporter.

features.summary_nl: Verkrijg toegang tot open-source Power BI-apps voor verkoop, aankoop en projecten om semantische modellen en rapporten aan te passen.
features.title_fr: Accéder aux applications Power BI open source
features.summary_fr: Accédez aux applications Power BI open source pour les ventes, l’achat et les projets pour personnaliser des modèles sémantiques et des rapports.

features.title: Add data fields to report layouts using Word add-in

features.title_da: Føj datafelter til rapportlayout ved hjælp af Word-tilføjelsesprogram
features.summary_da: Brug den nye opgaverude i Word-tilføjelsesprogrammet til at forenkle oprettelsen af rapporten med nem indsættelse af data, trænavigation og nyttige værktøjstip for at opnå større nøjagtighed.
features.title_nl: Gegevensvelden toevoegen aan rapportindelingen met behulp van Word-invoegtoepassing
features.summary_nl: Gebruik het nieuwe taakvenster van de Word-invoegtoepassing om het maken van rapporten te vereenvoudigen met eenvoudige gegevensinvoeging, structuurnavigatie en handige knopinfo voor betere nauwkeurigheid.
features.title_fr: Ajouter des champs de données aux mises en page de rapport à l’aide du module complémentaire Word
features.summary_fr: Utilisez le nouveau volet de tâche du complément Word pour simplifier la création de rapports grâce à une insertion facile des données, une navigation arborescente et des info-bulles utiles pour une précision accrue.

features.title: Deferral reporting enhancements
features.summary: Modernized deferral reports now support Word/Excel layouts and ad-hoc analysis, empowering controllers with flexible, no-code insights.
features.title_da: Forbedringer i rapporteringen af udskydelser
features.summary_da: Moderniserede udsættelsesrapporter understøtter nu Word/Excel-layout og ad hoc-analyse, så controllere får fleksibel indsigt uden kode.
features.title_nl: Verbeteringen van uitstelrapportage
features.summary_nl: Gemoderniseerde uitstelrapporten ondersteunen nu Word-/Excel-indelingen en ad-hocanalyse, waardoor controllers flexibele, no-code-inzichten krijgen.
features.title_fr: Améliorations apportées aux rapports différés
features.summary_fr: Les rapports de report modernisés prennent désormais en charge les mises en page Word/Excel et l’analyse ad hoc, offrant aux contrôleurs des analyses flexibles sans code.

features.title: Use drill-back and dynamic dimension names in Power BI apps
features.summary: Quickly drill into report data and use dynamic dimension naming in Power BI for deeper insights, flexible analysis, and faster decisions.
features.title_da: Brug detailudledningsnavne og dynamiske dimensionsnavne i Power BI-apps
features.summary_da: Analysér hurtigt rapportdata, og brug navngivning af dynamiske dimensioner i Power BI for at få dybere indsigt, fleksibel analyse og hurtigere beslutninger.
features.title_nl: Gebruik drill-back en dynamische dimensienamen in Power BI-apps
features.summary_nl: Zoom snel in op rapportgegevens en gebruik dynamische dimensienaamgeving in Power BI voor meer inzicht, flexibele analyse en snellere beslissingen.
features.title_fr: Utiliser le drill-back et des noms de dimensions dynamiques dans les applications Power BI
features.summary_fr: Explorez rapidement les données de rapport et utilisez un nommage de dimension dynamique dans Power BI pour obtenir des insights plus approfondis, une analyse flexible et des décisions plus rapides.

features.title: Use enhanced Financial Reporting
features.summary: The no-code Financial Reporting feature enables finance departments to create financial reports and statements without developer assistance.
features.title_da: Brug forbedret økonomirapportering
features.summary_da: Funktionen finansiel no-code-rapportering gør det muligt for økonomiafdelinger at oprette økonomiske rapporter og kontoudtog uden udviklerassistance.
features.title_nl: Verbeterde financiële rapportage gebruiken
features.summary_nl: Met de functie Financial Reporting zonder code kunnen financiële afdelingen financiële rapporten en overzichten maken zonder hulp van ontwikkelaars.
features.title_fr: Utiliser l’information financière améliorée
features.summary_fr: La fonctionnalité de gestion des états financiers sans code permet aux services financiers de créer des déclarations et des états financiers sans l’assistance d’un développeur.

features.title: Use the enhanced Inventory Power BI app to forecast future inventory flow
features.summary: Forecast inventory with Power BI using historical data and custom filters to optimize stock levels and improve supply chain efficiency.
features.title_da: Brug den forbedrede app Inventory Power BI til at forudsige fremtidigt lagerflow
features.summary_da: Prognoselager med Power BI ved hjælp af historiske data og brugerdefinerede filtre for at optimere lagerniveauer og forbedre effektiviteten af forsyningskæden.
features.title_nl: De verbeterde Power BI-app Inventaris gebruiken om de toekomstige voorraadstroom te voorspellen
features.summary_nl: Inventaris voorspellen met Power BI met behulp van historische gegevens en aangepaste filters om voorraadniveaus te optimaliseren en de efficiëntie van de toeleveringsketen te verbeteren.
features.title_fr: Utiliser l’application Power BI d’inventaire améliorée pour prévoir le flux d’inventaire futur
features.summary_fr: Prévoir l’inventaire avec Power BI à l’aide de données historiques et de filtres personnalisés pour optimiser les niveaux de stock et améliorer l’efficacité de la chaîne d’approvisionnement.

features.title: Use the enhanced Power BI app for Projects to analyze project profitability
features.summary: The updated Projects Power BI app adds dynamic dimensions, new measures, and improved visuals for precise, customizable project profitability insights.
features.title_da: Brug den forbedrede Power BI-app til projekter til at analysere projektets rentabilitet
features.summary_da: Den opdaterede app Projects Power BI tilføjer dynamiske dimensioner, nye målinger og forbedrede visualiseringer for at få præcis indsigt i projektets rentabilitet, der kan tilpasses.
features.title_nl: De verbeterde Power BI-app voor projecten gebruiken om de winstgevendheid van projecten te analyseren
features.summary_nl: De bijgewerkte Power BI-app Projecten voegt dynamische dimensies, nieuwe metingen en verbeterde visuals toe voor nauwkeurige, aanpasbare inzichten in projectwinstgevendheid.
features.title_fr: Utiliser l’application Power BI améliorée pour Projects pour analyser la rentabilité du projet
features.summary_fr: L’application Projects Power BI mise à jour ajoute des dimensions dynamiques, de nouvelles mesures et des visuels améliorés pour obtenir des insights précis et personnalisables sur la rentabilité des projets.

features.title: Use the enhanced Power BI Finance app to improve your cashflow
features.summary: Track late payments, analyze 12-month receivables trends, and filter by customer dimensions to improve cashflow and financial planning.
features.title_da: Brug den forbedrede Power BI Finance-app til at forbedre din pengestrøm
features.summary_da: Spor forsinkede betalinger, analysér tendenser for 12-måneders fordringer, og filtrer efter kundedimensioner for at forbedre pengestrømmen og den økonomiske planlægning.
features.title_nl: De verbeterde Power BI Finance-app gebruiken om uw cashflow te verbeteren
features.summary_nl: Houd late betalingen bij, analyseer trends in vorderingen van 12 maanden en filter op klantdimensies om de cashflow en financiële planning te verbeteren.
features.title_fr: Utilisez l’application Power BI Finance améliorée pour améliorer votre flux de trésorerie
features.summary_fr: Suivez les paiements en retard, analysez les tendances des créances de 12 mois et filtrez les dimensions des clients pour améliorer les flux de trésorerie et la planification financière.

features.title: Use the enhanced Power BI Manufacturing app and modernized reports in manufacturing analytics
features.summary: The enhanced reporting and analytics for manufacturing offer new KPIs in Power BI, better data analysis, as well as customizable Excel layouts.
features.title_da: Brug den forbedrede Power BI-produktionsapp og moderniserede rapporter i produktionsanalyse
features.summary_da: Den forbedrede rapportering og analyse til produktion tilbyder nye KPI'er i Power BI, bedre dataanalyse samt Excel-layout, der kan tilpasses.
features.title_nl: De verbeterde Power BI Manufacturing-app en gemoderniseerde rapporten gebruiken in productieanalyses
features.summary_nl: De verbeterde rapportage en analyse voor productie bieden nieuwe KPI's in Power BI, betere gegevensanalyse en aanpasbare Excel-indelingen.
features.title_fr: Utiliser l'application de fabrication Power BI améliorée et les rapports modernisés dans l'analyse de fabrication
features.summary_fr: Les rapports et les analyses améliorés pour la fabrication offrent de nouveaux indicateurs de performance clés dans Power BI, une meilleure analyse des données, ainsi que des dispositions Excel personnalisables.

features.title: Use the enhanced Purchasing Power BI app to analyze risk related to vendors
features.summary: The enhanced reporting and analytics for purchasing offers new reports and KPIs in Power BI.
features.title_da: Brug den forbedrede app Indkøb Power BI til at analysere risici, der er relateret til leverandører
features.summary_da: Den forbedrede rapportering og analyse til indkøb tilbyder nye rapporter og KPI'er i Power BI.
features.title_nl: De verbeterde aankoop-Power BI-app gebruiken om risico's met betrekking tot leveranciers te analyseren
features.summary_nl: De verbeterde rapportage en analyse voor inkoop biedt nieuwe rapporten en KPI's in Power BI.
features.title_fr: Utiliser l’application Power BI d’achat améliorée pour analyser les risques liés aux fournisseurs
features.summary_fr: Le reporting et l’analyse améliorés pour les achats offrent de nouveaux rapports et KPI dans Power BI.

features.title: Use the enhanced Power BI Sales app and modernized reports in sales analytics
features.summary: The enhanced reporting and analytics for sales offer new KPIs in Power BI, better data analysis, as well as customizable Excel layouts.
features.title_da: Brug den forbedrede Power BI Sales-app og moderniserede rapporter i salgsanalyse
features.summary_da: Den forbedrede rapportering og analyse for salg tilbyder nye KPI'er i Power BI, bedre dataanalyse samt Excel-layout, der kan tilpasses.
features.title_nl: Gebruik de verbeterde Power BI Sales-app en gemoderniseerde rapporten in verkoopanalyses
features.summary_nl: De verbeterde rapportage en analyses voor verkoop bieden nieuwe KPI's in Power BI, betere gegevensanalyse en aanpasbare Excel-indelingen.
features.title_fr: Utiliser l’application Power BI Sales améliorée et les rapports modernisés dans l’analyse des ventes
features.summary_fr: Les rapports et analyses améliorés pour les ventes offrent de nouveaux indicateurs clés de performance dans Power BI, une meilleure analyse des données, ainsi que des mises en page Excel personnalisables.

features.title: Add more fields and columns by personalizing pages
features.summary: Gain extra insight into processes and data by using personalization to add more fields and columns to different pages.
features.title_da: Tilføj flere felter og kolonner ved at tilpasse sider
features.summary_da: Få ekstra indsigt i processer og data ved hjælp af tilpasning for at føje flere felter og kolonner til forskellige sider.
features.title_nl: Meer velden en kolommen toevoegen door pagina's te personaliseren
features.summary_nl: Krijg extra inzicht in processen en gegevens door personalisatie te gebruiken om meer velden en kolommen aan verschillende pagina's toe te voegen.
features.title_fr: Ajouter d’autres champs et colonnes en personnalisant les pages
features.summary_fr: Obtenez des informations supplémentaires sur les processus et les données à l’aide de la personnalisation pour ajouter des champs et des colonnes aux différentes pages.

features.title: Configure the default calculation for the Calculate Consumption report
features.summary: On the Manufacturing Setup page, you can configure the Calculate Consumption report to show either the expected output or actual output values by default.
features.title_da: Konfigurer standardberegningen for rapporten Beregn forbrug
features.summary_da: På siden Produktionsopsætning kan du konfigurere rapporten Beregn forbrug til enten at vise de forventede outputværdier eller de faktiske outputværdier som standard.
features.title_nl: De standaardberekening voor het rapport Verbruik berekenen configureren
features.summary_nl: Op de pagina Productie-instellingen kunt u het rapport Verbruik berekenen zo configureren dat de verwachte of werkelijke uitvoerwaarden standaard worden weergegeven.
features.title_fr: Configurer le calcul par défaut pour le rapport Calculer la consommation
features.summary_fr: Sur la page Paramètres production, vous pouvez configurer l’état Calculer la consommation pour afficher par défaut les valeurs de rendement prévu ou les valeurs de rendement réel.

features.title: Sort lines by type and number in sales and purchase postings
features.summary: To reduce deadlocks, when you enable concurrent inventory posting, sales and purchase posting will sort and process lines by type (and line number).
features.title_da: Sortér linjer efter type i salgs- og købsbogføringer
features.summary_da: Hvis du vil reducere blokeringer, når du aktiverer samtidig lagerbogføring, sorterer og behandler salgs- og købsbogføring linjer efter type (og linjenummer).
features.title_nl: Lijnen sorteren op type in verkoop- en inkoopposteringen
features.summary_nl: Wanneer u gelijktijdige voorraadboeking inschakelt, worden regels bij verkoop- en inkoopboeking op type (en regelnummer) gesorteerd en verwerkt om deadlocks te verminderen.
features.title_fr: Trier les lignes par type dans les publications de ventes et d’achat
features.summary_fr: Pour réduire les interblocages, lorsque la comptabilisation simultanée des stocks est activée, les écritures de vente et d’achat trient et traitent les lignes par type (et par numéro de ligne).

features.title: Avoid changing the Emissions Unit of Measure when entries already exist
features.summary: Prevent inconsistent sustainability data by locking the Emissions Unit of Measure after entries exist, ensuring accurate environmental reporting.
features.title_da: Undgå at ændre emissionsmåleenheden, når der allerede findes poster
features.summary_da: Undgå inkonsekvente bæredygtighedsdata ved at låse emissionsenheden, når der er poster, for at sikre nøjagtig miljørapportering.
features.title_nl: Voorkomen dat de uitstooteenheid verandert als er al posten bestaan
features.summary_nl: Voorkom inconsistente duurzaamheidsgegevens door de uitstooteenheid te vergrendelen zodra er posten zijn, zodat nauwkeurige milieurapportage wordt gegarandeerd.
features.title_fr: Éviter de modifier l’unité de mesure des émissions lorsque des entrées existent déjà
features.summary_fr: Évitez les incohérences dans les données de durabilité en figeant l’unité de mesure des émissions dès que des enregistrements ont été créés, afin de garantir l’exactitude des rapports environnementaux.

features.title: Enable projects with value chain automation in Scope 3
features.summary: You can improve tracking and calculating emissions for delivered projects under Scope 3.
features.title_da: Aktivér projekter med automatisering af værdikæden i Scope 3
features.summary_da: Du kan forbedre sporing og beregning af emissioner for leverede projekter under Scope 3.
features.title_nl: Maak projecten mogelijk met automatisering van de waardeketen in Scope 3
features.summary_nl: U kunt het volgen en berekenen van emissies verbeteren voor opgeleverde projecten onder Scope 3.
features.title_fr: Réaliser des projets avec l’automatisation de la chaîne de valeur dans le périmètre 3
features.summary_fr: Vous pouvez améliorer le suivi et le calcul des émissions pour les projets livrés dans le cadre du scope 3.

features.title: Enable taxonomy elements for ESRS and other standards
features.summary: Users will have a tool where they can map their entries with required taxonomies for reporting.
features.title_da: Aktivere taksonomielementer for ESRS og andre standarder
features.summary_da: Brugerne vil få et værktøj, hvor de kan tilknytte deres poster med nødvendige taksonomier til rapportering.
features.title_nl: Taxonomie-elementen inschakelen voor ESRS en andere standaarden
features.summary_nl: Gebruikers krijgen de beschikking over een tool waarmee ze hun gegevens kunnen toewijzen aan vereiste taxonomieën voor rapportage.
features.title_fr: Activer les éléments de taxonomie pour les normes ESRS et d’autres normes
features.summary_fr: Les utilisateurs disposeront d’un outil leur permettant de mapper leurs entrées avec les taxonomies requises pour la génération d’états.

features.title: Generate a CSRD preparation report
features.summary: Print reports that feature data prepared for CSRD reporting, complete with taxonomies for clarity and compliance.
features.title_da: Generér en CSRD-forberedelsesrapport
features.summary_da: Udskriv rapporter, der indeholder data, som er udarbejdet til CSRD-rapportering, komplet med taksonomier for klarhed og overholdelse.
features.title_nl: Een CSRD-voorbereidingsrapport genereren
features.summary_nl: Druk rapporten af met gegevens die zijn voorbereid voor CSRD-rapportage, compleet met taxonomieën voor duidelijkheid en compliance.
features.title_fr: Générer un rapport de préparation CSRD
features.summary_fr: Imprimer des rapports contenant des données préparées en vue de rapports CSRD, utilisant des taxonomies pour une clarté accrue et une mise en conformité efficace.

features.title: Measure all gases as CO2 equivalents in Sustainability
features.summary: Track gas emissions as CO2 equivalents in Business Central for accurate carbon reporting and compliance.
features.title_da: Mål alle gasser som CO2-ækvivalenter i bæredygtighed
features.summary_da: Spor gasemissioner som CO2-ækvivalenter i Business Central for nøjagtig CO2-rapportering og overholdelse.
features.title_nl: Meet alle gassen als CO2-equivalenten in de context van duurzaamheid.
features.summary_nl: Volg gasemissies als CO2-equivalenten in Business Central voor nauwkeurige koolstofrapportage en naleving.
features.title_fr: Mesurer tous les gaz en équivalents CO2 dans Sustainability
features.summary_fr: Suivez les émissions de gaz en tant qu’équivalents CO2 dans Business Central pour la déclaration et la conformité précises du carbone.

features.title: Report on social and governance information for employees in Sustainability
features.summary: Features for sustainability enhance ESG reporting by integrating not only environmental, but also social and governance details.
features.title_da: Rapport om sociale og ledelsesmæssige oplysninger til medarbejdere i bæredygtighed
features.summary_da: Funktioner til bæredygtighed forbedrer ESG-rapportering ved at integrere ikke kun miljømæssige, men også sociale og ledelsesmæssige detaljer.
features.title_nl: Verslag over sociale en governance-informatie voor medewerkers in Duurzaamheid
features.summary_nl: Functies voor duurzaamheid verbeteren ESG-rapportage door niet alleen milieu-, maar ook sociale en governance-details te integreren.
features.title_fr: Rapport sur l’information sociale et de gouvernance pour les employés du secteur du développement durable
features.summary_fr: Les fonctionnalités de durabilité améliorent le reporting ESG en intégrant non seulement les détails environnementaux, mais aussi sociaux et de gouvernance.

features.title: Require approvals for sustainability journals
features.summary: Enable approval workflow for sustainability journals and add actions for sending and canceling approval requests.
features.title_da: Kræv godkendelser for bæredygtighedstidsskrifter
features.summary_da: Aktivér godkendelsesprocesser for bæredygtighedsjournaler, og tilføj handlinger til afsendelse og annullering af godkendelsesanmodninger.
features.title_nl: Vereisen goedkeuring voor duurzaamheidstijdschriften
features.summary_nl: Schakel de goedkeuringsworkflow voor duurzaamheidsjournalen in en voeg acties toe voor het verzenden en annuleren van goedkeuringsaanvragen.
features.title_fr: Exiger l’approbation des revues sur le développement durable
features.summary_fr: Activez le flux de travail d’approbation pour les journaux de durabilité et ajoutez des actions pour l’envoi et l’annulation des demandes d’approbation.

features.title: Track energy consumption in Sustainability
features.summary: Tracking consumed energy is a critical component of CSRD reporting. This feature enables energy tracking with specific sources.
features.title_da: Spor energiforbrug i bæredygtighed
features.summary_da: Sporing af forbrugt energi er en kritisk komponent i CSRD-rapportering. Denne funktion muliggør energisporing med specifikke kilder.
features.title_nl: Energieverbruik bijhouden in Duurzaamheid
features.summary_nl: Het bijhouden van verbruikte energie is een cruciaal onderdeel van CSRD-rapportage. Deze functie maakt het mogelijk om energie te volgen met specifieke bronnen.
features.title_fr: Suivre la consommation d’énergie dans le domaine de la durabilité
features.summary_fr: Le suivi de l’énergie consommée est un élément essentiel des rapports CSRD. Cette fonction permet le suivi de l’énergie avec des sources spécifiques.

features.title: Track item charges across value chain automation in Scope 3
features.summary: Track inventory emissions by collecting data on item charges during the purchase process and track emissions under Scope 3.
features.title_da: Opfolg varerelaterede gebyrer på tværs af automatiseringen af værdikæden i Scope 3
features.summary_da: Spor lageremissioner ved at indsamle data om varegebyrer under købsprocessen og spor emissioner under Område 3.
features.title_nl: Volg kosten van artikelen in de automatisering van de waardeketen in Scope 3
features.summary_nl: Volg voorraademissies door gegevens te verzamelen over artikelkosten tijdens het aankoopproces en volg emissies onder Scope 3.
features.title_fr: Suivi des coûts des articles dans l’automatisation de la chaîne de valeur dans le Scope 3
features.summary_fr: Suivez les émissions de stock en collectant des données sur les frais d’articles pendant le processus d’achat et suivez les émissions dans le cadre du champ d’application 3.

features.title: Track items of concern related to gas emissions
features.summary: Track items based on their emissions level using the Item of Concern flag. Create a report for tracking inbound and outbound movements of these items.
features.title_da: Spor problematiske punkter i forbindelse med gasemissioner
features.summary_da: Spor varer baseret på deres emissionsniveau ved hjælp af flaget Bekymring. Opret en rapport til sporing af indgående og udgående bevægelser af disse varer.
features.title_nl: Volg aandachtspunten met betrekking tot gasemissies
features.summary_nl: Volg items op basis van hun emissieniveau met behulp van de Item of Concern-vlag. Maak een rapport voor het bijhouden van inkomende en uitgaande bewegingen van deze artikelen.
features.title_fr: Suivre les sujets de préoccupation liés aux émissions de gaz
features.summary_fr: Suivez les articles en fonction de leur niveau d’émissions à l’aide de l’indicateur « Élément préoccupant ». Créez un rapport pour le suivi des mouvements entrants et sortants de ces articles.

features.title: Use CBAM and EPR calculations
features.summary: The EU’s CBAM ensures that imports face the same carbon costs as local goods to prevent leakage. EPR makes producers accountable for product lifecycles.
features.title_da: Brug CBAM- og EPR-beregninger
features.summary_da: EU's CBAM sikrer, at importen står over for de samme kulstofomkostninger som lokale varer for at forhindre lækage. EPR gør producenterne ansvarlige for produkters livscyklus.
features.title_nl: Gebruik CBAM- en EPR-berekeningen
features.summary_nl: Het CBAM van de EU zorgt ervoor dat invoer met dezelfde koolstofkosten wordt geconfronteerd als lokale goederen om lekkage te voorkomen. EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility) maakt producenten verantwoordelijk voor de levenscyclus van producten.
features.title_fr: Utiliser les calculs MACF et EPR
features.summary_fr: Le MACF de l’UE veille à ce que les importations soient soumises aux mêmes coûts carbone que les produits locaux afin d’éviter les fuites. La REP responsabilise les producteurs sur le cycle de vie des produits.

features.title: Use ESG Reporting integrated with Business Central

features.title_nl: Voer meerdere agents voor verkooporders per bedrijf uit met slimmere artikelmatching, relevantiefilters en een gestroomlijnde configuratie

features.title_fr: Exécuter plusieurs agents de commandes par entreprise avec une mise en correspondance d’éléments plus intelligente, un filtrage de pertinence et une configuration simplifiée

features.summary_da: Forhåndsvis og valider e-fakturaer, før de bogføres i Business Central, ved hjælp af siden Købskladde, som nu understøtter Peppol for øget fleksibilitet.
features.title_nl: De pagina Inkoopconcept gebruiken om een voorbeeld van elektronische Peppol-facturen te bekijken
features.summary_nl: Bekijk en valideer e-facturen, voordat u in Business Central boekt, met de pagina Inkoopconcept, die nu Peppol ondersteunt voor meer flexibiliteit.
features.title_fr: Utilisez la page brouillon d’achat pour afficher l’aperçu des factures électroniques Peppol.
features.summary_fr: Affichez un aperçu et validez les factures électroniques avant de les publier dans Business Central avec la page "Brouillon d'achat", qui prend désormais en charge Peppol pour une plus grande flexibilité.

features.title: Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions

features.title_da: Brug AI-ressourcer til dine Copilot-udvidelser
features.summary_da: Udgivere kan nu bruge LLM'er via Business Central AI-ressourcer administreret af Microsoft, når de udvider Copilot i Business Central i Marketplace-apps.
features.title_nl: AI-resources gebruiken voor uw Copilot-extensies
features.summary_nl: Uitgevers kunnen nu grote taalmodellen (LLM's) gebruiken via door Microsoft beheerde Business Central AI-bronnen wanneer ze Copilot uitbreiden in Business Central in Marketplace-apps.
features.title_fr: Utilisez des ressources d’IA pour vos extensions Copilot
features.summary_fr: Les éditeurs peuvent désormais utiliser des LLM à l’aide des ressources d’IA pour Business Central gérées par Microsoft lorsqu’ils enrichissent Copilot dans Business Central dans des applications Marketplace.

features.title: Enable embedded Verifactu mode in Spain
features.summary: Enable real-time invoice reporting to AEAT with Verifactu in Business Central, ensuring QR code, hash chaining, and digital signature compliance.
features.title_da: Aktivér indlejret Verifactu-tilstand i Spanien
features.summary_da: Få mulighed for rapportering af fakturaer i realtid til AEAT med Verifactu i Business Central, så du overholder kravene om QR-kode, hashkæde og digital signatur.
features.title_nl: Ingesloten Verifactu-modus inschakelen in Spanje
features.summary_nl: Schakel realtime factuurrapportage aan de AEAT in met Verifactu in Business Central, zodat u voldoet aan de eisen betreffende QR-codes, hash-ketening en digitale handtekeningen.
features.title_fr: Activer le mode Verifactu intégré en Espagne
features.summary_fr: Activez le rapport de factures en temps réel à l'AEAT avec Verifactu dans Business Central, en assurant la conformité au code QR, au chaînage de hachage et aux signatures numériques.

features.title: Enable unified Copilot chat experience consistent with Microsoft Copilot
features.summary: Use the new Microsoft Copilot experience in Business Central to reason over business data, web results, and general knowledge in a modern chat experience aligned with the broader Microsoft Copilot ecosystem.

features.title: Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent
features.summary: Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent with line amounts and expected receipt dates. Align draft finalization with the Receipt on Invoice settings.

features.title: Run data queries with MCP Server
features.summary: Use new MCP tools to define, validate, and run custom data queries. Your MCP application can then query data for which no existing APIs exist.

features.title: Cash document – sending by e‑mail in Czechia
features.summary: Issue, post, and email Czech receipt cash documents using standard document sending profiles.

features.title: Compensation – sending by e‑mail in Czechia
features.summary: Businesses can share compensations by email directly from Business Central.

features.title: Proforma Invoice Report with Czech Layout in Czechia
features.summary: Use the enhanced Draft Invoice and Pro Forma Invoice reports with additional details and an improved layout for pre-posting approval processes.

features.title: Separate setup for automatic dimensions in Czechia
features.summary: Use a new framework that automates how you create and maintain default dimensions with migration from existing setups.

features.title: Access application links through ModuleInfo
features.summary: Read help, EULA, privacy statement, and locale-aware context-sensitive help links from an app manifest at runtime through additional ModuleInfo properties.

features.title: Actions on reports and pages can now inherit tooltips
features.summary: Tooltips on page or report objects are now inherited into actions that run those pages. This means you only need to write descriptive tooltips in one place and have it propagated out to all usage of the object.

features.title: AL developers can turn indexes on/off in AL code.
features.summary: AL developers can now turn indexes off/on from AL code.

features.title: Audit AL app accessibility and debugging boundaries
features.summary: Build and query static AL call graphs to trace public-to-internal calls, debugging boundaries, elevated code, and cross-app relationships, with visual exports.

features.title: Build extensible and data-driven AL test suites
features.summary: Create parameterized AL tests from reusable data sources, and attach lifecycle handlers for shared setup, cleanup, logging, measurement, and test reporting.

features.title: Check records for uncommitted changes
features.summary: Use the Record API IsDirty property to determine whether a record instance contains unsaved changes before deciding to validate, save, or otherwise process it.

features.title: Configure AL MCP workspaces dynamically
features.summary: Start the AL MCP server without a predefined project, add AL projects at runtime, and use configured connection details in headless scenarios without authentication prompts.

features.title: Control transaction isolation for queries and isolated storage
features.summary: Read only committed data in AL queries and choose the isolation level for isolated-storage reads, including row locking for safer read-modify-write operations.

features.title: Debug recorded Business Central failures with an AI agent
features.summary: Describe a failing scenario to an AI agent, record the next matching Business Central session or a known session, and collect its snapshot for offline AL debugging.

features.title: Detect tables approaching SQL column limits
features.summary: Receive compiler warnings when tables or table extensions contain many normal fields, helping identify data models that are approaching SQL extensibility limits.

features.title: Developers can define indexes that span fields from a base table and its table extensions
features.summary: The new data model for storing fields from table extensions allows developers to define keys across fields from the base table and table extensions.

features.title: Diagnose AL MCP server activity with file logging
features.summary: Write AL MCP server diagnostics to a configurable file, select the appropriate detail level for troubleshooting, or turn file logging off when it isn't required.

features.title: Discover objects in connected Business Central environments
features.summary: Search objects installed in a connected Business Central environment, including owning-app metadata needed to add dependencies and download the correct symbols.

features.title: Evolve AL interfaces with default implementations
features.summary: Add default method bodies to AL interfaces so existing implementors continue working, then use RequiredPending and analyzer rules to introduce required methods safely.

features.title: Get clearer guidance for AL object structure
features.summary: Use compiler diagnostic AL0926 to identify AL object sections declared in the wrong order instead of interpreting multiple secondary and less specific parser errors.

features.title: Let agents allocate free AL object IDs
features.summary: Let coding agents find available IDs for AL objects and extension objects within project ranges, reducing manual range checks and collisions with existing project objects.

features.title: Migrate table fields from Integer to BigInteger
features.summary: Increase an existing table field from Integer to BigInteger while receiving compiler and analyzer warnings for dependent expressions that might narrow or overflow values.

features.title: Profile slow Business Central sessions with AI agents
features.summary: Let an AI agent schedule profiling for a Business Central session, collect CPU and memory data, identify costly AL paths, and summarize SQL and HTTP activity.

features.title: Restrict global symbol resolution to a minor version
features.summary: Configure global symbol downloads to remain within the major and minor version in app.json while still selecting the newest available patch for all dependencies.

features.title: Run AL tests from command-line and CI/CD workflows
features.summary: Use ALTool to compile, deploy, and run AL test projects from scripts or pipelines, with structured JSON results for test methods and pass, fail, and skip counts.

features.title: Simplify AL extension setup and authentication in Visual Studio Code
features.summary: Automatically acquire the required .NET runtime and use Visual Studio Code authentication by default, reducing manual setup across local and browser-hosted environments.

features.title: Track AL compiler diagnostics in automated builds
features.summary: Have ALTool workspace builds write structured, project-specific compiler error logs that automated systems can retain, analyze, and use for code-quality tracking.

features.title: Translate objects with the same name in different namespaces
features.summary: Generate namespace-aware translation identifiers so identically named AL objects can be translated independently while existing non-namespaced translations remain valid.

features.title: Use AL language intelligence from AI agents and other editors
features.summary: Run the standalone AL language server to provide completion, navigation, references, rename, formatting, and other project-aware LSP features outside Visual Studio Code.

features.title: Use cross-platform report layout paths
features.summary: Use either forward slashes or backslashes in report layout and analysis-view paths so the same AL source compiles consistently on Windows and Linux systems.

features.title: Control sales document creation for Shopify orders and returns
features.summary: Set Use Shopify Order No. and Process Returns as on the Shopify Shop Card, then review contacts before you choose Create Sales Document.

features.title: Keep Shopify connections current
features.summary: Use Shopify's July 2026 API, activate secure access tokens, and use clearer synchronization diagnostics with Skipped Records and API Errors cues.

features.title: Manage Shopify B2B companies, catalogs, and pricing
features.summary: Map company tax identifiers, manage B2B catalogs, and control price synchronization for capabilities available with your Shopify plan.

features.title: Match Shopify tax lines with the Tax Matching Agent
features.summary: Review suggested tax jurisdictions, confidence levels, and rate differences on the Tax Match Review page before you process sales document with sales tax.

features.title: Process Shopify order changes, exchanges, and refunds
features.summary: Keep edited and exchanged Shopify orders aligned when you create sales documents and process refunds.

features.title: Synchronize tariff numbers and countries/regions of origin with Shopify
features.summary: Turn on Sync HS Code and Country of Origin on the Shopify Shop Card page to include tariff numbers and countries or regions of origin into the product synchronization tasks.

features.title: Exchange EDI documents via E-Documents
features.summary: Send and receive electronic documents (orders, payments) seamlessly through E-Documents using the Peppol BIS 3 EDI standard for secure, efficient data exchange.

features.title: Add date range and different vehicle types in your mileage calculation in Expense Agent
features.summary: Configure mileage rates by effective date range and vehicle type to ensure accurate calculations that reflect changing policies and transportation methods

features.title: Add interim approver when submit the expense report
features.summary: Enable interim approvers for expense reports, allowing submissions to be routed through a temporary reviewer before final approval

features.title: Calculate withholding taxes automatically in expense report
features.summary: Automatically calculate employee withholding taxes within expense reports to improve compliance, reduce manual effort, and ensure accurate reimbursement process

features.title: Expense Agent supports approval process
features.summary: Review submitted expense reports with AI-based policy validation that flags suspicious or noncompliant items across lines and reports.

features.title: Improve duplicates prevention in Expense Agent
features.summary: Improve expense accuracy with enhanced duplicate detection and prevention even with already posted documents, helping to reduce duplicate reimbursements

features.title: Manage travel requisitions with Expense Agent
features.summary: Plan and approve travel in advance using travel requisitions with support for multiple travelers and integrated approval workflows.

features.title: Calculate multiple excise duties per item
features.summary: Support multiple excise duties on a single item, enabling businesses to calculate and manage complex excise tax requirements with greater accuracy.

features.title: Calculate withholding taxes for vendors
features.summary: You can calculate withholding tax for vendors in the standard version of Business Central.

features.title: Enable accelerated depreciation methods for fixed assets
features.summary: Introduce accelerated depreciation for fixed assets, enabling compliant calculations and reporting.

features.title: Set up vendor specific number series for self-billing invoices
features.summary: Configure vendor-specific number series for self-billing purchase invoices to meet supplier requirements and improve invoice traceability and compliance.

features.title: Use withholding taxes with employee transactions
features.summary: Enable withholding tax processing for employee-related transactions, ensuring accurate tax calculation, posting, and compliance across employee payments

features.title: Administrators can turn SIFT indexes on/off
features.summary: Administrators can now turn SIFT indexes on/off directly in the Business Central application.

features.title: Monitor usage of Open in Excel with telemetry
features.summary: Logging Open in Excel actions to telemetry makes data export events auditable, which can be critical for compliance, security investigations, and understanding how customers use Business Central.

features.title: Automate report outputs
features.summary: Use the new APIs on the report inbox to extend automation with Power Automate or MCP to reports.

features.title: Bookmark list views and analysis tabs
features.summary: Bookmark analysis tabs and list views to your role center and/or incorporate them into profiles.

features.title: Brand document reports with report themes
features.summary: With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a report theme on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output. It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.

features.title: Control the lifecycle of all report layouts
features.summary: Set status on all types of layouts to control which layouts are available to end users.

features.title: Design document report themes with the updated Word add-in
features.summary: Design document report themes using the new document samples controls in the Word add-in

features.title: Design document reports with the updated Word add-in
features.summary: Use new design components in the Word add-in to layout your document report layouts.

features.title: Design header/footer layouts for document reports with the updated Word add-in
features.summary: Design document report header/footer layouts using the new header and/or footer document samples controls in the Word add-in

features.title: Financial report changes are now always logged
features.summary: Changes to financial row, column, and report definitions are automatically recorded in the change log for easier auditing.

features.title: Reduce complexity of report datasets
features.summary: Word layouts now include a company information dataitem that is shared across all report datasets. This reduces the work needed for a report developer and standardizes how company information is used across report layouts.

features.title: Reuse header/footer layouts across document reports
features.summary: With the new composable layouts feature, you can apply a header/footer on layouts to get consistent look and feel on the PDF output. It is possible to set defaults on a global level, per company, per report, or per layout, giving the administrator full flexibility of theming.

features.title: Run multiple financial reports and get a single PDF output
features.summary: Define report packs that contain multiple financial reports, and then run them immediately or schedule delivery to report inboxes or by email.

features.title: Trace G/L account usage in finance reports
features.summary: Financial report authors can now identify uncategorized accounts, trace account usage and calculations, and preview definitions before publishing

features.title: Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in
features.summary: Design document reports layouts with conditional visibility using the new HideIf logic control in the Word add-in

features.title: Use system audit fields in analysis mode and in profiles
features.summary: Use system audit fields in analysis tabs and add them directly to pages in profiles.

features.title: Faster data loading with improved data model for table extensions
features.summary: With the new data model for table extensions, all fields on an AL table are stored in the same table in the database. This gives faster performance on all database operations that involve table extensions.

features.title: Carry subcontracting instructions into purchase orders
features.summary: Give subcontractors the right operation instructions by carrying routing comments and attachments into purchase orders.

features.title: Migrate Italian legacy subcontracting data to the Subcontracting app
features.summary: Complete open WIP transfers and purchase orders, then move setup, prices, and active document references in a sandbox and verify record counts before running migration in production.

features.title: Post direct transfer orders from warehouse-enabled locations
features.summary: Use direct transfer orders for source locations that require inventory picks or warehouse shipments.

features.title: Reduce manual work in quality tests and inspections
features.summary: Finishing an inspection fills in passed and failed quantities. Actionable posting errors let you jump to blocking inspection. Editing an inspection prompts you to assign it to yourself.

features.title: Set up and explore subcontracting more easily
features.summary: Configure subcontracting with assisted setup and notifications that open missing vendor or location setup. Contoso demo data helps evaluate different subcontracting scenarios.

features.title: Use inventory put-aways and picks for subcontracting
features.summary: Basic warehouse configurations now support subcontracting, so employees can process this work alongside their regular inbound and outbound activities.

features.title: Work more efficiently with manufacturing documents and capacity calendars
features.summary: Create released orders from Planning Worksheet, monitor and update capacity calendars, and open production BOMs and routings from actionable errors.

features.title: Estimate your carbon footprint in Service Management
features.summary: Show an estimated carbon footprint on service invoices and related documents by using sustainability data from items and resources in Service Management.

features.title: Reverse Sustainability Ledger entrie transaction
features.summary: Reverse sustainability ledger entries posted from sustainability or general journals, directly from the Sustainability Ledger Entries page.

features.title: Track your carbon footprint for fixed assets
features.summary: Enable carbon footprint tracking for fixed assets by adding sustainability accounts and CO₂e values to fixed asset transactions.

features.title: Track your carbon footprint with item journals and item reclassification journals

features.summary: Several improvements have been made to the eCandidates functionality. features.summary: A new field, Process Document Type, has been added to the Document Category Card. This field controls how PDF and XML files are handled during import when both file types are attached to the same email. Depending on the selected option, either one or both file types are processed, while unprocessed file types are added as attachments. For more information, see Working with paper and PDF documents.

features.summary: A Document Status Code column has been added to the Message Center Setup page, enabling automatic assignment of document status codes based on predefined comments.

features.summary: Several labels and actions related to the custom columns functionality have been updated to align with standard Business Central naming: In the document journal, the Custom Columns action has been added to the Page action group. features.summary: Previously, when using AI line recognition, template line fields that had been manually recognized could only be reset to AI-only recognition by recreating the template. It is now possible to reset a line field to AI recognition by selecting the field and then left-clicking an empty area in the Document Viewer , allowing the AI engine to recognize the field again.

features.title: Previously, changing the Notification Email Address on a document category did not trigger an automatic export of the OCR configuration files.
features.summary: Previously, changing the Notification Email Address on a document category did not trigger an automatic export of the OCR configuration files. The OCR configuration is now automatically exported when this field value is updated.

features.title: Item tracking capture has been enhanced to make it easier to process documents containing multiple item tracking values.
features.summary: Item tracking capture has been enhanced to make it easier to process documents containing multiple item tracking values. Multiple values can now be captured for each item line, allowing all relevant item tracking information to be captured directly from the document.

features.title: Previously, blocked dimension values were included when looking up dimensions in Accounts for Amounts .
features.summary: Previously, blocked dimension values were included when looking up dimensions in Accounts for Amounts . Blocked values are now excluded from the list.

features.title: Duplicate invoice validation has been improved to provide a complete overview of potential duplicates.
features.summary: Duplicate invoice validation has been improved to provide a complete overview of potential duplicates. Previously, when duplicates existed across unregistered, registered, and posted documents, not all relevant warning comments were displayed. All applicable duplicate warnings are now shown together, making it easier to identify and assess every potential duplicate before proceeding.

features.title: Vendor VAT number and vendor bank account number validation comments can now be configured as errors, warnings, or information, providing greater flex
features.summary: Vendor VAT number and vendor bank account number validation comments can now be configured as errors, warnings, or information, providing greater flexibility in how mismatches are handled. This allows documents to be registered when a mismatch is acceptable for the specific business scenario.

features.summary: On the Approval Sharing - Document Capture (DC) page, the Both Users option in the Send Email To field was previously blocked and could not be selected. The option is now fully supported, allowing both the original approver and the substitute to receive notifications when the Send Status Email to Approvers function is used.

features.title: Integrating Sustainability with Document Capture has been simplified through a new guide available in Assisted Setup .
features.summary: Integrating Sustainability with Document Capture has been simplified through a new guide available in Assisted Setup . Completing the guide automatically adds the required sustainability fields to all purchase document master templates.

features.summary: When entering text in the document header No. or Bal. Account No. fields, the matching account is now automatically identified based on its name or search name, and the correct number is filled out. features.summary: Previously, when using the Create Line on Purchase Document action on the Match Lines page, only one order line could be created at a time. It is now possible to select multiple captured lines and create corresponding purchase order or return order lines in a single action.

features.title: When a partial receipt is received against a purchase order – and the auto-match configuration (e.g.
features.summary: When a partial receipt is received against a purchase order – and the auto-match configuration (e.g.: matching on order number, item number, and quantity) can not find a match for lines with differing quantities – it's now possible to manually set the Matched Quantity on the Order Lines section in the Order Matching.

features.title: Standard Business Central order matching actions introduced in BC 28.0 are hidden when using Document Capture.
features.summary: Standard Business Central order matching actions introduced in BC 28.0 are hidden when using Document Capture. You can continue to use the dedicated Document Capture matching experience without interference f

features.title: It is now possible to enable a new purchase order and receipt matching engine that significantly improves the performance of three-way matching for pu
features.summary: It is now possible to enable a new purchase order and receipt matching engine that significantly improves the performance of three-way matching for purchase invoices and credit memos. The improvements apply to both header-level and line-level matching and are particularly beneficial in environments with large numbers of open purchase orders and receipts.

features.title: When a GP-to-Business-Central cloud migration was performed in environments with Continia apps installed, the migration could fail in some cases.
features.summary: When a GP-to-Business-Central cloud migration was performed in environments with Continia apps installed, the migration could fail in some cases. This occurred because Continia added entries to the Migration Table Mapping table without first verifying whether the migration was a GP-to-Business Central or a Business-Central-to-Business-Central migration. Now, Continia checks the product ID before adding custom table mappings – ensuring that GP-to-Business-Central migrations complete successfully.

features.summary: A new field, Approval Date Adjustment , has been added to the Purchase Contract Card to define a lead-time period (a.k.a. offset) for contract approvals.

features.summary: When configuring the XML template to Show Embedded PDF files as Default (instead of the styled XML view), embedded PDF files were shown only in Business Central. Now. Now, the embedded PDF files are also viewable in the Web Approval Portal.

features.summary: The right and left arrow keys can be used to move the cursor between the Field and Value columns in the Document Header section on the Document Journal and Document Card pages.

The change has been made to comply with GDPR legislation in certain countries, such as Germany. To adhere to bookkeeping legislation in other countries, like Denmark, the value remains accessible via Page Inspection (zoom). A user with sufficient permissions is still able to inspect the user ID by using the Page Inspection (zoom).

features.summary: This version introduces the Document Control Log which makes it easier to do a proactive follow-up on documents having one or more failed Secure Archive checks. The list is populated from a batch job that can be either executed or scheduled in the current user session. The Document Control Log offers easy access to a number of related information through direct access to Find Entries and the Document Log Summary for further examination of the document.

features.summary: Enabling the option Check for attachment before posting of purchase document in the Document Capture Setup page specifies if the system should display an error message if no incoming document or Document Capture file is associated with the document at the time of posting. The check is imposed both on purchase documents and purchase journals. The option only applies to on-premises environments and Business Central versions 23.1 and earlier.

features.summary: The internal version of Document Capture 2024 R1 has been updated to 24 (the internal version of Document Capture 2023 R2 was 12). The change aims to align the Continia solution versions with those of Business Central, simplifying for Continia partners which versions of the solutions are compatible. The synchronization is particularly crucial for the Continia Core and Continia Delivery Network extensions.

features.title: Now the user export will only run if any changes necessitate a new export, reducing unnecessary excessive exports when configured in the Job Queue .
features.summary: Now the user export will only run if any changes necessitate a new export, reducing unnecessary excessive exports when configured in the Job Queue . If the export is run in a database where the data for export is unchanged since the last export, the following notification will be shown: Nothing is exported, because no changes have been done since the last export.

features.summary: With Document Capture 2024 R1 (24.00), we have released Document Capture for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2024 release wave 1 (BC24). As the incoming documents functionality is a key part of Microsoft's new Digital Vouchers feature, the factbox will not be hidden but instead showing it below the Document Viewer factbox.

features.summary: The Output Profile field was added to standard Business Central document pages. This enhancement allows users to see output settings directly from the document pages.

features.summary: Enhanced functionality was implemented to allow users to hide the standard Email action on purchase documents in Business Central. This update provides greater flexibility in customizing the user interface.

features.summary: You can now apply filtering options to the Update Output Profile on Documents batch job. This enhancement allows users to specify criteria for selecting documents, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of the output profile updates. Users can filter based on various document attributes, such as Document Type , Document Date , and Customer/Vendor No. , ensuring that only relevant documents are processed.

features.title: Enhanced stability has been achieved when using Azure Blob Storage to store log data.
features.summary: Enhanced stability has been achieved when using Azure Blob Storage to store log data. This improvement addressed issues that previously led to intermittent failures during data storage operations, ensuring more reliable performance and data integrity.

features.title: When a copy to a sandbox environment is performed, the Azure Blob Container Name is cleared.
features.summary: When a copy to a sandbox environment is performed, the Azure Blob Container Name is cleared. This change was implemented to prevent any unintended modifications to production data stored in Azure Blob Containers.

features.title: Added a toggle in Output Profile to enable or disable automatic fallback to email if the recipient's network ID is not registered.
features.summary: Added a toggle in Output Profile to enable or disable automatic fallback to email if the recipient's network ID is not registered. When enabled, invoices are automatically sent by email if the receiver for the selected eDocument network is not registered, removing the need for manual resending.

features.summary: The field handling of Buyer Reference and Order Reference in Document Output (DO) and Continia Delivery Network (CDN) has been reworked for PEPPOL BIS 3, OIOUBL, and xRechnung formats. features.summary: The Document Output FactBox on Service Credit Memo pages previously displayed the Quote Recipient and Shipment Recipient fields instead of the appropriate recipient information. It now correctly shows the Credit Memo Recipient field, ensuring that recipient details for service credit memo documents are accurate and relevant.

features.title: The integration event OnBeforeUpdateHandledFields has been added to support scenarios where custom document types require CDO Handled logic.
features.summary: The integration event OnBeforeUpdateHandledFields has been added to support scenarios where custom document types require CDO Handled logic. This event allows you to extend or modify the handling of fields before the standard CDO Handled processing occurs.

features.title: A new batch job has been added to update the Handled status on issued reminders.
features.summary: A new batch job has been added to update the Handled status on issued reminders. You can now run this batch job to automatically set the Handled field for reminders that meet specific criteria.

features.title: The Output Profiles feature now includes a new option, Fallback to Print .
features.summary: The Output Profiles feature now includes a new option, Fallback to Print . This option can be enabled to automatically print documents when no email recipients are found during the email-sending process. By activating Fallback to Print , users ensure that documents are printed instead of being sent via email if recipient information is missing, thereby maintaining document delivery continuity.

features.title: In the Update Output Profile on Documents batch job, the checkboxes will now default to false .
features.summary: In the Update Output Profile on Documents batch job, the checkboxes will now default to false . This change ensures that users must actively select the checkboxes if they wish to update the output profile on documents, providing greater control and reducing the risk of unintentional updates.

features.summary: Lines in CII invoices/credit memos with a 0% line discount triggered a war2025 R1ning when validating an XML file: Item net price MUST equal (Gross price - Allowance amount) when gross price is provided. Comment lines containing a VAT Posting Group selected in the CII invoice/credit memo lines resulted in an incorrect tax category being specified in the XML files. The External Document No. field now appears in the CII invoice/credit memo XML files when it has a value.

features.title: You can now translate Email Templates into different languages or adjust the tone of the email using Copilot.
features.summary: You can now translate Email Templates into different languages or adjust the tone of the email using Copilot. This functionality is accessible under Edit Email Template on the Email Template Card. It allows users to customize email communications to better suit their audience's language preferences or desired tone. Please note that this feature is currently in prerelease and will only be visible once it has been enabled in Continia Feature Management .

features.title: Handled (DO) functionality is now also added to Reminders.
features.summary: Handled (DO) functionality is now also added to Reminders.

features.title: Enhanced the functionality for embedding documents in electronic documents to include attachments.
features.summary: Enhanced the functionality for embedding documents in electronic documents to include attachments. The configuration for which documents to embed is determined by the settings in the Output Profile and is also influenced by the configuration of the template.

features.summary: The fields Log E-Mails and Keep E-Mail log for on the Email Template Card now require users to have either the SUPER or CDO-SUPER permission set to edit them. This change ensures that only users with the appropriate level of access can modify these fields, enhancing security and control over email logging configurations.

features.title: A new setup wizard was introduced to the Automatic Period Statement page.
features.summary: A new setup wizard was introduced to the Automatic Period Statement page. This wizard was designed to streamline the configuration process for the Automatic Period Statement and to provide clear guidance on how each setting in the table influences the dispatch of statements. To support this enhancement, the user interface on the Automatic Period Statement page was optimized for compatibility with the new wizard.

When you register a new Danish Peppol participation, Business Central now sends the 8-digit CVR number directly, without adding a DK prefix. features.summary: Whenever you open the Participations page, Business Central now also synchronizes participation identifier values from the Continia Delivery Network. If an identifier value has been updated on the network side – for example, to comply with updated Peppol format requirements – your local participation record is automatically updated to reflect the current value. This ensures that your Business Central records stay in sync with the Continia Delivery Network without any manual intervention.

features.summary: Email templates now support custom Report Selection Usage values, and you can extend the CDOReportSelectionUsage enum with custom values to isolate custom templates from standard Business Central document processing. A new OnFindTemplateWithReportSelection event lets you control template selection for custom usage codes, and template selection now prioritizes exact matches by usage and table before falling back to generic templates.

features.title: Added a toggle to the output profile to enable or disable automatic fallback to email if the eDocument ID is not registered.
features.summary: Added a toggle to the output profile to enable or disable automatic fallback to email if the eDocument ID is not registered. When enabled, invoices are automatically sent by email if the Peppol endpoint is not registered, eliminating the need for manual intervention.

features.summary: The Send action has been renamed to Send/Print across all relevant pages, including sales order pages, purchase order pages, posted document pages, and unhandled document pages, in order to ensure consistency. Tooltips and action orders have also been updated accordingly. Translations for Send/Print have been applied in all supported languages.

features.summary: The handling of TaxExemptionReason in the TaxTotal element for PEPPOL and xRechnung eDocuments has been updated: When a document line’s VAT Posting Setup includes a VAT clause code, the TaxExemptionReason is populated using a combination of the Description and Description 2 fields. features.title: Document Output Service and OnPrem PDF DLLs now require DotNet 8, as previous versions used unsupported DotNet runtimes.
features.summary: Document Output Service and OnPrem PDF DLLs now require DotNet 8, as previous versions used unsupported DotNet runtimes. This is only relevant for new installations.

features.title: A new eSeal feature has been added to automatically apply electronic seals to PDF documents sent to customers, verifying the origin, integrity and sig
features.summary: A new eSeal feature has been added to automatically apply electronic seals to PDF documents sent to customers, verifying the origin, integrity and signing entity's identity. The feature can be configured individually for each customer and integrates with existing document workflows, ensuring that PDF documents are secured without manual steps. This feature is available when activating the new Security module.

features.title: Added ability to select file format (PDF, Excel, or Word) at the Template line reports (Report overwrite), on the Email Template Lines .
features.summary: Added ability to select file format (PDF, Excel, or Word) at the Template line reports (Report overwrite), on the Email Template Lines . This allows sending the same document type in different formats based on recipient preferences or template Variants , providing greater flexibility in document delivery.

features.summary: The field handling of Buyer Reference and Order Reference in Document Output (DO) and Continia Delivery Network (CDN) has been reworked for PEPPOL BIS 3, OIOUBL, and xRechnung formats. features.title: Added events to allow customization of document template selection when attaching invoices and credit memos to reminders.
features.summary: Added events to allow customization of document template selection when attaching invoices and credit memos to reminders. Partners can now override the default template selection for special document types like rental invoices and credit memos, enabling proper document generation for specialized modules and complete coverage of all open documents scenarios.

features.title: The following changes have been made to the Document Output permission sets
features.summary: The following changes have been made to the Document Output permission sets: CDO-ALL has been renamed to CDO BASIC. CDO-SUPER has been renamed to CDO ADMIN. CDO-LOG has been renamed to CDO LOG. The renamed permission sets will be updated automatically during the upgrade. For more information about permission sets, see Document Output Permissions .

features.title: Enhanced Document Output with a new modular architecture that provides better scalability and easier feature management.
features.summary: Enhanced Document Output with a new modular architecture that provides better scalability and easier feature management. The system now supports distinct Essential and Security modules, improving license management and feature organization. With the introduction of the Security module, the features PDF-Password and Sign-PDF will be moved from the Essential module to the Security module. This means that the interface elements related to these features will no longer be visible unless the Security

features.summary: The following improvements have been added to the ZUGFeRD format: Lines in CII invoices/credit memos with a 0% line discount no longer trigger the following warning when validating an XML file: Item net price MUST equal (Gross price - Allowance amount) when gross price is provided. features.summary: Added support for payment discounts in XML export when exporting electronic documents from sales invoices and service invoices.

features.summary: A Recalculate action is now available on the eReport Card and eReports list pages, where multiple eReports can be selected and recalculated at once. Recalculating returns the documents in an eReport to the processing queue, allowing the eReport to be rebuilt the next time Process References runs, either manually or as scheduled. features.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2

features.summary: Required #PMT#, #PMD#, and #AAB# document notes are now generated automatically when you send eDocuments through the French PA network. These notes can also be configured manually in the Payment Means Setup page.

features.title: When retrieving document attachments stored by a third-party app in Azure Blob Storage, the wrong attachment files were returned.
features.summary: When retrieving document attachments stored by a third-party app in Azure Blob Storage, the wrong attachment files were returned. A new OnBeforeGetDocumentAttachment event is now available, so custom retrieval logic can be implemented to return the correct files.

features.title: The Print PDF function now offers the same capabilities as Open Email and Save PDF when using saved request pages from the Email Template Line Report
features.summary: The Print PDF function now offers the same capabilities as Open Email and Save PDF when using saved request pages from the Email Template Line Report Layout .

features.title: Aligned French CustomizationID values with the latest French implementation examples.
features.summary: Aligned French CustomizationID values with the latest French implementation examples. French EN16931 documents are now correctly identified and processed using the FR CII and FR UBL XML structures.

features.title: Added eDocument scenario flow <REGULARCREDITMEMO> to support sales credit memos in CII-FR.
features.summary: Added eDocument scenario flow <REGULARCREDITMEMO> to support sales credit memos in CII-FR.

features.title: An eReport now remains open for changes until it is sent, and eReports can be processed and sent directly from the eReports list.
features.summary: An eReport now remains open for changes until it is sent, and eReports can be processed and sent directly from the eReports list. The following changes have been made: A document posted after its reporting period has been processed will be added to that period's eReport. An eReport that was already approved returns to the Ready for Approval status, so the change can be approved. The next reporting period starts only after the eReport has been sent. features.title: Added support for the French Factur-X format across sending and receiving processes.
features.summary: Added support for the French Factur-X format across sending and receiving processes. This update introduces support for handling Factur-X documents, including the associated PDF invoice file: Added support for sending Factur-X PDF documents through the Continia Delivery Network. Extended network document storage to support PDF attachments alongside XML content. Added support for downloading and storing incoming Factur-X PDF files when receiving electronic documents. Onboarding has now been split into a company onboarding and a network registration, and both are new. features.summary: On the References page, two new actions recover reporting data without reposting: Add Missing Reference adds again an already-posted document or ledger entry that never reached a report so it can be classified against the current filters, and Run Identification runs the identification pass over pending references on demand.

features.title: When only Document Output was installed, the eDocuments configuration file could be imported but not exported.
features.summary: When only Document Output was installed, the eDocuments configuration file could be imported but not exported. Exporting the eDocuments configuration file is now supported when only Document Output is installed.

features.summary: Improved identifier handling across electronic documents. Customer, vendor, and onboarding configurations now automatically apply country-specific identifier defaults, ensuring more consistent and accurate document generation.

features.summary: In previous versions of Document Capture and Document Output, each product brought a selection of tiles to a number of Role Centers. features.summary: When the Sender Profile was missing in both the Output Profile and Customer Setup (or Vendor Setup ), the system incorrectly showed the following error: XML Structure Setup is empty . The validation now shows an actionable error, which allows users to navigate directly to relevant Output Profile or Customer Setup (or Vendor Setup ) pages, where the Sender Profile is missing.

features.summary: A new Send action has been added to the eReport Card , allowing approved eReports to be sent directly to the delivery network. This action is available when the eReport has the Approved status.

features.title: After upgrading from version 27 to 28 and running the DO Setup Guide in a DC-to-DO migration, DO permissions were not correctly assigned based on exis
features.summary: After upgrading from version 27 to 28 and running the DO Setup Guide in a DC-to-DO migration, DO permissions were not correctly assigned based on existing DC Admin/Basic permissions (including security groups). The setup guide now assigns DO Admin to DC Admin users and DO Basic to DC Basic users, and applies the same mapping to security groups when used.
