features.summary: It is now possible to always import inpayments from a file. Regardless of whether webservice communication is used or not.

features.title: New payment journal setups will now have "Use Vend.
features.summary: New payment journal setups will now have "Use Vend. Pmt. info" set to "Modified" per default.

features.title: Field "FI-Direct" removed from Payment Management Basis - Setup page.
features.summary: Field "FI-Direct" removed from Payment Management Basis - Setup page. Field is no longer used.

features.title: Support for Nordea Corporate Access Reporting Services (CARS).
features.summary: Support for Nordea Corporate Access Reporting Services (CARS). Improvements in the Nordea Corporate Access-format which now supports Camt053, Camt053E and Camt054C.

features.title: Infobox added to the payment journal with Information about payments (status codes) from the banks.
features.summary: Infobox added to the payment journal with Information about payments (status codes) from the banks. For example "2. approver missing".

features.title: We now import more information when updating status on payments.
features.summary: We now import more information when updating status on payments. Various status codes from the bank are imported along with the message attached to them. Can be seen in the Payments Overview. If we know the status code that is returned we will fetch the description of the code from our internal table.

features.title: It is now possible to override the automatic creation of balance entries and instead the user can choose how balance entries are to be created.
features.summary: It is now possible to override the automatic creation of balance entries and instead the user can choose how balance entries are to be created. Basically you can choose between: Per line and Per day.

features.title: When import inpayments you can now choose which date is to be used in the journal.
features.summary: When import inpayments you can now choose which date is to be used in the journal. Cash Receipt date or Posting Date.

features.title: Instead of the user having to chose whether to import "Inpayments from a file" or "Import CREMUL" the system will now determine what type of file is i
features.summary: Instead of the user having to chose whether to import "Inpayments from a file" or "Import CREMUL" the system will now determine what type of file is imported and whether it is via a file on disk or direct communication with the bank.

features.title: If a bank account has the same currency code entered as the LCY code we will force the Bank Account Currency Code onto the Cash Receipts Journal line
features.summary: If a bank account has the same currency code entered as the LCY code we will force the Bank Account Currency Code onto the Cash Receipts Journal line to ensure the line can still be posted. This is NOT the recommended way to use currency codes in business central. We have made this change to support the few customers that still do this even though it is not the way to use currency codes in Business Central.

features.title: PM will now store Danske Bank certificates in the database to ensure compatibility with Collection Management.
features.summary: PM will now store Danske Bank certificates in the database to ensure compatibility with Collection Management. The certificate will be automatically converted the first time it is used and no action is needed from the user. If the certificate is from Danske Bank, please read more information in the upgrade article Upgrade to Continia Payment Management version 4.00 .

features.title: Fields that relate to the old Danske Bank API has been hidden from the user interface.
features.summary: Fields that relate to the old Danske Bank API has been hidden from the user interface. They still exist in the background for those few customers that still use it.

features.title: Renewal of Nordea Certificates failed as they were never saved.
features.summary: Renewal of Nordea Certificates failed as they were never saved. This has been corrected.

features.title: On the account statement line new fields called "Cust.
features.summary: On the account statement line new fields called "Cust. Document Type" and "Cust. Document no." have been added. Here you can enter a document type and no. When this is done the system will check to see if the document is open. If it is open we create a line in the cash receipt journal of type Payment that will apply to the entered document no. and have the bank account as balance account. After posting of the line the system will then be able to automatically reconcile the new bank ledger entry.

features.title: Added the possibility to change the file name used for Handelsbanken.
features.summary: Added the possibility to change the file name used for Handelsbanken. This should only be changed if the bank expects a different file name. If left blank, the default name from the bank system card will be used.

features.summary: Introduced an additional validation for Approval Administrators , requiring them to delegate approval requests before approving on behalf of others. This helps prevent unintended approvals.

features.title: Multi create Time Schedule Calendar

features.title: Registration add-on / Registreringstillæg - Time Counter and Specify per Stamp Journal Line
features.summary: In version 01.18 a new feature were introduced on Registration add-on (Registreringstillæg) where setting up a Time Counter, would lead to inserting an extra line in Calculated Lines (Beregnede linier) during Time Calculation (Beregning). These new Calculated Lines where missing reference to the associated Stamp Journal Line (journalstempling). This has been corrected an therefore "Specify per Stamp Journal Line" in Agreement Setup Formula (Overenskomstsopsætningsformel) works for these Time Cou

features.title: Production Output skip Applies-to Entry for non Item Tracking
features.summary: The field "Applies-to Entry" (Udlign.postløbenr.) in "Item Journal Line" (Varekladdelinje) is omitted for items without "Item Tracking Code" (Varesporingskode). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Pay Engine - Skip line
features.summary: The Pay Engine, used for Create Pay Transactions (Generer lønposter) and the new Pre-Pay functionality, has been extended with a "Skip" field. Allowing to disable a line/rule, but still keep the setup. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Calculation - new Pre-Pay engine
features.summary: A "Pre-Pay" (Pre-lønkørsel) engine is now called at the end of the normal Time Calculation (Beregning). This make i possible to insert "Time Counters" (Tidstælleværker) in "Calculated lines" (Beregnede linier) based on the rules from normal "Create Pay Transactions" (Generer lønposter) engine. Furthermore these lines can be posted to NAV following the normal posting upon Approval (Godkendelse) of Time. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Wait Job direction
features.summary: Time between job registration, also known as "Wait Job", can be eliminated. Now a new parameter controls whether the gab should be set to the Previous or Next job. Default value is Previous, which will behave as before. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: APP: Week Number added to all Date pickers
features.summary: Week Number is now shown whenever an date should be selected. BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: APP: Setup APP fields extended with new fields
features.summary: New fields added to the selectable fields. Both fields both as Hours Minuts and Centi-Hours: Actual Time Consump (Faktisk tidsforbrug) Calculated Time Consump (Kalkuleret tidsforbrug) BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: APP: Open links from Comments
features.summary: Links in NAV/BC is shown in the Comments text. Files can be opened with the magnifying glass icon (as always). Now links to HTTP addresses can be opened with the arrow icon. BC-NAV: APP;#ALL

features.title: APP: Two-factor authentication
features.summary: Two-factor authentication can now be activated in JobManager User Interface. See help on https://documentation.jmgapp.dk for further information. BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: APP: Communication to the NAV/BC server (TLS)
features.summary: The encryption between the APP and the NAV/BC server is now upgraded to TLS 1.2. This solves problems connecting the APP to BC SaaS versions. BC-NAV: APP;#ALL

features.title: Wait Job and Break
features.summary: Time between job registration, also known as "Wait Job", is now taking breaks in consideration. That is breaks is deducted before the checking up against the global "Wait Job" pararameter. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: APP: Hide the lists of jobs from the main menu
features.summary: If "Hide Job List" is activated in JobManager User Interface, the lists of jobs on the main menu is hidden (IPC, Production, Job, Service and Assembly). BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: APP: Assembly details - fixed App Fields settings
features.summary: The page with details about an Assembly job is now fixed. Now showing the selected fields with correct labels from the "ASSEMBLY-DETAILS" in App Fields setup. BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: APP: Time Sheet - Hide Clock-In/-Out
features.summary: The menuitems for Clock-In/-Out is now hidden if "Hide Clock-In/-Out" is set on JobManager User Interface OR "Skip Clock-In & Clock-Out" is set on JobManager Employeee. BC-NAV: APP;#ALL

features.title: APP: Time Sheet - Show description from selected Job
features.summary: A description is now shown below the the Job Id field. Showing the selected Job Id. BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: Time Calculation - Absence in the middle of the day
features.summary: Absence in the middle of the day (between two zones with work on the same day) is now handled better when using Flexible Time Schedules. Now this absence is considered as Work Time, by merging the absence in the flexible scheme. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Custom Signing Functions within the Job List of Registration Cockpit
features.summary: It is now possible to change the filters within the Job List of the Registration Cockpit when using Custom Signing Functions. Now works as it did in the legacy Registration Client (Jobkø). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Serial No. and Lot No. field length

features.title: JobManager Employee - Global Dimension fields

features.title: Report Barcodes Employee Card - Didn't launch in Extension version
features.summary: The report didn't launch correct in the Extension version. This fix was included in patch 1.23.10025.3 BC-NAV: Extension

features.title: Calculation Warning/Errors - Description on Time Counter rules
features.summary: If a custom description is entered (value are colored black instead of gray) this is now actually used when showing the error in Time Calculation and Approval. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Registration Cockpit - FactBox with status from Prod.route

features.title: Time Schedule - Copy Shift from

features.title: Report Barcodes Employee Card - Employee Number length

features.title: Status field in the My Employees page on the Role Center

features.title: Specification of Time and Payment - Exclude Zero-Lines

features.title: Pick Date in eg. Request Scheduled Absence

features.title: Role Center Cue Indicator - Absence Request

features.title: Pay Export with file counter

features.title: Time Sheet (Week) - Load Work Type / Timekladde (uge) - Hent Arbejdstype

features.title: Assisted Setup / Assisteret opsætning

features.title: Make demodata / Opret demodata

features.title: Download Calculation / Beregning

features.summary: Sometimes the End time (Stop tidspunkt) on the last registration exceed Clock-Out time (Gå tidspunkt). This could happen if a long time elapses between entering the employee number and selecting the "Clock-Out" action. This fix was included in the latest 01.21 patch. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Calculation / Beregning - Wait Job and Work Type / Arbejdstype

features.title: Time Calculation / Beregning - Wait Job and Teams

features.title: Employee Time Counter Overview / Medarbejder tidstælleværk oversigt

features.title: Adjust Employee Balance - Job Id / Reguler medarbejder saldi - Job id

features.title: Error in Foundation Setup Guide /Grundlæggende opsætningsguide

features.title: JobManager Role Centers - My Employees (inactive)
features.summary: BC14 (in some newer CU versions) have problems with the My Employee (Mine medarbejdere) part, which where inactive. BC-NAV: BC14

features.title: Create Pay Transactions - Seniority / Generer lønposter - Anciennitet
features.summary: Corrected the seniority (anciennitet) check. It now count from the date it hits the seniority. Previously, it was a day after. Same applies to end of the period, which is corrected by one day. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Sheet (Week) - Work Type / Timekladde (uge) - Arbejdstype
features.summary: Better handling of Work Type (arbejdstype). Now the value can be set on each line. BC-NAV: ALL

features.summary: New events OnXML_JobManWS_JobManStampJournalLin_OnAfterGetRecord OnXML_JobManWS_ItemConsumption_OnAfterGetRecord BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: JobManNavEventPublisher - changed events (developer)
features.summary: Changed events WS_GetJobList has new parameters BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: JobManager User Interface - Posting Description 2
features.summary: The visibility of Posting Description 1 & 2 (Posteringsbeskrivelse 1 & 2) can now be controlled independently. The field "Hide Posting Description 2" added. That applies to both the APP and NAV. BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: APP: Search within list of jobs
features.summary: Search changed on the various lists of jobs. That could be the list Jobs (Sager). Previously, all jobs were transferred to the device. Only then was the search performed. Visible fields were searched. Now the Search Text is sent to NAV to be processed. This increases flexibility as search can now be done in all fields (regardless of visibility). It can even be in related tables. Furthermore this will in most cases lead to better performance. By default the following columns are searched: Job Id

features.title: APP: Length of Posting Description 1 & 2
features.summary: The input length of Posting Description 1 & 2 can now be restricted. The length is set on the JobManager User Interface. Default value is the database length of the NAV fields. The value could be extended, but then code customizations should be made. The input field support floating height. BC-NAV: APP

features.title: APP: Add to Time Sheet from list of jobs
features.summary: Add to Time Sheet (Til kladde) button added on the various lists of jobs. That could be the list Jobs (Sager). It would bring up the dialog to add a new line in the Time Sheet on the chosen job. BC-NAV: APP

features.title: APP: GPS tracking
features.summary: The tracking of GPS has been fixed. Previously, GPS position was only renewed at APP launch. Now it is constantly updated. Some restrictions on Android phones - see "ReadMe_GPS på Android enheder.pdf". BC-NAV: APP

features.title: Time Sheet - Copy from another day (Work Type)
features.summary: Copy from another day now also copies the Work Type. This fix was included in the latest 01.18 patch. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Export Pay Transactions (Lessor 5)
features.summary: Export format for danish payroll system "Lessor 5". That is two different CSV files for respectively payroll and absence. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Stamp Event showing Error Message from Job Queue Entry
features.summary: The Error Message showed from the Job Queue Entry changed to one multi-line field. Due to changes in BC15. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Calculation / Beregning - Skip Clock-In & Clock-Out / Uden Komme & Gå
features.summary: Employees without Clock-In/-Out (uden Komme/Gå) now supports registrations passing midnight. Further bugfix regarding some issues with bundles in above situations. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Sheet (Week) / Timekladde (uge) - Skip Clock-In & Clock-Out / Uden Komme & Gå
features.summary: Time Sheet (Week) (Timekladde (uge)) now support the new parameter on JobManager Employee Skip Clock-In & Clock-Out (Uden Komme & Gå). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Sheet (Week) / Timekladde (uge) - Change sort order
features.summary: Changed the way lines are sorted. Now favorites are listed first. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Pay Events - Specify per Stamp Journal Line
features.summary: New field Specify per Stamp Journal Line (Specificere pr. Journalstempling) on Agreement Setup Formula (Overenskomstsopsætningsformel). whether or not Pay Events (Lønlinier) shoud be specified for each Stamp Journal Line. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: JobManager Job - sum Actual Qty
features.summary: Sum fields Actual Good Qty (Faktisk gode antal) and Actual Scrap Qty (Faktisk kasserede antal) changed. Previously, it sums up records from Stamp Journal Line (journalstemplinger). Now, it sums up records from Stamp Event (stemplingshandlinger), and skips lines with status Skip (Udelad). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Posting to NAV with NAV Job Queue - Priority
features.summary: Some newer versions of NAV/BC doesn't respect the standard Priority field on Job Queue Entries (Opgavekøposter). That could lead to e.g. a production being reported as finished before the reported quantity (leading to a standard NAV error). To get around this standard NAV/BC issue, JobManager now make a minor (under one second) delay on Job Queue Entries (reflectiong the Priority). If the same registration has more pending Stamp Events (stemplingshandlinger) another minute is added. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Sheet / Timekladde - Clock-in/-out time as Timestamp / Tidspunkt
features.summary: Regarding the field Default Clock-in/-out time (Foreslået Komme/Gå tidspunkt) added to JobManager User Interface in 01.16, to control the behavor of time of Clock-in (Komme) and Clock-out (Gå). If selected value is Timestamp (Tidspunkt), this also applies to registrations ahead in time. See online help for further information. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Custom Fields / Tilpassede felter - Modify permission
features.summary: This only applies to JobManager as Extension. Permission Sets created as part of an Extension (e.g. the JobManager Extension) couldn't be choosen as Modify permission on JobManager Custom Fields table. BC-NAV: Extension

features.title: Pay Export in Extension
features.summary: XMLports for Pay Export didn't set default filters and values. This could lead to missing sum peer Pay Type and Rate. Developer: Due to missing OnOpenPage trigger. This is an error in Microsoft Txt2Al.exe, which is part of the building process of Extensions. BC-NAV: Extension

features.title: APP minor performance improvements (developer)

features.title: Disable Notfications on Stamp Warnings/Errors / Stemplingssadvarsler/-fejl

features.title: Missing Period Lines

features.title: Setup blocking transactions based on date

Making it possible to block transactions relative to date for: Time Registration, Time Calculation, Posting to NAV and Create Pay Transactions. Default setup to Time Registration 10 days ahead and prevent Time Calculation for tomorrow and onwards. To protect "master" company during initial implementation all fields could be set to "-10Y" (-10Å). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Employee of type Machine (changed functionality)

Furthermore a bug has bee

features.title: Time Calculation and Approval / Beregning og Godkendelse - Notifications optimized
features.summary: Notifications in page Time Calculation and Approval (Beregning og Godkendelse) has been extended. Counting number of missing Calculation and Approval. And a notification is always shown to prevent flicker in the page. BC-NAV: NAV2017;#NAV2018;#BC13;#BC14

features.title: Rename Time Counter (Tidstælleværk)
features.summary: Now rename the values in Calculated lines (Beregnede linier). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Sheet (Week) / Timekladde (uge) - Minor bugs fixed
features.summary: Minor bugs fixed. Corrected labels for Work Type (Arbejdstype). Regarding header lines: Prevent delete Prevent change fields Job Id and Favorite. Regarding lines with underlying Journal Lines: Prevent delete Prevent change fields Job Id and Favorite. Regarding lines marked as Favorite: Prevent delete Prevent change fields Job Id. This fix was included in the latest 01.17 patch. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Time Schedule Overview / Tidsskemaoversigt
features.summary: New matrix page to show Time Schedule (tidsskema) peer Employee peer day/week/month. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Export Pay Transactions (EG Lønservice)
features.summary: Export format for danish payroll system "EG Lønservice". BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Posting time to Job and Service Line - missing Work Type
features.summary: An error where introduced in 01.17 regarding posting to Job and Service Line. The Work Type were missing when posting. This fix was included in the latest 01.17 patch. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Clock-in too late by selecting job directly
features.summary: When a clocked-out Employee is starting a job, the system will automatic make a Clock-in registration. If selecting Absence is required, the Employee could end up in a situation, where "Cancel" ("Fortryd") were the only option. Now a warning is given when selecting a job, if Absence is required. features.title: Formula expressions - decimal separator

features.summary: The new option in 01.17 on JobManager User Interface to allow the registrationtime to be updated upon every new registrations has been improved. Now the Profile Date is also updated. Fixed handling of selecting Absence. As well as additional required checks and updates. This also applies to the new Registration Cockpit. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: JobManager Role Center Actions Calculation missing and Approvement missing

features.title: Time Sheet (Week) / Timekladde (uge) - FactBoxes

features.title: Time Sheet - Copy from another day (Postingdescriptions)
features.summary: Copy from another day now also copies the Postingdescription1 and 2. BC-NAV: ALL;#APP

features.title: Error Message if JobManager updated and missing data upgrade - extended
features.summary: This check was introduced in 01.17 (see Changelog). Now extended to: Time Sheet (Timekladde) Registration Cockpit (Registrering Cockpit) BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: JobManNavEventPublisher - new events (developer)

features.title: Specification of Time and Payment (E-mail) - Sender address
features.summary: It't now possible to select/change the sender E-mail address when mailing Specification of Time and Payment (Specifikation af tid og lønlinier). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Registration add-on / Registreringstillæg - Time Counter

features.title: Agreement Setup List / Overenskomstsopsætningsliste - renumber

features.title: Time Calculation - Absence in flex zones
features.summary: Bugfix regarding Absence in flex zones. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Registration Client / Job kø - Ref. Type Filter

features.title: Check for dublicate User Name on JobManager Employee
features.summary: Now check to avoid using the same User Name on different JobManager Employees. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Adjust Employee Balance / Reguler medarbejder saldi
features.summary: New worksheet to adjust balance on Time Counter (Tidstælleværker) and Pay Types (Lønarter). Replaces manual adjustments and these auto/multi adjustments: Auto adjust Time Counter (Automatisk regulering af tidstælleværk) Auto Adjust Pay Counter (Automatisk regulering af løntælleværk) Multi adjust Pay Counter (Masse regulering af løntælleværk) The new worksheet is also ideal for importing starting balances for each Employee when start using JobManager. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: APP: Clock-In/-Out with absence (empty list)
features.summary: When absence is required on Clock-In/-Out (Komme/Gå), AND the list of absence is empty. Previously, nothing happened when selecting Clock-In/-Out. Now showing an empty list. BC-NAV: APP

features.title: Calculation Warnings/Errors - invalid formula
features.summary: The following applies to Warnings/Errors of Type "Time Counter (condition)". An invalid formula would result in Time Calculation going into infinite loop. Now a warning is inserted into Stamp Warnings/Errors instead. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Posting to NAV with NAV Job Queue - Lines marked as Skip (Udelad) or OK
features.summary: If JobManager Stamp Events (Stemplingshandlinger) are set to status Skip (Udelad) og OK, any associated Job Queue Entries (Opgavekøposter) afterwards are ignored (just run without doing any thing. Previously, in some cases, the Stamp Event (Stemplingshandling) could be set back to status Error (Fejl) or the Job Queue Entry (Opgavekøpost) could try to re-run forever with the error: Event already posted (Handling er allerede bogført). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: APP: Report Item Consumption - Item pick list
features.summary: Typing search text now search on individual words. Each word would be translated to an "and" search. Items marked as Blocked are hidden when select items for consumption. Can be overridden with custom code. A new parameter "Search No. of Records (maximum)" on JobManager User Interface. If the number of Items matching the search excees this, an empty list is send to the APP (due to performance). BC-NAV: APP

features.title: APP: Phased out OData connections
features.summary: The use of OData (Queries) has been phased out. The APP now solely relies on SOAP. This has lead to better performance, language independence and better options for partners to adjust/filter data sent to the APP. BC-NAV: APP

features.title: Missing Report finish after break signing on Employee of type Machine
features.summary: The following applies to JobManager Employees of type "Machine" and registration from the Registration Clients. After returning from a break registration, all further reportings where suppressed. Both Report Stop-code and Quantity. BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Team phantom Stamp Journal Lines (Journalstemplinger)
features.summary: Pilot registrations are automatically divided for a maximum length of one day. When dividing these lines, new Stamp Journal Lines (Journalstemplinger) are inserted for the Pilot. That lead to inserting additional Stamp Journal Lines (Journalstemplinger) on all active Team members. The divide takes place at first pilot interaction after midnight og when the Pilot are Time Calculated (Beregnet). JobManager where inserting Stamp Journal Lines (Journalstemplinger) for all active Team members in that

features.title: APP: Employee De-activation
features.summary: If the JobManager Employee has been de-activated, the Employee is disconnected from the APP. Previously, the Employee could stay in the app and still browse around. The check is done in the background every 15 minuts. BC-NAV: APP

features.title: APP: Setup APP fields
features.summary: In previous versions the CustomText04 and CustomText05 fields didn't work correct. That has been fixed, and in general more fields has been added. BC-NAV: APP

features.title: APP: Upload photo (indicator)

features.title: APP: New PDF viewer for associated PDF files

features.title: APP: Time Sheet Clock-In/-Out / Timekladde Komme/Gå
features.summary: The JobManager APP has now adopted the NAV JobManager Time Sheet (Timekladde) functionality from 01.16, that JobManager User Interface can control the behavor of time of Clock-in (Komme) and Clock-out (Gå). features.title: APP: Questionnaire module / Spørgeskemamodul

Furthermore when Pilot closed the Job Id all occurrence where closed, Now only one occurrence for each assistant (medhjælp). BC-NAV: ALL

features.title: Color marking on jobs already started

features.title: Item Consumption from Service Item Lines

features.title: Time Sheet / Timekladde - Clock-out time prior to Clock-in

This initial release is intended for controlled production validation and is not yet recommended for general activation. If you are interested in using this functionality, please contact

features.title: Filter by File Extension
features.summary: The global search now supports filtering by an exact file extension. This allows you to search specifically for file types such as _.pdf_ or _.doc_, avoiding partial matches and ensuring more accurate search results.

features.title: HEIC Thumbnail Generation
features.summary: Thumbnail generation is now supported for images stored in the _.heic_ file format, providing a consistent preview experience across a wider range of image types.

features.title: User-Level Permissions for MCP Server Access
features.summary: Access to the MCP Server can now be controlled at the user level through dedicated permissions. Previously, enabling the MCP Server feature for a tenant automatically granted access to all users within that tenant. With this enhancement, administrators can define which users are allowed to use MCP functionality while continuing to manage the feature globally through the existing feature flag. Notes: Administrators retain full access to the MCP Server and do not require the dedicated MCP permissi

features.title: Rework UBL Attachments integration
features.summary: The UBL Viewer can display attachments associated with the selected document. We have redesigned the attachments area so that attachments now use the full available space within the UBL Viewer, providing a more consistent viewing experience that aligns with the mail viewer.

features.title: MCP Server

features.title: Document Viewer Annotation Controls
features.summary: The document viewer has been enhanced with a new control to show or hide annotations. This allows users to quickly toggle annotation visibility, making it easier to view underlying content that may be obscured and improving overall readability during document review.

features.title: Outlook Drag & Drop from Conversation View
features.summary: Drag-and-drop from Outlook to Raptor has been enhanced to fully support emails within conversation view. Users can now seamlessly drag and drop emails regardless of whether they are working with individual messages or grouped conversations. This improvement provides a more consistent and streamlined experience when managing emails in Outlook.

features.title: Infrastructure updates

Additionally, the UI will display a document count in the Advanced Search and Taxonomy.

features.title: Display additional line info in UBL viewer

Extra header fields that will be displayed when they are present in the UBL file: Buyer Reference Despatch Document Reference Receipt Document Reference Originator Document Reference Invoice Period Corrected label for currency (previously labeled as _contract_). Extra line-level detail: If there are discounts or charges at line level, they will also be rendered on the line.

After dismissing the warning, Raptor behaves as before, showing all documents to which the user has access. In case an "administrator" opens Rap

features.summary: Previously when a SharePoint sync was configured to Raptor, all drives (/document collections,...) would be synced to raptor. Now you can choose to specify specific drives that should be synced. This should make Power Automate flows for customers that do not want all document collections to be synced a lot simpler, as before they could not use the standard sync that was available in Raptor and had to replicate a lot of the logic in a custom flow. features.title: Update backend dependencies
features.summary: This update is not expected to have any functional impact. Its purpose is to keep the platform and dependencies up to date.

features.title: Support for new image formats: .webp & .avif
features.summary: Our viewer now also supports the .webp and .avif image format.

features.title: Modified kickstart for D365-FO: Added return order entity

features.title: UBL viewer for e-invoices
features.summary: Added a visual “invoice overlay” for Peppol invoices and credit notes. When you save a Peppol XML, Raptor detects it automatically and shows a button to open the visual view. The view displays key information such as: Header details (invoice date, order reference, delivery date) Buyer and seller Payment terms and details Notes Invoice lines Attachments The overlay shows relevant information, though not every XML field. Raptor remembers the overlay’s visibility when you navigate between invoices.

features.title: Empty viewer when no document is selected
features.summary: When no document is selected and the viewer is detached, the last opened document stayed visible. The viewer now shows “No document selected” instead to prevent confusion about which record is active.

features.title: Power Automate – new URLs and subscription updates
features.summary: Microsoft is replacing the URLs used to trigger Power Automate flows with HTTP triggers and will disable the old ones by the end of November. Event Grid flows also require manual confirmation under the new security rules. We implemented a workaround and will migrate all existing subscriptions to prevent disruption when Microsoft disables the old endpoints.

features.title: Improved UBL Viewer
features.summary: The previous release included an early preview of the new UBL viewer. Added VAT summary lines in the header for each tax bracket (e.g., 21%, 6%, Exempt). Added a popup showing detailed information for each tax bracket. Adjusted when totals for allowances and charges are displayed. Added translations for field names and descriptions for various XML codes. Made the UI more

features.title: New field types for timestamps and durations
features.summary: 2 new field types have been added. One for timestamps, and one for durations. A duration (time span) can be used to store intervals, or the "time of day". A timestamp can be used to store an exact moment in time (unlike the already existing date field that did not have time of day or time zone information) The timestamp will use the browsers time zone information to automatically show the time in the users time zone. And the users language will be used to render dates and times in culture specif

features.title: Job Logs
features.summary: In the configuration page each job now has an extra log block that contains logs for that job. The 50 most recent job invocations (limited to 1 week) can be viewed. The UI will indicate how many warnings or errors were logged related to the job invocation. In addition, the "Kofax Document Export" jobs can show a list of 50 most recent messages (from the last 7 days) that were send via E-Platform. You can see the individual calls made to FO with the body of the request and response messages.

A "cube" is added on which the user can click to move the camera to a specific view (top, left, right, ...) features.title: As a key user you can now create advanced queries where you can select multiple tags in one expression.
features.summary: As a key user you are now able to create advanced queries where you can create a single expression containing multiple tags and decide if one, all or none of the containing tags should be set as a criteria. This feature significantly reduces the number of expressions you need to add in a advanced query to result to the same query result.

In the viewer itself the end-user will now see the text "no viewer available (unsupported file format)" and a button to download the zip instead of the error message.

features.title: "Move document 2 SPO" endpoint

This enpoint allows smooth & optimized upload of documents from Raptor towards SharePoint Online without the Raptor synchronisation automatically recreation the document in Raptor after upload to SharePoint Online.

features.summary: Reworked D365 Finance & Operations Input management documentation

features.summary: While drag & drop from an email from the new Outlook client towards the 9A Raptor Document Warehouse was already possible, you are now also able to do drag & drop an email attachments directly from he new Outlook client to 9A Raptor Document Warehouse.

features.title: Allow end users to sort on date/numeric/text fields in the document list.
features.summary: As an administrator, you able to activate sorting on multiple fields of the field type: Date, Numeric & Text As an end user, you can then sort on those fields in the document list. Up to 3 fields can be activated for sorting in the document list.

features.title: Option to download files "inline"
features.summary: Provided a new query parameter in the endpoint GET /api/meta/document/{id}/content to indicate that you wish a response with the header 'Content-Disposition: inline'.

features.title: CoPilot features in Item Configuration
features.summary: To help and ease the creation of Attributes on Items and on Configuration Templates, we have released features to create these with assistance from CoPilot. In Item Attributes it is now possible to choose CoPilot assisted creation to create Item Attributes and the needed values within. In the Configuration Template it is now also possible to create attributes for the Configuration using CoPilot assistance. These features will support the user in creating the needed data much faster than before -

features.title: Price calculation - major refactor for alignment and performance
features.summary: The entire pricing part of the app has been rewritten to handle the existing 3 types (already public) in a aligned and unified way. Especially the price method called Configuration has undergone some modernization to align better with the overall calculation principle. The rewrite had also the focus to optimize performance for the customers with large data volume. Based on the newer structure of Configuration hierarchy we have ensured the correct calculation actions bottom up also for the price

features.title: Rules within rules - extended and flexible support
features.summary: Due to the limitations in use of rules on templates for combinations in AND/OR we have seen some limitations in customer installations. We extended the engine for Rules so we opened for having rulesets within rulesets and have removed the limitations with multi levels and combinations.

features.title: Copy sales documents or lines with configurations now also clone entire configuration
features.summary: Working with the Sales Quotes or Sales Orders the user often copy a document or sales line and works within the copy with the changes that are relevant. When copying orders or lines we now create a entire new configuration for the new line/lines which enables the user in an easy way to do more lines in one Quote that are look alikes or to copy an old quote into a new one and work on it - all in a very smooth way.

features.title: Create new configuration based on Production Order data

Copying the BOM and Routings to a new configuration card enabling the user to work on this as a base instead of from standard production BOMs. The feature is available from the configuration List.

features.summary: In some cases values not in use were not blanked when selsctions was made and this could potentially end up showing some parts of the configuration that was not intended.

If the Order Date on the sales quote or Sales Order is changes the configurration can be recalculated based on the pricing from the new sales prices calculcation date. features.title: Project Copy - pre-view status ended

This feature have the ability to create a new Project and create Project Planning Lines on the basis of a document like Sales Quote or other ongoing Projects with the visibility of selecting the needed structure and data.

This feature enables Project Controlling on a higher level and supports the transparency of the constant evolvement of budgets and supports Project Controlling with both analyzing and ask/answer features. Budget entries evolves in many iterations often over many financial periods and this feature enables the Project Controller to have more i

features.title: Rework queue due to large message content
features.summary: A new form for both log and queue is created where the payload is not displayed directly (a button needs to be pressed to load the message content): Because of this the queue and log table will open much faster.

features.title: Improve app insights logging
features.summary: The application insights logs have been improved with additional values.

features.title: Make the left side of the processor and connector form dynamic
features.summary: The form for connectors and processors have been changed so the overview list is more insightful and can be changed dynamically in shape.

features.title: Add send to smart connect button to each record that is linked to a business process
features.summary: Added a Send to Smart Connect action on supported posted sales invoice, packing slip, and project invoice forms. Setup and use: configure and activate an event processor for the relevant Smart Connect business process; users can then select one or more posted records and choose Send to Smart Connect to create or recreate the event for asynchronous processing. Multi-select is supported, so failed or missed documents can be retriggered without reposting them.

features.title: Add Multi-threading functionality to batch processing
features.summary: Added multithreaded execution for Smart Connect batch processing so eligible processor workloads can run concurrently instead of being handled serially. Setup and use: schedule Run processors as a batch task and configure the participating processors for the multithreaded execution pattern used by the environment. This is intended for independent workloads; processor grouping, order, and run-separately settings should still be used where processing dependencies must be preserved.

features.title: Use Events to trigger ER
features.summary: Added event-driven Electronic Reporting generation. Setup and use: create an outbound event processor, select the Generate Electronic Report data handler, choose the connector and Smart Connect business process, and set the ER format mapping in the processor variables; activate the processor and schedule event processing. The event supplies the source table and record, Smart Connect runs the selected ER format in memory, and the generated document is sent through the configured connector.

features.title: Use placeholders for dynamic values
features.summary: Added reusable placeholders for dynamic connector and processor values. Setup and use: open the Placeholders page under 9A Smart Connect, Setup; define a placeholder name, select the Queue field that supplies its input, configure the regular expression transformation, and use the test action to verify the result. Reference the placeholder in supported settings such as a Raptor field value. If no dynamic value is configured for the Attachment connector, its existing queue ID behavior remains avai

features.title: Check tables setup
features.summary: Reviewed and corrected Smart Connect table properties across the model to align table setup and metadata with the framework conventions. No functional setup or user action is required after deployment. The change improves the technical consistency of the underlying NAN tables used by connectors, processors, queues, and related configuration.

features.title: HandlerId logging
features.summary: Smart Connect logs now store the handler ID that actually processed each record. No setup change is required; open 9A Smart Connect Logs or the log details from a Queue record to see the recorded handler. New log records remain historically accurate if the processor is later changed to use another handler, while older records without a stored handler continue to show the processor handler as a fallback.

features.title: Clean Connector field visibility
features.summary: Simplified the Connectors form so choosing a connector type shows only the fields and field groups relevant to that connector. Setup and use: create or edit the connector, select its Type first, and then complete the displayed authentication, endpoint, certificate, or storage fields; API, SharePoint, and AS2 options are now separated more clearly. Credential and connection-string values can no longer be exposed through table browsing or personalization, and Key Vault lookup controls appear only

features.title: Enable credential encryption by default
features.summary: Credential encryption is now enabled by default when Smart Connect is initialized for a new legal entity. Setup and use: review Encrypt credentials in 9A Smart Connect Parameters before entering connector passwords, client secrets, or connection strings; when enabled, these values are encrypted at rest and existing connector credentials are converted when the setting is switched on. Use either credential encryption or Azure Key Vault, not both; Key Vault remains the recommended production option

features.title: Make it possible to "Extend" API URL from a processor
features.summary: API connectors can now use processor-specific URL extensions, allowing one base connection and authentication setup to serve several API operations. Setup and use: enter the common base Resource URL on the API connector and enable its API URL extension option; each linked inbound or outbound processor then receives a variable for its relative endpoint, such as a download or upload path. Periodic transfer processors can configure separate extensions for the inbound and outbound connector legs.

features.title: Add API Key to connector
features.summary: Added first-class API key authentication to the API connector. Setup and use: select the API connector and API key authentication, then enter the key in the protected credential field; Smart Connect sends it automatically in the x-api-key request header. Existing integrations that already add x-api-key through Custom headers remain unchanged until the dedicated key field is populated, after which the duplicate custom header should be removed.

features.title: Add form-data file stream content to API connector
features.summary: Added multipart form-data file-stream support to the API connector. Setup and use: on the API connector select Form-data file stream as the Content type and link it to a processor whose handler produces a file stream. Smart Connect creates the multipart request and sends the generated file as form-data, so integrations no longer need custom code to upload documents to endpoints that expect this format.

features.title: Create a new handler to orchestrate the inbound MySupply messages
features.summary: Added a MySupply inbound orchestration handler that retrieves, classifies, queues, and confirms all documents delivered through the shared MySupply queue. Setup and use: create the MySupply In, MySupply Out, and MySupply Confirm API connectors; create an inbound Periodic transfer processor using the MySupply distributor handler; then fill its processor variables for e-invoice, status update, archive, and download-confirmation processors. Schedule the orchestrator in batch. It fetches until the e

features.title: Extend business process for e-invoice
features.summary: Extended the Invoice creation business process so one event processor can distinguish sales invoices, sales credit notes, free-text invoices, free-text credit notes, project invoices, and project credit notes. Setup and use: select Invoice creation on the processor, enable Invoice type selection, and choose the document types that processor should handle; activate the processor and run event processing in batch. Leaving Invoice type selection disabled preserves the previous sales invoice and sal

features.title: BusinessDocumentSubmission for payment message
features.summary: Added support for registering sent sales and project invoices or credit notes as completed Business Document Submissions, allowing later payment or status messages to find the original document. Current setup and use: configure the outbound invoice event processor with the Generate Electronic Report and submit electronic document handler, select its ER format mapping and connector, enable the queue, and activate the processor. The handler generates and sends the ER document and creates the submi

features.title: BusinessDocumentApplicationResponse as businessProcess
features.summary: Added Business Document Application Response as a Smart Connect business process for outgoing status messages. Setup and use: create an outbound event processor for this business process, select the ER handler and format mapping, configure its connector, enable the queue, and activate the processor; schedule event processing as usual. Creating or updating an application response with a Response processing code creates the event, while clearing the response does not.

features.title: Update labels
features.summary: Updated Smart Connect user-interface labels, including Dutch translations, to make configuration and processing terminology clearer and more consistent. No setup or migration is required. The translated captions are shown automatically according to the user's Dynamics 365 language.

features.title: Event cannot be manually processed after error
features.summary: Fixed manual processing of an event after an earlier error. No setup change is required: after correcting the underlying configuration or data, open the Smart Connect Events inquiry, select the failed event, and use Process to retry it manually. Manual processing is no longer blocked by the automatic retry state, while scheduled retry rules continue to apply to unattended processing.

features.title: Invoice event can only be triggered after print management is finished
features.summary: Added a configurable Minimum event processing delay for outbound event processors. Setup and use: open the event processor and enter the required delay interval; leave it at zero to preserve the previous immediate behavior, then run event processing through the normal batch schedule. The delay gives print management, document generation, or asynchronous Raptor indexing time to finish before Smart Connect creates and sends the e-invoice, and affects outbound events only.

features.title: Extend queue form list
features.summary: Extended the contextual Queue action to the invoice journal and project invoice journal forms. Setup and use: no separate form configuration is required; when Smart Connect queue records exist for a supported posted invoice, select the document and open the Queue action to review its processing records, status, payload, logs, or retry options. Project invoices use dedicated record-link logic, so the action opens the queue entries belonging to the selected project invoice.

features.title: When no filename is linked to the embedded documents in an UBL - add a default name
features.summary: A default name is used for embedded pdf of an e-invoice when no name is provided in the UBL.

features.title: Event + queue flow changes
features.summary: It is now possible to use event based triggers in combination with queue for all handlers.

features.title: Fileshare should import based on added timestamp instead of alphabetic
features.summary: It is now possible to setup in what order the files in a fileshare should be uploaded (alphabetic on name, on creation date or on modify date).

features.title: Add clean up job to only remove payload
features.summary: An option was added to remove only the payload from the logs and queues, this keeps the log record but makes the form faster. This can be used if the content is not needed but you would like the queue record to be there.

features.title: Make on prem label integration work for container labels
features.summary: Container labels can now be processed through smart connect aswel. Setup is identitcal as the setup of the normal label integration.

features.title: Better job description on running batch job
features.summary: A better default job discription has been added when a processor batch job is started.

features.title: Extend clean up job functionalities
features.summary: Extra functionality have been added to the clean up jobs. You can now specify the job per processor.

features.title: Create a new handler to trigger API functions
features.summary: A new handler has been created, this handler can be used to trigger API functions by added fixed body values. This can be usefull if you are creating an integration using API functions.

features.title: Use deferred status for DMF processing status follow up
features.summary: A new function has been added so that the status of retrieving the file and processing the DMF import project is separated. This can be enabled from the processor with parameter Import two stage status on the processor linked to a DMF import handler. An extra column should be added to the queue, this column is named Execution summary status, this status reflects the DMF import status. The status is also updated when the DMF project status changes by fixing the upload manually from within the DMF

features.title: Move vat/reg number search from general to einvoice settings
features.summary: This fields is moved to einvoice settings tab

features.title: Improved vendor look up
features.summary: An improved vendor look up has been added to the inbound e invoice handler. Now we first look at the peppol ID (as this is mandatory). If the scheme equals 0088, we do a look up based on GLN field on the address (on registration number tab) (smart connect field) If another scheme is there, we will look to the registration numbers stripped and not stripped from the country code If no vendor found, we will apply the logic that we have today, so searching the vendor based on the company ID If no ve

features.title: Encrypt connector passwords
features.summary: It is now possible to encrypt the passwords. This is now enabled using a paramter, this parameter will be removed in some versions and encrypting will become mandatory

features.title: Create new api connector - auth type Bearer token
features.summary: A new type of api connection has been added: Fixed bearer token

features.title: Replace illegal char in filename before saving document for einvoicing
features.summary: If illegal characters are in the path of a file (e.g. / or \) these will be replace, like that we don't get unwanted folder structures

features.title: Add wait before retry time functionality
features.summary: A new functionality has been introduced: It is now possible to specify a time after which a retry should be performmed. (this only works when using the queue)

features.title: Increase performance of the queue form
features.summary: The performance of the queue has been improved.

features.title: Make the Forms queue handler extensible
features.summary: The Forms queue handler has now been made more extensible.

features.title: Add option to overwrite existing files (for integrations)
features.summary: It is now possible to overwrite already existing files, this could be useful for integrations with full push exports.

features.title: Add Connector of type FO Attachment (for periodic - transfer processors only)
features.summary: A new connector has been developed to archive files to the FO attachments. For now this is only working with the processors of type periodic transfer, in the future this will work with all processor out processors.

features.title: Add Skip queue execution parameter to processor
features.summary: A skip queue execution parameter has been added for testing purposes.

features.title: Keep parameter setup when changing values on processor
features.summary: When changing values on the processor, the setup will be kept the same (it will not be removed as before).

features.title: Create new connecter type User interface for testing
features.summary: A new connector named User interface has been created, this can be used for testing. When using the connector, this generated outbound file will be downloaded to your local machine.

features.title: Make it possible to send the queue id in an API request (Deferred response)
features.summary: It is now possible to add the queueId as an outbound parameter when sending data API based: e.g. https://xxxx/rest/9asmart-test/message ?queueId=xxxxxx This has to be enabled on the connector

features.title: Add option for successor processor
features.summary: It is now possible to use successor processors, here the same message content will be used making it possible to run multiple processors with the same message content.

features.title: Make it possible to query based on file name (inbound processor)
features.summary: It is now possible to filter based on filename and extension to select the inbound files, to use this a parameter in the smart connect parameters should be enabled

features.title: Deferred Response status: Add to api message + add a column in the Queue with the status + create Business event when deferred status = Error
features.summary: We now have an extra deferred status in the queue, this is used for async follow up in the queue. To get the status in the queue the following endpoint should be used: {{resource}}/api/services/NANProcessServiceGroup/NANProcessInService/setQueueResponse With the following body: { "request" : { "Company": "DataAreaId", "QueueId": "The ID of the queue in smart connect", "PayLoad" : "Additional message to add", "ResponseResult" : "Processed or Error" } } We also have a business event linked to the

features.title: Add Tungsten masterdata sync job to Smart Connect
features.summary: We now have two handlers to sync data from FO to Tungsten: NANHandlerOutTungstenVendorBanks -> Vendor Bank details NANHandlerOutTungstenVendors -> Vendors

features.title: VatNum/TaxRegistration search function amended
features.summary: Extra functionality has been added to make the vendor search faster and better. Now VAT numbers without country codes will also be found.

features.title: Make E-Invoice Transfer option so both e-invoice as pdf are archived NO Raptor DWH
features.summary: An extra type of period transfer has been added "einvoice", next to tranfering the file, this will look for an embedded pdf(s), transform them and archive them in the "to" connector.

features.title: Create smart connect attributes to avoid hard coded values in EDI messages
features.summary: A new table has been added where you can store attributes that are used in custom handlers. By using this, no hard coded values should be added. This can be handy for emails, company information, etc. Next to that, an ER method has been created so you can also use these values in ER.

features.title: Handler to add header to files before importing
features.summary: A new handler has been created to add a header to a csv like file before importing it into DMF. name: NANHandlerInDmfNoHeader

features.title: OAuth Azure Apps/Functions requires separate scope than URL
features.summary: The new scope URL has been added

features.title: Make classes Public
features.summary: All classes have been made public, this makes it easier to reuse smart connect building block for custom integrations

features.title: Sharepoint as a connector
features.summary: A new type of connector has been developed - Sharepoint. This makes it possible to directly use files from sharepoint for import or export to sharepoint.

features.title: Remove e-invoice validation warnings
features.summary: A new parameter has been added in the smart connect parameters, when this one is enabled, the validation warnings will not be shown on booking the einvoice.

features.title: Add OAuth type - Password Grant with custom headers
features.summary: It is now possible to add custom api headers to your api call. Also the OAuth type - password grant using sys url encoded content type will allow you to specify both client id/secret as password/username.

features.title: Make it possible to store the connector response in the queue (Direct response)
features.summary: Make it possible to store the connector response in the queue (Direct response)

features.title: Make it possible to link a response message from a middleware to the outbound message in the queue
features.summary: Make it possible to link a response message from a middleware to the outbound message in the queue

features.title: Create a handler that moves files from one connector to another
features.summary: A handler is created to move files from one connector to another, this can be convenient if you want to follow up the status of imported files on a local place rather than on the connectors destination. Example: DMF import is used to get a CSV file from an SFTP server (from a client) and import it in FO OOTB - Fail and Success directory on the SFTP server (so on the client side) Often this is unwanted behaviour, the follow up of success/fail is needed on the companies side (e.g. Azure fileshare)

features.title: Extended logging per process
features.summary: For the projects where the queue is not used, the possibility to have extended logging has been added.

features.title: Queue inbound file upload manually
features.summary: For testing purposes, a functionality has been added to manually upload files into the queue to be processed. This functionality should be enabled in the smart connect general settings.

features.title: Add Skip additional fetch for periodic processor (API based)
features.summary: A parameter has been added to skip the additional fetch (GET method) when using the periodically process method combined with an API based connector. This should be enabled when other systems are pushing records in the queue.

features.title: Connecter Reference from Handler
features.summary: Connecter Reference from Handler

features.title: Add table name and record identification to the event records
features.summary: It is now possible to see the table name and some record info in the event table.

features.title: Make it possible to 'export' electronic report on trigger by event record
features.summary: We added a function to export an ER on event trigger, however if not needed we do not recommend to use this as MS is shutting down the access to the ER triggers.

features.title: Make it possible to specify the wanted HTTP method on the processor
features.summary: It is now possible to add an event type triggering different API methods on processing of the event to an API Connector: Insert - POST Update - PUT Delete - DELETE None (empty) - POST

features.title: Telemetry add more to other locations
features.summary: It is now possible to activate the telemetry per processor (by activating the parameter in he processor setup)

features.title: Copy the error log from DMF export to the smart connect log (and queue)
features.summary: It is now possible to see the error log from DMF in the smart connect queue. The link to the DMF project is also added as a hyper link.

features.title: Move retries to processes
features.summary: In the previous version the amount of retries was specified in the general parameters, meaning it was for all processors or for none. As the setup of retries will be in most of the cases processor specific this field is is changed to the processor.

features.title: Make it possible to add a path for a fileshare to each label layout
features.summary: It is now possible to add an extension of the base path for each label, this can be done on the label layout form.

features.title: Link smart connect created records in FO with the message id in the queue for follow up purposes
features.summary: By adding the form on the processor, it is now possible to see from that form what queue record created the record in the form. Example: A handler creates a sales order (EDI message), on the processor the salestable form is specified. When opening the sales table and navigating to the created sales order, there will be the option under the 9A smart connect Tab to view the queue record that was associated with this sales order. (like this it will be easier to find error if they would occur).

features.title: Add if not exist, create - parameter to connecter
features.summary: A parameter on the connector was added to activate the functionality: if Update (PUT) doesn't work (because the record doesn't exists) create (POST) the record through the API connection.

features.title: Add more dedicated security privileges
features.summary: Some more dedicated security roles and privileges were added.

features.title: OAuth Token Cache
features.summary: The option to cache the OAuth Token was added, the Token will only be renewed upon expiration.

features.title: Add the GLN number to the address
features.summary: It is now possible to add a GLN number to the addresses, this can be used for EDI integrations. This fields is also included in the following data entities: Vendors V2 Customers V2 Customers V3 Global address book V2 Party postal address V2

features.title: Add Telemetry to smart connect
features.summary: Telemetry has been added for the smart connect module.

features.title: Add a privilege to send smart connect messages into the queue
features.summary: A privilege has been added to sending messages in the queue (inbound messages) using the following url: resource/api/services/NANProcessServiceGroup/NANProcessInService/setQueue. This means that from now on you can easily only assign this privilege to the users linked to the entra ID shared with the sender of these messages (as processing of them is done in batch by a different user - often an admin user). Working like this increases the safety of the integrations. The privilege is named Process

features.title: Add data entities for smart connect (Connectors and Processors)
features.summary: Data entities are added to export and import smart connect configurations, the following ones are included: 9A Smart Connect - connecters 9A Smart Connect - processor groups 9A Smart Connect - processor variables 9A Smart Connect - processors 9A Smart Connect - queue

features.title: Create data entity to export/import process configurations
features.summary: A data entity has been added to easily export/import process configurations (the link between customer (group)/ vendor (group) en the processors when using business processes)

features.title: Create a clean up job to automatically delete records in the queue after a specified time range
features.summary: A clean up job is added to clear the queue for records older than the specified time.

features.title: DMF import upgrade
features.summary: If a file is imported but not processed to staging, then the DMF import hangs waiting for a status change. This working has changed now

features.title: Updated logging levels
features.summary: Logging is now included on no content and if the data handler indicated a NoGo, previously this was not included.

features.title: Queue UI and UE upgrades
features.summary: The standard view has been changed to display more relevant data.

features.title: Add printer specific text to outgoing labels
features.summary: Add printer specific text to outgoing labels

features.title: Add API authorisation type to include audience
features.summary: It is now possible to use an API connection that requires audience for authorisation.

features.title: Upgrade Queue UI en UE
features.summary: The queue UI and UE got an upgrade including: Standard queue lay out Multi select cancel option More filter functionality Better logging layout

features.title: Add more flexibility to the outbound configuration
features.summary: There is added more flexibility to the outbound configuration: On the processor it is now possible to select a business process, that business process is a trigger to place a record in the event table when certain conditions are met. The event contains the record id and the table id of the created record, that reference can be used by the handler on the processor to create an export message. For now 4 business processes are added: Sales order confirmation (custConfirmJourTable) Packing slip crea

features.title: Add external service smart connect option for label printing (e.g. BarTender integration)
features.summary: The standard external service instance has been extended with a processor field. This makes it possible to send labels (custom labels, document routing labels, wave labels) to a connector (e.g. Fileshare, Blob, Container, ... ). This makes it possible to send labels to on premise label processors (e.g. bartender). Needed setup: Create a processor that will process the labels Use the NANHandlerOutDR handler Fill in the variable information on the processor that is linked to the selected connector
