hotfixes.title: Previously, if you entered a Preferred Bank Account Code on a vendor or customer card, it was impossible to remove it without encountering an error.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, if you entered a Preferred Bank Account Code on a vendor or customer card, it was impossible to remove it without encountering an error. This issue has been resolved, allowing you to clear the Preferred Bank Account Code without receiving the Bank Account does not exist error.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where payments with a manual payment method were incorrectly included when exporting or sending payments to the bank.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where payments with a manual payment method were incorrectly included when exporting or sending payments to the bank.

hotfixes.title: Ensured that the mandate ID always matches the related bank account.
hotfixes.summary: Ensured that the mandate ID always matches the related bank account. Selecting a mismatched mandate will now trigger an error in Direct Debit Journal, Advanced Mode Payment Suggestion, Customer Ledger Entry, and Sales Invoice.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where remittance sending was not correctly executed when using the job queue.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where remittance sending was not correctly executed when using the job queue.

hotfixes.title: Ensured that alternative information fields for vendors/customers are always used together.
hotfixes.summary: Ensured that alternative information fields for vendors/customers are always used together. If alternative information is set up, only those fields are used, and original fields are ignored.

hotfixes.title: Fixed a validation error in the Create Payment action on the vendor ledger entries page, which previously caused a Bank Account No.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed a validation error in the Create Payment action on the vendor ledger entries page, which previously caused a Bank Account No. not found issue.

hotfixes.title: Added support for 731 validation for payment references exceeding 19 characters.
hotfixes.summary: Added support for 731 validation for payment references exceeding 19 characters.

hotfixes.title: The standard action for regulatory reporting codes in the Norwegian version is now hidden when using a banking export journal.
hotfixes.summary: The standard action for regulatory reporting codes in the Norwegian version is now hidden when using a banking export journal.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue with the Credit/Debit indicator in Payment Status Entry.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue with the Credit/Debit indicator in Payment Status Entry.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue in advanced mode where remittance information could not be added to payments.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue in advanced mode where remittance information could not be added to payments. A new action is now available on Payment Suggestion Lines to access remittance information when payments are not summarized. If payments are summarized, the action should be used on the Payment Suggestion Header instead.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where running the Security Setup only displayed one Payment Journal Batch instead of all available batches.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where running the Security Setup only displayed one Payment Journal Batch instead of all available batches.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where Banking Import fields and actions were not displayed after Business Central logged out due to inactivity.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where Banking Import fields and actions were not displayed after Business Central logged out due to inactivity. They are now properly restored after re-login.

hotfixes.title: Bank Account Reconciliation Lines are now updated accordingly when a search rule is deleted.
hotfixes.summary: Bank Account Reconciliation Lines are now updated accordingly when a search rule is deleted.

hotfixes.title: You can now include an FIK payment reference on customer statements.
hotfixes.summary: You can now include an FIK payment reference on customer statements. When customers pay using the reference, matching automatically proposes all statement entries.

hotfixes.title: The Customer Statement now includes an FIK payment reference covering all open entries in the statement period.
hotfixes.summary: The Customer Statement now includes an FIK payment reference covering all open entries in the statement period.

hotfixes.title: Previewing the Customer Statement report no longer generates payment references.
hotfixes.summary: Previewing the Customer Statement report no longer generates payment references.

hotfixes.title: You can now add an FIK payment reference to the Customer Statement report for automatic matching.
hotfixes.summary: You can now add an FIK payment reference to the Customer Statement report for automatic matching.

hotfixes.title: Internal test reliability improvements with no user-facing impact.
hotfixes.summary: Internal test reliability improvements with no user-facing impact.

hotfixes.title: You can now add a payment reference to the Customer Statement report to support automatic matching of statement entries.
hotfixes.summary: You can now add a payment reference to the Customer Statement report to support automatic matching of statement entries.

hotfixes.title: You can now select different report layouts for customer and employee remittance advices.
hotfixes.summary: You can now select different report layouts for customer and employee remittance advices.

hotfixes.title: Partner extensions can now access journal template, batch, and line information in vendor creditor/debtor integration events.
hotfixes.summary: Partner extensions can now access journal template, batch, and line information in vendor creditor/debtor integration events.

hotfixes.title: Additional journal fields, including Document No.
hotfixes.summary: Additional journal fields, including Document No. , Payment Reference , and dimension fields, are now shown by default.

hotfixes.title: You can now view archived payment application proposals on a new read-only page.
hotfixes.summary: You can now view archived payment application proposals on a new read-only page.

hotfixes.title: New archive pages provide a full audit trail for posted reconciliation lines.
hotfixes.summary: New archive pages provide a full audit trail for posted reconciliation lines.

hotfixes.title: A new Appl.
hotfixes.summary: A new Appl. Pmt Entry Archive page lets you view archived applied payment entries.

hotfixes.title: Yapily imports now support aggregated imports across multiple days.
hotfixes.summary: Yapily imports now support aggregated imports across multiple days.

hotfixes.title: Added the OnAfterFillAppliedPaymentEntryFromPaymentApplProposal integration event.
hotfixes.summary: Added the OnAfterFillAppliedPaymentEntryFromPaymentApplProposal integration event.

hotfixes.title: In the Troubleshooting page, the Last Updated field was updated whenever any bank system field changed.
hotfixes.summary: In the Troubleshooting page, the Last Updated field was updated whenever any bank system field changed. It now updates only when a new setup file is downloaded and applied.

hotfixes.title: Reopening the Bank Account Setup wizard could overwrite a manually entered Bank Code .
hotfixes.summary: Reopening the Bank Account Setup wizard could overwrite a manually entered Bank Code . The wizard now preserves manually assigned bank codes unless the referenced bank no longer exists.

hotfixes.title: Validation rules that referenced unresolved fields could pass silently without warning.
hotfixes.summary: Validation rules that referenced unresolved fields could pass silently without warning. Telemetry is now generated to help identify and diagnose these situations.

hotfixes.title: The first Yapily account statement import could start one day earlier than the selected date.
hotfixes.summary: The first Yapily account statement import could start one day earlier than the selected date. Imports now start on the date entered.

hotfixes.title: Yapily bank accounts not included in the granted consent could be shown as ready.
hotfixes.summary: Yapily bank accounts not included in the granted consent could be shown as ready. Only accounts included in the consent are now marked as ready.

hotfixes.title: Automatic reconciliation posting could be scheduled before transaction imports completed.
hotfixes.summary: Automatic reconciliation posting could be scheduled before transaction imports completed. Default schedules now ensure imports run before reconciliation posting.

hotfixes.title: Removed unused test variables and unreachable code in payment reconciliation functionality.
hotfixes.summary: Removed unused test variables and unreachable code in payment reconciliation functionality. This is an internal code cleanup with no functional impact.

hotfixes.title: Rabobank error responses during payment or direct debit submission could trigger endless retries.
hotfixes.summary: Rabobank error responses during payment or direct debit submission could trigger endless retries. Failed requests are now correctly marked as failed and no longer resubmitted.

hotfixes.title: Deleting a bank system or payment method did not remove related field validation setup.
hotfixes.summary: Deleting a bank system or payment method did not remove related field validation setup. Related validation setup is now deleted automatically, and bank system codes can no longer be renamed.

hotfixes.title: When creating a Banking Template , the Template Type field was empty by default.
hotfixes.summary: When creating a Banking Template , the Template Type field was empty by default. The field is now prefilled automatically.

hotfixes.title: Disconnecting and reconnecting ABN AMRO, Bizcuit, or Yapily connections could leave stale import state information.
hotfixes.summary: Disconnecting and reconnecting ABN AMRO, Bizcuit, or Yapily connections could leave stale import state information. The import state is now cleared when a connection is disconnected.

hotfixes.title: New Citibank connections used an outdated default SFTP address.
hotfixes.summary: New Citibank connections used an outdated default SFTP address. The correct address is now used during onboarding.

hotfixes.title: Payment entries could not use a blank or custom End To End Id value required by some payment formats.
hotfixes.summary: Payment entries could not use a blank or custom End To End Id value required by some payment formats. A separate Bank End To End Id field now supports export-specific values without affecting internal processing.

hotfixes.title: Remittance templates using both Single Instance and Line Break could generate invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance templates using both Single Instance and Line Break could generate invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods. The default activation template now uses a compatible single-line configuration.

hotfixes.title: In Approval Flow Lines , selecting Never for notifications required removing an existing email address first.
hotfixes.summary: In Approval Flow Lines , selecting Never for notifications required removing an existing email address first. The notification option can now be changed regardless of whether an email address is entered.

hotfixes.title: Global dimension codes were not cleared from payment journal lines when dimensions were removed during manual payment summarization.
hotfixes.summary: Global dimension codes were not cleared from payment journal lines when dimensions were removed during manual payment summarization. Dimension values are now cleared correctly.

hotfixes.title: Anti-money laundering approver information could show rejected, canceled, or duplicate approvers.
hotfixes.summary: Anti-money laundering approver information could show rejected, canceled, or duplicate approvers. Only approved users from the current approval round are now reported.

hotfixes.title: Validating Recipient Bank Account could fail if a related payment suggestion had been deleted.
hotfixes.summary: Validating Recipient Bank Account could fail if a related payment suggestion had been deleted. Validation now succeeds even when the payment suggestion no longer exists.

hotfixes.title: Payment Suggestion Templates running through the Job Queue generated callback errors after execution.
hotfixes.summary: Payment Suggestion Templates running through the Job Queue generated callback errors after execution. They now run without creating job queue errors.

hotfixes.title: VAT amounts in payment allocations could be calculated incorrectly for foreign-currency documents or documents with multiple VAT rates.
hotfixes.summary: VAT amounts in payment allocations could be calculated incorrectly for foreign-currency documents or documents with multiple VAT rates. Calculations now use the correct currency and all relevant VAT entries.

hotfixes.title: The Send Remittance Advice option was not selected when payment lines were manually summarized.
hotfixes.summary: The Send Remittance Advice option was not selected when payment lines were manually summarized. The option is now set correctly on summarized lines.

hotfixes.title: Payment suggestions displayed confirmation dialogs for Pay-to Vendor No.
hotfixes.summary: Payment suggestions displayed confirmation dialogs for Pay-to Vendor No. and Bill-to Customer No. during automated processing. These confirmations are now skipped for payment suggestions while remaining available for manual entry.

hotfixes.title: Security conflict errors could occur when posting purchase invoices that changed non-bank-related vendor fields.
hotfixes.summary: Security conflict errors could occur when posting purchase invoices that changed non-bank-related vendor fields. The validation now applies only to security-sensitive bank information.

hotfixes.title: Manual remittance processing could delete unrelated payment suggestion data.
hotfixes.summary: Manual remittance processing could delete unrelated payment suggestion data. Only data belonging to the current batch is now removed, and partially posted suggestions can no longer be deleted.

hotfixes.title: Payment allocations defined on vendors were not applied to invoices posted from purchase orders.
hotfixes.summary: Payment allocations defined on vendors were not applied to invoices posted from purchase orders. Allocations are now carried over correctly.

hotfixes.title: Fixed-amount payment allocations could exceed the invoice amount without generating an error.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed-amount payment allocations could exceed the invoice amount without generating an error. Posting is now blocked when allocations exceed the invoice total.

hotfixes.title: Remittance advice emails were not sent for payments with the Sent to Bank status.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance advice emails were not sent for payments with the Sent to Bank status. Emails are now sent correctly for these payments.

hotfixes.title: Remittance template limit warnings could hide other validation errors and appear when remittance advice was sent by email or PDF.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance template limit warnings could hide other validation errors and appear when remittance advice was sent by email or PDF. Warnings now appear only for Bank Only delivery and no longer hide other errors.

hotfixes.title: Importing certain CAMT.054 files could assign incorrect amounts to bank transaction lines.
hotfixes.summary: Importing certain CAMT.054 files could assign incorrect amounts to bank transaction lines. The import now uses the correct proprietary amount when available.

hotfixes.title: The Reconciliation Test Report did not identify reconciliation lines that resulted in zero-sum applications when Post Multi Appln.
hotfixes.summary: The Reconciliation Test Report did not identify reconciliation lines that resulted in zero-sum applications when Post Multi Appln. as Sum. was enabled. A warning now highlights the affected line before posting.

hotfixes.title: The Apply Merge Rule action could merge all selected lines regardless of merge rule configuration.
hotfixes.summary: The Apply Merge Rule action could merge all selected lines regardless of merge rule configuration. Merge rules are now applied correctly.

hotfixes.title: Automatic matching could fail when Bank Account No.
hotfixes.summary: Automatic matching could fail when Bank Account No. contained special characters. Matching now handles special characters correctly.

hotfixes.title: The Some search rules are incomplete notification could appear even when all search rules were complete.
hotfixes.summary: The Some search rules are incomplete notification could appear even when all search rules were complete. The notification is now shown only for genuinely incomplete rules.

hotfixes.title: Split line calculations in the Payment Reconciliation Journal could produce incorrect parent totals after repeated edits.
hotfixes.summary: Split line calculations in the Payment Reconciliation Journal could produce incorrect parent totals after repeated edits. Parent line amounts are now recalculated correctly.

hotfixes.title: Using Post Payment Only could delete a payment reconciliation journal even when no entries were posted.
hotfixes.summary: Using Post Payment Only could delete a payment reconciliation journal even when no entries were posted. Posting is now blocked until all lines are properly completed and posted.

hotfixes.title: Split rules did not create journal lines when reconciliation lines were applied only to bank account ledger entries.
hotfixes.summary: Split rules did not create journal lines when reconciliation lines were applied only to bank account ledger entries. Journal lines are now created correctly for split amounts.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The Correction and Document No.
hotfixes.summary: The Correction and Document No. columns are now visible by default in the Payment Journal and Direct Debit Journal . The columns follow standard Business Central behavior without requiring Show More Columns .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: For the first account statement import through Yapily, the import period started one day before the entered date.
hotfixes.summary: For the first account statement import through Yapily, the import period started one day before the entered date. The entered date is now used as the first day of the import period.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Payment entries did not allow End To End ID to be blank or use an alternative value required by some payment formats.
hotfixes.summary: Payment entries did not allow End To End ID to be blank or use an alternative value required by some payment formats. Bank End To End ID lets exported values differ without affecting the internal End To End ID .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Remittance templates with Single Instance and Line Break enabled generated invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance templates with Single Instance and Line Break enabled generated invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods. The default activation template now uses a single-line format without Line Break .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: In Approval Flow Lines , Never could not be selected as the notification option when an email address was present.
hotfixes.summary: In Approval Flow Lines , Never could not be selected as the notification option when an email address was present. Never can now be selected regardless of the E-mail field value.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Anti-money laundering approver reporting could include users who rejected or canceled a payment.
hotfixes.summary: Anti-money laundering approver reporting could include users who rejected or canceled a payment. It could also duplicate users in both approver fields. Reporting now considers approved entries from the current approval round. The second approver field is populated only when another user approved the payment.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Payment Suggestion Templates run through the Job Queue generated callback errors after each run.
hotfixes.summary: Payment Suggestion Templates run through the Job Queue generated callback errors after each run. Templates now run without job queue errors.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When payment journal lines were manually summarized after Suggest Vendor Payments , Send Remittance Advice was not selected on the summarized line.
hotfixes.summary: When payment journal lines were manually summarized after Suggest Vendor Payments , Send Remittance Advice was not selected on the summarized line. The field is now selected correctly during manual summarization.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The Reconciliation Test Report did not warn when applications summed to zero while Post Multi Appln.
hotfixes.summary: The Reconciliation Test Report did not warn when applications summed to zero while Post Multi Appln. as Sum. was enabled. A warning now identifies the affected reconciliation line.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Automatic matching could not find ledger entries when the bank account number contained special characters.
hotfixes.summary: Automatic matching could not find ledger entries when the bank account number contained special characters. Matching now handles these account numbers correctly.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The Some search rules are incomplete notification appeared when all search rules were complete.
hotfixes.summary: The Some search rules are incomplete notification appeared when all search rules were complete. The notification now appears only when a search rule is incomplete.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: In the Payment Reconciliation Journal , updating a child line's Statement Amount could increase group totals incorrectly.
hotfixes.summary: In the Payment Reconciliation Journal , updating a child line's Statement Amount could increase group totals incorrectly. Parent line amounts are now recalculated when a child line amount changes.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 10, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Restricted records in Payment Approvals were not always deleted because license checks were skipped.
hotfixes.summary: Restricted records in Payment Approvals were not always deleted because license checks were skipped. License checks are now enforced. A permission error is shown when access is insufficient.

hotfixes.title: You can now share a bank authentication with other companies in the same environment, allowing multiple companies to use the same bank connection with
hotfixes.summary: You can now share a bank authentication with other companies in the same environment, allowing multiple companies to use the same bank connection without repeating the authentication process. The sharing process includes setup, refresh, and revoke capabilities. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: Partner extensions can now determine whether a date is a bank closing day by using a new public codeunit.
hotfixes.summary: Partner extensions can now determine whether a date is a bank closing day by using a new public codeunit.

hotfixes.title: You can now share authentication entries across companies in the same Business Central tenant.
hotfixes.summary: You can now share authentication entries across companies in the same Business Central tenant. The Share Authentication wizard helps configure, refresh, and revoke shared authentications across eligible companies. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: Cross-company authentication sharing is now controlled by the Allow Cross-Company Share setting on the Bank System page.
hotfixes.summary: Cross-company authentication sharing is now controlled by the Allow Cross-Company Share setting on the Bank System page. Clear error messages are shown when sharing is blocked due to insufficient permissions.

hotfixes.title: You can now share authentication entries with other companies by using the new Share Authentication wizard.
hotfixes.summary: You can now share authentication entries with other companies by using the new Share Authentication wizard. The wizard automatically configures bank connections in target companies and supports ongoing management of shared entries. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: You can now share authentication entries with multiple companies from the Authentication Entries page.
hotfixes.summary: You can now share authentication entries with multiple companies from the Authentication Entries page. The sharing experience includes previews and confirmation of results for each target company. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: The authentication sharing wizard now includes companies that do not yet have a bank system assigned and provides status information when automatic de
hotfixes.summary: The authentication sharing wizard now includes companies that do not yet have a bank system assigned and provides status information when automatic detection cannot be completed. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: A guided Share Authentication Wizard is now available for sharing authentication entries across multiple companies.
hotfixes.summary: A guided Share Authentication Wizard is now available for sharing authentication entries across multiple companies. The wizard provides previews, validation, and completion reporting throughout the process. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: Shared authentication targets can now be refreshed to synchronize updated bank settings.
hotfixes.summary: Shared authentication targets can now be refreshed to synchronize updated bank settings. You can also revoke shares for individual companies while preserving unrelated setup data. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: The Assisted Bank Account Setup wizard can now reuse an authentication that already exists in a sibling company.
hotfixes.summary: The Assisted Bank Account Setup wizard can now reuse an authentication that already exists in a sibling company. This reduces setup effort by eliminating the need to enter credentials again.

hotfixes.title: Assisted bank account setup now displays bank-specific activation information after setup is completed, helping users understand when a new bank conne
hotfixes.summary: Assisted bank account setup now displays bank-specific activation information after setup is completed, helping users understand when a new bank connection may become available.

hotfixes.title: OAuth access tokens for direct-communication bank systems are now refreshed automatically through a scheduled background job.
hotfixes.summary: OAuth access tokens for direct-communication bank systems are now refreshed automatically through a scheduled background job. This helps prevent communication interruptions caused by expired tokens.

hotfixes.title: You can now edit the Payment Discount Amount and Amount to Pay fields directly on the Applied Entries page.
hotfixes.summary: You can now edit the Payment Discount Amount and Amount to Pay fields directly on the Applied Entries page.

hotfixes.title: Payment export validation now verifies alternative recipient bank accounts defined in payment allocations.
hotfixes.summary: Payment export validation now verifies alternative recipient bank accounts defined in payment allocations. This helps identify configuration issues before payments are exported.

hotfixes.title: The Applied Entries FactBox in the Payment Journal now includes an Applied Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: The Applied Entries FactBox in the Payment Journal now includes an Applied Pmt. Discount column to show the discount amount that will be applied.

hotfixes.title: A new Summarize per Account setting in Payment Journal Setup lets you define the default summarization behavior for payment suggestions.
hotfixes.summary: A new Summarize per Account setting in Payment Journal Setup lets you define the default summarization behavior for payment suggestions.

hotfixes.title: Bank account verification now uses a unified verification status column and improved validation behavior across payment workflows.
hotfixes.summary: Bank account verification now uses a unified verification status column and improved validation behavior across payment workflows. Verification details are clearer and only enforced during export or approval when blocking is enabled.

hotfixes.title: Partners can now integrate Continia Banking purchase and sales document functionality into custom page extensions.
hotfixes.summary: Partners can now integrate Continia Banking purchase and sales document functionality into custom page extensions.

hotfixes.title: Partners can now access public APIs for checking bank closing days and finding the nearest available banking date.
hotfixes.summary: Partners can now access public APIs for checking bank closing days and finding the nearest available banking date.

hotfixes.title: Payment allocation entries now include their own On Hold status, which stays synchronized with related ledger entries.
hotfixes.summary: Payment allocation entries now include their own On Hold status, which stays synchronized with related ledger entries. Released document payment allocations are also protected from further editing.

hotfixes.title: The Applied Entries and Payment Journal pages now support Analysis Mode with predefined views that help summarize and analyze payment data.
hotfixes.summary: The Applied Entries and Payment Journal pages now support Analysis Mode with predefined views that help summarize and analyze payment data. See Analyzing applied entries .

hotfixes.title: You can now configure remittance description text by selecting a Remittance Advice template in Banking Export Setup .
hotfixes.summary: You can now configure remittance description text by selecting a Remittance Advice template in Banking Export Setup .

hotfixes.title: The Payment Journal and Direct Debit Journal now open in a simplified Standard view.
hotfixes.summary: The Payment Journal and Direct Debit Journal now open in a simplified Standard view. Users can switch between Standard and Advanced views, and preferences are saved per user.

hotfixes.title: A new Automatic Proposal Application Setup lets administrators configure automatic application behavior, matching requirements, and partial-payment ha
hotfixes.summary: A new Automatic Proposal Application Setup lets administrators configure automatic application behavior, matching requirements, and partial-payment handling for different matching strategies.

hotfixes.title: The payment reference rule test tool now indicates whether a detected document type indicator can be mapped successfully.
hotfixes.summary: The payment reference rule test tool now indicates whether a detected document type indicator can be mapped successfully.

hotfixes.title: You can now configure how document types are assigned during payment application by using the new Document Type Implementation setting.
hotfixes.summary: You can now configure how document types are assigned during payment application by using the new Document Type Implementation setting.

hotfixes.title: External extensions can now tokenize bank reconciliation line text through a new public codeunit.
hotfixes.summary: External extensions can now tokenize bank reconciliation line text through a new public codeunit.

hotfixes.title: Partners can now apply bank account reconciliation lines to accounts programmatically through a public API with improved error handling.
hotfixes.summary: Partners can now apply bank account reconciliation lines to accounts programmatically through a public API with improved error handling.

hotfixes.title: A new integration event allows partner extensions to transfer custom data from bank reconciliation lines to applied payment entries.
hotfixes.summary: A new integration event allows partner extensions to transfer custom data from bank reconciliation lines to applied payment entries.

hotfixes.title: A new integration event allows partner extensions to transfer custom fields from payment application proposals to applied payment entries.
hotfixes.summary: A new integration event allows partner extensions to transfer custom fields from payment application proposals to applied payment entries.

hotfixes.title: Partner extensions can now add custom filters to open ledger entry queries used during automatic matching.
hotfixes.summary: Partner extensions can now add custom filters to open ledger entry queries used during automatic matching.

hotfixes.title: Partner extensions can now validate payment references through a new public API that uses the same validation logic as Continia Banking.
hotfixes.summary: Partner extensions can now validate payment references through a new public API that uses the same validation logic as Continia Banking.

hotfixes.title: You can now resolve the bank account associated with imported or previously posted bank transactions by using the same matching logic as the import pr
hotfixes.summary: You can now resolve the bank account associated with imported or previously posted bank transactions by using the same matching logic as the import process.

hotfixes.title: A new Matching Details FactBox in the Cash Receipt Journal provides insight into payment matching results and explains why a match succeeded or failed
hotfixes.summary: A new Matching Details FactBox in the Cash Receipt Journal provides insight into payment matching results and explains why a match succeeded or failed.

hotfixes.title: PSP reconciliation can now use an alternative description when the primary posting description does not produce a match.
hotfixes.summary: PSP reconciliation can now use an alternative description when the primary posting description does not produce a match.

hotfixes.title: You can now merge multiple CSV column values into a single field by configuring a connector in the column mapping.
hotfixes.summary: You can now merge multiple CSV column values into a single field by configuring a connector in the column mapping.

hotfixes.title: Added an Important information message to the final step of assisted bank setup.
hotfixes.summary: Added an Important information message to the final step of assisted bank setup. The message explains that bank activation may still be pending and is tailored to the selected bank system.

hotfixes.title: OAuth access tokens for direct-communication bank systems are now refreshed automatically each day by a background job to help prevent communication f
hotfixes.summary: OAuth access tokens for direct-communication bank systems are now refreshed automatically each day by a background job to help prevent communication failures caused by expired tokens.

hotfixes.title: Improved Yapily bank account linking.
hotfixes.summary: Improved Yapily bank account linking. Account references are now assigned only to the correct bank account, and matching by sort code and account number is more reliable.

hotfixes.title: Removed a temporary diagnostic action from the Bank Account Card.
hotfixes.summary: Removed a temporary diagnostic action from the Bank Account Card. This internal development feature was never available in released versions and has no user-facing impact.

hotfixes.title: Corrected JavaScript resource path casing for the Popup Login control add-in to ensure consistent behavior across all deployment environments.
hotfixes.summary: Corrected JavaScript resource path casing for the Popup Login control add-in to ensure consistent behavior across all deployment environments.

hotfixes.title: Updated Payment Allocation tables for document and journal entries to address breaking changes introduced in version 28.3.0.0.
hotfixes.summary: Updated Payment Allocation tables for document and journal entries to address breaking changes introduced in version 28.3.0.0. Payment allocations now process correctly.

hotfixes.title: The Payment Discount Amount and Amount to Pay fields on the Applied Entries page are now editable, allowing payment amounts and discounts to be adjust
hotfixes.summary: The Payment Discount Amount and Amount to Pay fields on the Applied Entries page are now editable, allowing payment amounts and discounts to be adjusted directly.

hotfixes.title: Payment export validation now validates alternative recipient bank accounts defined in Payment Allocations.
hotfixes.summary: Payment export validation now validates alternative recipient bank accounts defined in Payment Allocations. Validation entries are created for each allocation to ensure all recipient accounts are verified before export.

hotfixes.title: Added an Applied Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: Added an Applied Pmt. Discount column to the Applied Entries FactBox in the Payment Journal. The column shows the discount that will be applied based on the posting date and discount date.

hotfixes.title: Added a Summarize per Account field to Payment Journal Setup, allowing default summarization behavior to be configured for each journal batch.

hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue affecting PSP Excel uploads.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Introduced a pre-match step in bank reconciliation for Yapily.
hotfixes.summary: Introduced a pre-match step in bank reconciliation for Yapily. The step identifies rejected BACS payments within a batch, adjusts statement lines, and enables automatic reconciliation without manual intervention.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Added support for importing only transactions with the TransactionMutability value set to Immutable in Yapily HSBC.
hotfixes.summary: Added support for importing only transactions with the TransactionMutability value set to Immutable in Yapily HSBC.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Added the OnBeforeUpdateTempGenJournalLine integration event to allow modification of the temporary general journal line before posting during payment
hotfixes.summary: Added the OnBeforeUpdateTempGenJournalLine integration event to allow modification of the temporary general journal line before posting during payment reconciliation. This enables partners to transfer custom field values to resulting ledger entries.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where service IDs could not be added from the bank card.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where service IDs could not be added from the bank card. A new action now opens an editable list, allowing service IDs to be added and removed.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Improved performance when applying or posting payment journal lines with Applies-to ID.
hotfixes.summary: Improved performance when applying or posting payment journal lines with Applies-to ID. The system now avoids unnecessary locking and updates only entries that change.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Found By enum in payment application proposals was not extensible.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Found By enum in payment application proposals was not extensible. It is now extensible, allowing custom values in integrations.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where activation setup did not run when activating multiple companies.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where activation setup did not run when activating multiple companies. The system now tracks per-company activation and runs setup automatically when needed.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Batch field was not set automatically for payment methods with batching enabled.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Batch field was not set automatically for payment methods with batching enabled. The field is now correctly set during setup import.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where Yapily consent tokens could expire after long inactivity.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where Yapily consent tokens could expire after long inactivity. Token refresh now occurs earlier to prevent expiration.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where payment journal lines were not summarized correctly after due date adjustments.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where payment journal lines were not summarized correctly after due date adjustments. Summarization now correctly groups all eligible payments.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where Recipient Reference and Description did not use the vendor language.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where Recipient Reference and Description did not use the vendor language. Template values now respect the vendor's language code.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where payment approval setup failed because approval flows were missing.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where payment approval setup failed because approval flows were missing. Approval flows are now created automatically during setup.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where direct debit mandates could not be downloaded as PDF when email setup failed.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where direct debit mandates could not be downloaded as PDF when email setup failed. A new Print Mandate action allows direct PDF download.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where remittance information showed incorrect amounts after modifying applied entries.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where remittance information showed incorrect amounts after modifying applied entries. The correct per-entry amounts are now used.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Pmt. Reference was not updated after relevant field changes. The field is now recalculated correctly.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where multiple mandate sequence types were grouped incorrectly in export files.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where multiple mandate sequence types were grouped incorrectly in export files. Sequence type is now used as a grouping criterion.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where pages could not be opened when Continia Banking was not activated.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where pages could not be opened when Continia Banking was not activated. Activation checks are now in place on relevant cards.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Added support for a Payment Approval Administrator field.
hotfixes.summary: Added support for a Payment Approval Administrator field. Users can now be configured as approval administrators for Continia Banking.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where foreign currency statement amounts were incorrect during import.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where foreign currency statement amounts were incorrect during import. The system now uses the correct amount based on statement currency.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where Document Type was blank when applying Finance Charge Memos and Reminders .
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where Document Type was blank when applying Finance Charge Memos and Reminders . It is now set to Payment .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Payment Batch ID on ledger entries was converted to uppercase automatically.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Payment Batch ID on ledger entries was converted to uppercase automatically.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Added a new publisher event, OnBeforeValidateBankAccount , to the PmtSuggHeadPub codeunit so partners can run custom validation before a bank account
hotfixes.summary: Added a new publisher event, OnBeforeValidateBankAccount , to the PmtSuggHeadPub codeunit so partners can run custom validation before a bank account is validated in payment suggestions. The existing internal event remains unchanged. This enables custom validation without affecting localization logic.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Setup import failed when authentication entries already existed for a bank system.
hotfixes.summary: Setup import failed when authentication entries already existed for a bank system. The import incorrectly validated unchanged fields, causing an error. The process now validates only changed fields, allowing the import to complete.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: HTTP error occurred when importing or converting bank files if the user name contained non-ASCII characters.
hotfixes.summary: HTTP error occurred when importing or converting bank files if the user name contained non-ASCII characters. The issue occurred during file import and other Continia Online operations. Redundant headers were removed, and authentication is now handled by the shared handler.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Payments could not be approved when the approver list was long.
hotfixes.summary: Payments could not be approved when the approver list was long. The issue occurred during approval workflows with many approvers. The full approver list is now always shown.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Payment reference templates only allowed fields from the purchase header.
hotfixes.summary: Payment reference templates only allowed fields from the purchase header. This occurred when configuring templates in Continia Banking Templates. Vendor fields are now included in the selection.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 8, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Modulus 11 calculation returned an invalid check digit when the remainder was 1.
hotfixes.summary: Modulus 11 calculation returned an invalid check digit when the remainder was 1. This occurred during check digit generation in banking templates. The calculation now returns “-” for remainder 1.

hotfixes.title: Import and export functionality has been added for CSV Ports.
hotfixes.summary: Import and export functionality has been added for CSV Ports. Payment service providers and PSP agreements can now be included in the import and export process, making it easier to move configurations from a test environment to a production environment. See Importing and exporting CSV ports .

hotfixes.title: A new Service IDs list has been added to the Bank Card page.
hotfixes.summary: A new Service IDs list has been added to the Bank Card page. It is only visible for bank systems that support file lists, such as Nordea and Danske Bank. When one or more Service IDs are added, both the Bank File List page and the automatic file download are restricted to files matching those Service IDs.

hotfixes.title: A Bank Accounts Missing Setup FactBox is added to the Troubleshooting page.
hotfixes.summary: A Bank Accounts Missing Setup FactBox is added to the Troubleshooting page. It shows bank accounts that have a Bank Code on the Continia Banking tab but aren’t set up in Bank Acc. Com. Setup . Select a bank account number to open the setup page filtered to that account, so you can complete the setup. For more information, see Troubleshooting source files .

hotfixes.title: Email validation in bank assisted setup wizards now rejects malformed email addresses, including addresses without a domain extension (for example, na
hotfixes.summary: Email validation in bank assisted setup wizards now rejects malformed email addresses, including addresses without a domain extension (for example, name@host), addresses with multiple @ characters, consecutive dots in the domain, leading or trailing whitespace, and a dot at the beginning or end of the local or domain part. The error message is now consistent across email fields on bank, customer, vendor, and employee records.

hotfixes.title: BANKSapi is now generally available and no longer managed through Feature Management .
hotfixes.summary: BANKSapi is now generally available and no longer managed through Feature Management . For more information, see BANKSapi and Continia Banking .

hotfixes.title: BANKSapi EBICS exports now use the correct EBICS authentication flow instead of PSD2.
hotfixes.summary: BANKSapi EBICS exports now use the correct EBICS authentication flow instead of PSD2. The setup wizard exits early if the bank account is already Ready , and the Communication Type can’t be changed after authentication is created. Errors are shown if the bank system code is missing or deleted.

hotfixes.title: The assisted setup for direct bank account communication now recognizes a security challenge response as a pending state rather than a failure.
hotfixes.summary: The assisted setup for direct bank account communication now recognizes a security challenge response as a pending state rather than a failure. The established connection and bank connection user name are kept in place so the connection can be finalized after the signed challenge is approved at the bank. The setup now also confirms that the bank connection user name was saved and keeps it in sync with the stored value.

hotfixes.title: SEB and SWEDBank requests now correctly include the company's BC Company Info ID when authenticating, exporting payments, and importing statements and
hotfixes.summary: SEB and SWEDBank requests now correctly include the company's BC Company Info ID when authenticating, exporting payments, and importing statements and payment status. The value is only included when it has been set for the company.

hotfixes.title: The Payment Allocation module adds external access to allocation lines, VAT-only allocations, post-posting edits, recalculation, invoice previews, opt
hotfixes.summary: The Payment Allocation module adds external access to allocation lines, VAT-only allocations, post-posting edits, recalculation, invoice previews, optional invoice calculation, new extensibility points, and manual export setup. For more information, see Setting up and managing payment allocations

hotfixes.title: New OnBeforeCreateFromSuggestionOverview integration events have been added to the Suggest Customer Payments , Suggest Vendor Payments , and Suggest E
hotfixes.summary: New OnBeforeCreateFromSuggestionOverview integration events have been added to the Suggest Customer Payments , Suggest Vendor Payments , and Suggest Employee Payments reports. These events are raised at the beginning of the CreateFromSuggestionOverview procedure, allowing subscribers to apply additional filters or modify parameters before the payment suggestion is created.

hotfixes.title: New publisher events have been added to the general journal line validation process.
hotfixes.summary: New publisher events have been added to the general journal line validation process. The OnBeforeCTSPEValidateBankAccount event allows subscribers to perform custom bank account validation before the standard validation runs. The CTSPEInsertJnlExportError publisher enables partners to insert custom export error messages during the validation process.

hotfixes.title: Adds the Curr.
hotfixes.summary: Adds the Curr. Code (Equivalent Value) field to the vendor and payment flow, enabling payments to be executed in a different currency than the one used in Business Central. The value flows through documents, journals, and exports, and is included in the pain.001 file. Enable the feature using Use Curr. Code (Equivalent Value) in Banking Export Setup (disabled by default). For more information, see Paying in a different currency using Curr. Code (Equivalent Value) .

hotfixes.title: Support has been added for rules that enable bank statement lines to be merged automatically.
hotfixes.summary: Support has been added for rules that enable bank statement lines to be merged automatically. The feature can be enabled on the Continia Feature Management page. For more information, see Introducing merge rules .

hotfixes.title: Support has been added for manually merging multiple bank statement lines.
hotfixes.summary: Support has been added for manually merging multiple bank statement lines. The feature can be enabled on the Continia Feature Management page. For more information, see Merging bank statement lines manually .

hotfixes.title: Adds a Reminder/Fin.
hotfixes.summary: Adds a Reminder/Fin. Charge Memo Matching setting to Banking Import Setup . When enabled, it matches transactions to issued reminders and finance charge memos and creates a Payment Application Proposal from related customer ledger entries, including fees. For more information, see Matching reminders and finance charge memos .

hotfixes.title: The job queue setup logic has been updated so that delegated users are no longer blocked from creating job queues.
hotfixes.summary: The job queue setup logic has been updated so that delegated users are no longer blocked from creating job queues. When a delegated user initiates job queue creation, the job queues are created with a status of on hold, consistent with the behavior in other Continia products.

hotfixes.title: Actions have been added to the Bank Transaction Lines subpage to set and remove the value in the Imported To Company field.
hotfixes.summary: Actions have been added to the Bank Transaction Lines subpage to set and remove the value in the Imported To Company field.

hotfixes.title: Improves extensibility of reconciliation posting by adding the CTS-PI Applied Payment Entry to events, making the table public, and moving its busines
hotfixes.summary: Improves extensibility of reconciliation posting by adding the CTS-PI Applied Payment Entry to events, making the table public, and moving its business logic to a codeunit.

hotfixes.title: AccessPay report imports now use a persistent 4‑hour rate‑limit cache to reduce polling and prevent duplicate requests.
hotfixes.summary: AccessPay report imports now use a persistent 4‑hour rate‑limit cache to reduce polling and prevent duplicate requests. The first import after upgrade uses a 15‑day lookback window to ensure no reports are missed. For more information, see Troubleshooting source files .

hotfixes.title: Extracts Posted DD Return Entry logic into a new codeunit and makes the InitPostedReturnEntryFromReturnDDEntry procedure publicly accessible to suppor
hotfixes.summary: Extracts Posted DD Return Entry logic into a new codeunit and makes the InitPostedReturnEntryFromReturnDDEntry procedure publicly accessible to support extensibility and automated testing.

hotfixes.title: Blob storage integration has been added to PSP agreements.
hotfixes.summary: Blob storage integration has been added to PSP agreements. You can set up and create a job queue to import files from Azure Blob storage to the file archive and process them to PSP headers automatically.

hotfixes.title: The PSP reconciliation process has been enhanced to automatically handle invoices with a posting date after the payment date.
hotfixes.summary: The PSP reconciliation process has been enhanced to automatically handle invoices with a posting date after the payment date. A new Matched Ledger Entries table has been introduced to track these entries. New setup options have been added to the PSP Agreement Reconciliation Setup page to control this behavior.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where CSV date parsing failed in non-English environments.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where CSV date parsing failed in non-English environments. Adds an English fallback for parsing dates and moves the Amount Format Rules table to the Base Application.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where pending verification entries remained after restoring approved bank account values.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where pending verification entries remained after restoring approved bank account values. Entries are now automatically removed when values are reverted, including partial and full restores.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where importing account statements via BANKSapi silently failed when a response could not be decoded as JSON.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where importing account statements via BANKSapi silently failed when a response could not be decoded as JSON. The raw response is now archived with Type set to Error on decode failure, the request entry is released, and the import flow proceeds to the next polling cycle.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where communication with SEB and SWEDBank could be sent without the company's BC Company Info ID, preventing the bank from matching the
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where communication with SEB and SWEDBank could be sent without the company's BC Company Info ID, preventing the bank from matching the request to the correct company agreement. Requests now correctly include the BC Company Info ID when it has been set for the company.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where AML Approver Reference exceeded bank limits due to GUID formatting.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where AML Approver Reference exceeded bank limits due to GUID formatting. The field is now stored as text across payment tables, and GUID-based fields are obsolete. Improves validation and inspection pages with clearer value display, highlights missing sequence numbers, and simplifies the Line Inspection menu.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where BANKSapi exports could mark journals as exported without a payment reference.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where BANKSapi exports could mark journals as exported without a payment reference. The export now rolls back changes and shows an error so the payment can be reviewed and resent.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where a single payment with a missing payment reference aborted the entire Update Status run for a BANKSapi journal.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where a single payment with a missing payment reference aborted the entire Update Status run for a BANKSapi journal. Such payments are now skipped during status polling and receive their status through the regular account statement import once a payment reference exists.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue in CSV processing where a double delimiter in the middle of a file caused an import failure.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue in CSV processing where a double delimiter in the middle of a file caused an import failure.

hotfixes.title: Fixed PSP search rules with the Additional Description setting.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed PSP search rules with the Additional Description setting.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue during the upgrade from version 27 where existing CSV import data contained amount values in unsupported formats, causing the upgrade t
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue during the upgrade from version 27 where existing CSV import data contained amount values in unsupported formats, causing the upgrade to fail. Unsupported amount format values are now skipped during the upgrade.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue in the version 27.5 CSV Port Amount Handling upgrade where the upgrade failed with an error stating that the record in table PSP Search
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue in the version 27.5 CSV Port Amount Handling upgrade where the upgrade failed with an error stating that the record in table PSP Search Rule Template already exists.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where the payment journal line amount wasn’t updated when the application changed.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where the payment journal line amount wasn’t updated when the application changed. The amount is now always recalculated when applying or removing entries (for example via Apply Entries or changes to Applies-to ID or Applies-to Doc. No. ), instead of only when the amount was zero.

hotfixes.title: Warning-level validation results no longer block payment journal export or the posting of purchase and sales invoices and journal lines.
hotfixes.summary: Warning-level validation results no longer block payment journal export or the posting of purchase and sales invoices and journal lines. Previously, warnings were incorrectly treated as errors. Repeated use of the Export action also caused warning entries to accumulate in the validation log. This has been corrected.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where validation error details pointed to the wrong table.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where validation error details pointed to the wrong table. Errors for missing Creditor Bank Country Code now correctly reference the Vendor Bank Account and Country/Region Code field.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where posting vendor payments with partially applied invoices failed when using summarized payments.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where posting vendor payments with partially applied invoices failed when using summarized payments. Partial payment split logic has been removed, and partial payments are now included in the summarized entry.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where the mandate letter used Partner Type instead of the mandate.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where the mandate letter used Partner Type instead of the mandate. Adds a Mandate Type field to SEPA Direct Debit Mandate , now used to determine the correct letter. The field is pre-filled and can be changed on the Direct Debit Mandates page.

hotfixes.title: Adds new events that let partners apply custom filters when creating payment headers and split payments based on custom fields (for example, REMADV)
hotfixes.summary: Adds new events that let partners apply custom filters when creating payment headers and split payments based on custom fields (for example, REMADV), enabling flexible grouping of payment proposals.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where Payment Information ID and Payment Batch ID used Code type and forced uppercase, causing matching issues.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where Payment Information ID and Payment Batch ID used Code type and forced uppercase, causing matching issues. Replaced with Text fields that preserve casing and migrated existing data.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where import failed when values contained % .
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where import failed when values contained % . The character is now escaped and treated as a literal value.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the test report in the Payment Reconciliation Journal showed an incorrect warning ( The applied amount must be 0 ) for G/L or emp
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the test report in the Payment Reconciliation Journal showed an incorrect warning ( The applied amount must be 0 ) for G/L or employee entries. The report now handles these correctly.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where changing Account Type or Account No.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where changing Account Type or Account No. cleared Search Rule but not Split Rule . Both are now cleared together.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where an error occurred during upgrade of Banking Import due to incorrect field mapping in the data transfer logic for the Applied Paym
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where an error occurred during upgrade of Banking Import due to incorrect field mapping in the data transfer logic for the Applied Payment Entry and Payment Appl. Proposal tables. The field mappings in the upgrade codeunit have been corrected so that data is transferred correctly during the upgrade.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue during upgrade caused by incorrect field mapping for Applied Payment Entry and Payment Appl.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue during upgrade caused by incorrect field mapping for Applied Payment Entry and Payment Appl. Proposal . Field mappings have been corrected.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where imports failed when Yapily returned 0001-01-01T00
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where imports failed when Yapily returned 0001-01-01T00:00:00 for missing dates. These values are now treated as blank dates.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where importing PSP receipts failed due to currency validation when the balancing account had a currency.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where importing PSP receipts failed due to currency validation when the balancing account had a currency. The currency code is now set before validation.

hotfixes.title: Added new setting to have balancing per line if balance account per posting date is used.
hotfixes.summary: Added new setting to have balancing per line if balance account per posting date is used.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 7, hotfix 3
hotfixes.title: The AML Approver Reference field now supports longer text values, and validation pages clearly show values before and after formatting.
hotfixes.summary: The AML Approver Reference field now supports longer text values, and validation pages clearly show values before and after formatting. Missing configuration is highlighted, and the interface is simplified for easier inspection.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 7, hotfix 3
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue that caused an error during upgrade to version 28.1.1 due to incorrect field mapping in the data transfer logic for the Applied Payment
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue that caused an error during upgrade to version 28.1.1 due to incorrect field mapping in the data transfer logic for the Applied Payment Entry and Payment Application Proposal tables. Field mappings have been corrected to ensure data transfers successfully during the upgrade.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 7, hotfix 3
hotfixes.title: Improved validation and formatting for the AML Approver Reference field and removed length limitations.
hotfixes.summary: Improved validation and formatting for the AML Approver Reference field and removed length limitations.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2025 R2, Service Pack 7, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the direct debit mandate letter used the Partner Type on the Customer Card to determine whether to create a B2B or CORE letter.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the direct debit mandate letter used the Partner Type on the Customer Card to determine whether to create a B2B or CORE letter. This caused incorrect letters when a customer had both B2B and CORE mandates across different bank accounts. The mandate letter now uses the new Mandate Type field on the SEPA Direct Debit Mandate table to determine the correct letter content for each mandate. The field is automatically set when a mandate is created and can be adjusted manually on t

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue causing an error during upgrade to version 28.1.1 due to incorrect field mappings in the data transfer logic for the Applied Payment En
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue causing an error during upgrade to version 28.1.1 due to incorrect field mappings in the data transfer logic for the Applied Payment Entry and Payment Application Proposal tables. The field mappings have been corrected to ensure data transfers successfully during the upgrade.

hotfixes.summary: Improved AccessPay status import to avoid duplicate processing.

hotfixes.summary: Prevented re-running DNB setup for already configured accounts.

hotfixes.summary: Added full Yapily response to the File Archive for easier troubleshooting.

hotfixes.summary: Automatically sets AccessPay transaction ID format during setup.

hotfixes.summary: Fixed posting error with summarized payments and credit memos.

hotfixes.summary: Fixed inconsistent rule clearing when changing account fields.
