hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where standard linking between accounts was not working correctly. The linked account was always skipped if it had a higher balance. This condition now applies only when the linking payment is used in the suggestion.

hotfixes.title: Fixed external code validation.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed external code validation. When entering a code used for multiple countries, the selection page now allows users to confirm with OK .

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where deleting an added value in the sender reference pattern incorrectly inserted “2%” into the pattern.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where deleting an added value in the sender reference pattern incorrectly inserted “2%” into the pattern. The pattern now updates correctly when values are removed.

hotfixes.title: The Payment Suggestion Templates tile is now always visible in the Role Center.
hotfixes.summary: The Payment Suggestion Templates tile is now always visible in the Role Center.

hotfixes.title: Corrected validation error details for related fields.
hotfixes.summary: Corrected validation error details for related fields.

hotfixes.title: Rabobank: Only one bank account is authorized, but all were shown as ready.
hotfixes.summary: Rabobank: Only one bank account is authorized, but all were shown as ready.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an error handling response from Continia Online when updating status.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an error handling response from Continia Online when updating status.

hotfixes.title: Bizcuit: Fixed an error when importing account statements from ABN AMRO.
hotfixes.summary: Bizcuit: Fixed an error when importing account statements from ABN AMRO.

hotfixes.title: Bizcuit: Fixed an issue where payments remained in the Sent to bank status after approval.
hotfixes.summary: Bizcuit: Fixed an issue where payments remained in the Sent to bank status after approval.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where payment suggestions created payment lines in the default journal instead of the current journal.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where payment suggestions created payment lines in the default journal instead of the current journal.

hotfixes.title: Added support for extended clearing of information related to direct communication with Rabobank, Bizcuit, and similar integrations.
hotfixes.summary: Added support for extended clearing of information related to direct communication with Rabobank, Bizcuit, and similar integrations.

hotfixes.title: Resolved activation failure caused by CB 25 upgrade applying a filter to a field with ObsoleteState = Removed .
hotfixes.summary: Resolved activation failure caused by CB 25 upgrade applying a filter to a field with ObsoleteState = Removed .

hotfixes.title: Fixed issue where Update JobQueue 71553647 failed with an empty ETag error when encountering bank accounts not connected to Continia Banking (i.e., mi
hotfixes.summary: Fixed issue where Update JobQueue 71553647 failed with an empty ETag error when encountering bank accounts not connected to Continia Banking (i.e., missing Bankcode Mapping). This error prevented updates to other valid bank systems from completing successfully.

hotfixes.title: Added support for specific CSV formats with double delimiters when a space exists in a CSV value.
hotfixes.summary: Added support for specific CSV formats with double delimiters when a space exists in a CSV value.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where balance ledger entries incorrectly received the End-to-End ID instead of the Payment Information ID during batch posting; now, ba
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where balance ledger entries incorrectly received the End-to-End ID instead of the Payment Information ID during batch posting; now, balancing lines include only the Payment Information ID, as they aggregate multiple lines.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue that prevented users from selecting external codes.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue that prevented users from selecting external codes.

hotfixes.title: When a journal contained multiple payment methods, batch posting was applied to all lines even if setup existed for only one method.
hotfixes.summary: When a journal contained multiple payment methods, batch posting was applied to all lines even if setup existed for only one method. This is fixed: only payment methods with batch posting configured are now included.

hotfixes.title: Blocked bank accounts are now disregarded during file import.
hotfixes.summary: Blocked bank accounts are now disregarded during file import.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Recipient Reference was overwritten on the payment journal line after selecting Apply Entries .
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Recipient Reference was overwritten on the payment journal line after selecting Apply Entries . The Recipient Reference now rebuilds correctly based on the template setup instead of using a fixed value.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Standard Batch Approval Send/Cancel actions weren’t shown in Banking Journals.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Standard Batch Approval Send/Cancel actions weren’t shown in Banking Journals. They now appear if no Security module approval workflows are enabled.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where modifying the applied amount in the application proposal caused the system to delete the transferred difference line without rest
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where modifying the applied amount in the application proposal caused the system to delete the transferred difference line without restoring the original transaction amount on the parent line.

hotfixes.title: Resolved error occurring when exporting payments via Danske Bank direct communication.
hotfixes.summary: Resolved error occurring when exporting payments via Danske Bank direct communication.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an error where mandate usage was not registered correctly.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an error where mandate usage was not registered correctly.

hotfixes.title: You can now select a Payment Reconciliation Journal for each bank account and currency combination when importing CSV transactions.
hotfixes.summary: You can now select a Payment Reconciliation Journal for each bank account and currency combination when importing CSV transactions. The selected journal is saved and reused for future imports, making it easier to import transactions for accounts in multiple currencies.

hotfixes.title: You can now perform IBAN lookups for customer and vendor bank accounts from partner extensions.
hotfixes.summary: You can now perform IBAN lookups for customer and vendor bank accounts from partner extensions. This enables integration scenarios such as importing bank accounts into Continia Banking through custom extensions.

hotfixes.title: Bank communication requests can now send authentication credentials exactly as stored by the bank system.
hotfixes.summary: Bank communication requests can now send authentication credentials exactly as stored by the bank system. This supports bank systems that use a single encrypted credential blob for authentication while maintaining compatibility with systems that use individual credential fields.

hotfixes.title: JP Morgan direct communication now uses the second-generation Continia Online endpoints for file transfers and asynchronous status polling.
hotfixes.summary: JP Morgan direct communication now uses the second-generation Continia Online endpoints for file transfers and asynchronous status polling. Other bank systems are unaffected.

hotfixes.title: The Setup JP Morgan assisted setup now prevents accounts that are already connected or awaiting approval from being configured again.
hotfixes.summary: The Setup JP Morgan assisted setup now prevents accounts that are already connected or awaiting approval from being configured again. It also clarifies the required Host format and preserves uploaded SSH and PGP public keys when replaced during setup.

hotfixes.title: Automated test coverage has been expanded across authentication, payment export, and statement import flows for supported bank integrations.
hotfixes.summary: Automated test coverage has been expanded across authentication, payment export, and statement import flows for supported bank integrations. This is an internal quality improvement with no user-facing changes.

hotfixes.title: Base64- and gzip-encoded bank response payloads are now automatically decoded in the Request Header Log List .
hotfixes.summary: Base64- and gzip-encoded bank response payloads are now automatically decoded in the Request Header Log List . A new factbox displays decoded content, and exported files now include the decoded payload when available.

hotfixes.title: The automated pre-match test now uses deterministic data instead of randomly generated values, improving test reliability and consistency.
hotfixes.summary: The automated pre-match test now uses deterministic data instead of randomly generated values, improving test reliability and consistency.

hotfixes.title: Payment status requests for Yapily bank systems can now retrieve detailed statuses for individual payments within a bulk payment.
hotfixes.summary: Payment status requests for Yapily bank systems can now retrieve detailed statuses for individual payments within a bulk payment. Enable the new Bulk Status Details setting on the Bank System page to use this feature.

hotfixes.title: Support access code validation is now trusted for 15 minutes instead of 60 seconds.
hotfixes.summary: Support access code validation is now trusted for 15 minutes instead of 60 seconds. This reduces delays when reopening the Request Header Log List page during troubleshooting sessions.

hotfixes.title: Exported request header log files now use record-identifying filenames that include the log entry and endpoint.
hotfixes.summary: Exported request header log files now use record-identifying filenames that include the log entry and endpoint. This makes exported files easier to identify and manage.

hotfixes.title: Async status-poll entries are now shown by default in the request header log.
hotfixes.summary: Async status-poll entries are now shown by default in the request header log. The Show/Hide Status Polls action now hides these entries instead of revealing them.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue that could prevent installation of the Continia Banking test app in environments where the Continia Banking Import app was not installe
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue that could prevent installation of the Continia Banking test app in environments where the Continia Banking Import app was not installed.

hotfixes.title: In the Dutch localization, the Creditor No.
hotfixes.summary: In the Dutch localization, the Creditor No. field is now automatically populated from the Creditor Identifier field on bank accounts, eliminating the need to maintain both fields manually. See Using the Continia Banking fields on the customer, vendor, and employee card .

hotfixes.title: The Use Bank Account and Use Payment Method fields have been moved to the Fill In Journal Lines section on payment suggestion request pages, better re
hotfixes.summary: The Use Bank Account and Use Payment Method fields have been moved to the Fill In Journal Lines section on payment suggestion request pages, better reflecting their purpose.

hotfixes.title: The Completed Payment Suggestions page is now available under History , providing a read-only view of fully posted payment suggestions.
hotfixes.summary: The Completed Payment Suggestions page is now available under History , providing a read-only view of fully posted payment suggestions. See Viewing completed payment suggestions in Continia Banking .

hotfixes.title: You can now specify a custom exchange rate by using the new Currency Factor field on the Payment Card .
hotfixes.summary: You can now specify a custom exchange rate by using the new Currency Factor field on the Payment Card . This helps avoid exchange-rate differences when settling foreign-currency payments.

hotfixes.title: Added creditor number and payment reference logic to purchase journals for Danish FIK payment references.
hotfixes.summary: Added creditor number and payment reference logic to purchase journals for Danish FIK payment references.

hotfixes.title: A new setting in Payment Journal Setup lets you automatically export approved payment lines to the bank through a job queue, eliminating the need for
hotfixes.summary: A new setting in Payment Journal Setup lets you automatically export approved payment lines to the bank through a job queue, eliminating the need for manual export.

hotfixes.title: The Account Verification Status field is now available on the Payment Card .
hotfixes.summary: The Account Verification Status field is now available on the Payment Card .

hotfixes.title: You can now validate a remittance information template against a bank's remittance advice limits by using the new Bank Compatibility action.
hotfixes.summary: You can now validate a remittance information template against a bank's remittance advice limits by using the new Bank Compatibility action. This helps identify configuration issues before export.

hotfixes.title: The Remittance Advice report now uses consistent remaining-amount calculations for employees, vendors, and customers, improving accuracy for employee
hotfixes.summary: The Remittance Advice report now uses consistent remaining-amount calculations for employees, vendors, and customers, improving accuracy for employee remittance documents.

hotfixes.title: It is now possible to trigger Payment Suggestion header validation from extensions when custom header fields are updated.
hotfixes.summary: It is now possible to trigger Payment Suggestion header validation from extensions when custom header fields are updated.

hotfixes.title: The Correction and Document No.
hotfixes.summary: The Correction and Document No. columns are now visible by default in the Payment Journal and Direct Debit Journal , following standard Business Central behavior.

hotfixes.title: You can now add custom values to the Allocation Calc.
hotfixes.summary: You can now add custom values to the Allocation Calc. Type field and implement custom payment allocation calculation logic through extensions.

hotfixes.title: You can now select different report layouts for customer and employee remittance advices.
hotfixes.summary: You can now select different report layouts for customer and employee remittance advices. A new public procedure also enables extension-based customization of remittance advice export and delivery.

hotfixes.title: Partner extensions can now access journal template, batch, and line information in vendor creditor and debtor integration events.
hotfixes.summary: Partner extensions can now access journal template, batch, and line information in vendor creditor and debtor integration events.

hotfixes.title: The Document No.
hotfixes.summary: The Document No. , Message to Recipient , Description , Sender Reference , Payment Reference , and dimension fields are now displayed by default in the Payment Journal and Direct Debit Journal .

hotfixes.title: The imported transaction type, either account statement (CAMT.053) or transaction import (CAMT.054), is now displayed on the Payment Reconciliation Jo
hotfixes.summary: The imported transaction type, either account statement (CAMT.053) or transaction import (CAMT.054), is now displayed on the Payment Reconciliation Journal pages. The journal continues to accept only the transaction type selected during the first import.

hotfixes.title: You can now include an FIK payment reference on customer statements.
hotfixes.summary: You can now include an FIK payment reference on customer statements. When customers pay using this reference, payment matching automatically proposes all open entries included in the statement period.

hotfixes.title: The Customer Statement now includes an FIK payment reference that covers all open entries in the statement period, improving automatic payment matchin
hotfixes.summary: The Customer Statement now includes an FIK payment reference that covers all open entries in the statement period, improving automatic payment matching.

hotfixes.title: Previewing the Customer Statement report no longer generates a payment reference, preventing unused references from being created.
hotfixes.summary: Previewing the Customer Statement report no longer generates a payment reference, preventing unused references from being created.

hotfixes.title: You can now add an FIK payment reference to the Customer Statement report, allowing a single reference to cover all open entries in the statement peri
hotfixes.summary: You can now add an FIK payment reference to the Customer Statement report, allowing a single reference to cover all open entries in the statement period.

hotfixes.title: Internal test reliability improvements with no user-facing impact.
hotfixes.summary: Internal test reliability improvements with no user-facing impact.

hotfixes.title: The Apply Ledger Entries page now opens significantly faster for General Ledger account reconciliation when Finance Integration is enabled.
hotfixes.summary: The Apply Ledger Entries page now opens significantly faster for General Ledger account reconciliation when Finance Integration is enabled.

hotfixes.title: You can now add a payment reference to the Customer Statement report, enabling automatic matching of all entries included in the statement period.
hotfixes.summary: You can now add a payment reference to the Customer Statement report, enabling automatic matching of all entries included in the statement period.

hotfixes.title: A new Bank Account FactBox on the Payment Reconciliation Journal displays bank account information directly on the page.
hotfixes.summary: A new Bank Account FactBox on the Payment Reconciliation Journal displays bank account information directly on the page.

hotfixes.title: Added an Account Name column to the Cash Receipt Journal page.
hotfixes.summary: Added an Account Name column to the Cash Receipt Journal page.

hotfixes.title: You can now view archived payment application proposals on a new read-only page, preserving matching information after reconciliation lines are posted
hotfixes.summary: You can now view archived payment application proposals on a new read-only page, preserving matching information after reconciliation lines are posted.

hotfixes.title: New archive pages provide a complete audit trail for posted reconciliation lines, including payment application proposals and applied payment entries.
hotfixes.summary: New archive pages provide a complete audit trail for posted reconciliation lines, including payment application proposals and applied payment entries.

hotfixes.title: A new read-only Appl.
hotfixes.summary: A new read-only Appl. Pmt Entry Archive page lets you view applied payment entries that are removed when reconciliation lines are posted. See Understanding payment archives .

hotfixes.title: Yapily imports now support aggregated transaction imports across multiple days, ensuring the configured aggregation period is respected.
hotfixes.summary: Yapily imports now support aggregated transaction imports across multiple days, ensuring the configured aggregation period is respected.

hotfixes.title: Added the OnAfterFillAppliedPaymentEntryFromPaymentApplProposal integration event.
hotfixes.summary: Added the OnAfterFillAppliedPaymentEntryFromPaymentApplProposal integration event. Extensions can use this event to transfer custom field values from payment application proposals to applied payment entries.

hotfixes.title: Data change tracking files are now generated per table instead of as a single file.
hotfixes.summary: Data change tracking files are now generated per table instead of as a single file. This makes it easier to review changes for each release without encountering file size limits.

hotfixes.title: In the Troubleshooting page, the Last Updated field was updated whenever any bank system field changed.
hotfixes.summary: In the Troubleshooting page, the Last Updated field was updated whenever any bank system field changed. It now updates only when a new setup file is downloaded and applied.

hotfixes.title: Reopening the Bank Account Setup wizard could overwrite a manually entered Bank Code .
hotfixes.summary: Reopening the Bank Account Setup wizard could overwrite a manually entered Bank Code . The wizard now preserves manually assigned bank codes unless the referenced bank no longer exists.

hotfixes.title: Validation rules that referenced unresolved fields could pass silently without warning.
hotfixes.summary: Validation rules that referenced unresolved fields could pass silently without warning. Telemetry is now generated to help identify and diagnose these situations.

hotfixes.title: The first Yapily account statement import could start one day earlier than the selected date.
hotfixes.summary: The first Yapily account statement import could start one day earlier than the selected date. Imports now start on the date entered.

hotfixes.title: Yapily bank accounts not included in the granted consent could be shown as ready.
hotfixes.summary: Yapily bank accounts not included in the granted consent could be shown as ready. Only accounts included in the consent are now marked as ready.

hotfixes.title: Automatic reconciliation posting could be scheduled before transaction imports completed.
hotfixes.summary: Automatic reconciliation posting could be scheduled before transaction imports completed. Default schedules now ensure imports run before reconciliation posting.

hotfixes.title: Removed unused test variables and unreachable code in payment reconciliation functionality.
hotfixes.summary: Removed unused test variables and unreachable code in payment reconciliation functionality. This is an internal code cleanup with no functional impact.

hotfixes.title: Rabobank error responses during payment or direct debit submission could trigger endless retries.
hotfixes.summary: Rabobank error responses during payment or direct debit submission could trigger endless retries. Failed requests are now correctly marked as failed and no longer resubmitted.

hotfixes.title: Deleting a bank system or payment method did not remove related field validation setup.
hotfixes.summary: Deleting a bank system or payment method did not remove related field validation setup. Related validation setup is now deleted automatically, and bank system codes can no longer be renamed.

hotfixes.title: When creating a Banking Template , the Template Type field was empty by default.
hotfixes.summary: When creating a Banking Template , the Template Type field was empty by default. The field is now prefilled automatically.

hotfixes.title: Disconnecting and reconnecting ABN AMRO, Bizcuit, or Yapily connections could leave stale import state information.
hotfixes.summary: Disconnecting and reconnecting ABN AMRO, Bizcuit, or Yapily connections could leave stale import state information. The import state is now cleared when a connection is disconnected.

hotfixes.title: New Citibank connections used an outdated default SFTP address.
hotfixes.summary: New Citibank connections used an outdated default SFTP address. The correct address is now used during onboarding.

hotfixes.title: Payment entries could not use a blank or custom End To End ID value required by some payment formats.
hotfixes.summary: Payment entries could not use a blank or custom End To End ID value required by some payment formats. A separate Bank End To End Id field now supports export-specific values without affecting internal processing.

hotfixes.title: Remittance templates using both Single Instance and Line Break could generate invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance templates using both Single Instance and Line Break could generate invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods. The default activation template now uses a compatible single-line configuration.

hotfixes.title: In Approval Flow Lines , selecting Never for notifications required removing an existing email address first.
hotfixes.summary: In Approval Flow Lines , selecting Never for notifications required removing an existing email address first. The notification option can now be changed regardless of whether an email address is entered.

hotfixes.title: Global dimension codes were not cleared from payment journal lines when dimensions were removed during manual payment summarization.
hotfixes.summary: Global dimension codes were not cleared from payment journal lines when dimensions were removed during manual payment summarization. Dimension values are now cleared correctly.

hotfixes.title: Anti-money laundering approver information could show rejected, canceled, or duplicate approvers.
hotfixes.summary: Anti-money laundering approver information could show rejected, canceled, or duplicate approvers. Only approved users from the current approval round are now reported.

hotfixes.title: Validating Recipient Bank Account could fail if a related payment suggestion had been deleted.
hotfixes.summary: Validating Recipient Bank Account could fail if a related payment suggestion had been deleted. Validation now succeeds even when the payment suggestion no longer exists.

hotfixes.title: Payment Suggestion Templates running through the Job Queue generated callback errors after execution.
hotfixes.summary: Payment Suggestion Templates running through the Job Queue generated callback errors after execution. They now run without creating job queue errors.

hotfixes.title: VAT amounts in payment allocations could be calculated incorrectly for foreign-currency documents or documents with multiple VAT rates.
hotfixes.summary: VAT amounts in payment allocations could be calculated incorrectly for foreign-currency documents or documents with multiple VAT rates. Calculations now use the correct currency and all relevant VAT entries.

hotfixes.title: The Send Remittance Advice option was not selected when payment lines were manually summarized.
hotfixes.summary: The Send Remittance Advice option was not selected when payment lines were manually summarized. The option is now set correctly on summarized lines.

hotfixes.title: Payment suggestions displayed confirmation dialogs for Pay-to Vendor No.
hotfixes.summary: Payment suggestions displayed confirmation dialogs for Pay-to Vendor No. and Bill-to Customer No. during automated processing. These confirmations are now skipped for payment suggestions while remaining available for manual entry.

hotfixes.title: Security conflict errors could occur when posting purchase invoices that changed non-bank-related vendor fields.
hotfixes.summary: Security conflict errors could occur when posting purchase invoices that changed non-bank-related vendor fields. The validation now applies only to security-sensitive bank information.

hotfixes.title: Manual remittance processing could delete unrelated payment suggestion data.
hotfixes.summary: Manual remittance processing could delete unrelated payment suggestion data. Only data belonging to the current batch is now removed, and partially posted suggestions can no longer be deleted.

hotfixes.title: Payment allocations defined on vendors were not applied to invoices posted from purchase orders.
hotfixes.summary: Payment allocations defined on vendors were not applied to invoices posted from purchase orders. Allocations are now carried over correctly.

hotfixes.title: Fixed-amount payment allocations could exceed the invoice amount without generating an error.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed-amount payment allocations could exceed the invoice amount without generating an error. Posting is now blocked when allocations exceed the invoice total.

hotfixes.title: Remittance advice emails were not sent for payments with the Sent to Bank status.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance advice emails were not sent for payments with the Sent to Bank status. Emails are now sent correctly for these payments.

hotfixes.title: Remittance template limit warnings could hide other validation errors and appear when remittance advice was sent by email or PDF.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance template limit warnings could hide other validation errors and appear when remittance advice was sent by email or PDF. Warnings now appear only for Bank Only delivery and no longer hide other errors.

hotfixes.title: Importing certain CAMT.054 files could assign incorrect amounts to bank transaction lines.
hotfixes.summary: Importing certain CAMT.054 files could assign incorrect amounts to bank transaction lines. The import now uses the correct proprietary amount when available.

hotfixes.title: The Reconciliation Test Report did not identify reconciliation lines that resulted in zero-sum applications when Post Multi Appln.
hotfixes.summary: The Reconciliation Test Report did not identify reconciliation lines that resulted in zero-sum applications when Post Multi Appln. as Sum. was enabled. A warning now highlights the affected line before posting.

hotfixes.title: The Apply Merge Rule action could merge all selected lines regardless of merge rule configuration.
hotfixes.summary: The Apply Merge Rule action could merge all selected lines regardless of merge rule configuration. Merge rules are now applied correctly.

hotfixes.title: Automatic matching could fail when Bank Account No.
hotfixes.summary: Automatic matching could fail when Bank Account No. contained special characters. Matching now handles special characters correctly.

hotfixes.title: The Some search rules are incomplete notification could appear even when all search rules were complete.
hotfixes.summary: The Some search rules are incomplete notification could appear even when all search rules were complete. The notification is now shown only for genuinely incomplete rules.

hotfixes.title: Split line calculations in the Payment Reconciliation Journal could produce incorrect parent totals after repeated edits.
hotfixes.summary: Split line calculations in the Payment Reconciliation Journal could produce incorrect parent totals after repeated edits. Parent line amounts are now recalculated correctly.

hotfixes.title: Using Post Payment Only could delete a payment reconciliation journal even when no entries were posted.
hotfixes.summary: Using Post Payment Only could delete a payment reconciliation journal even when no entries were posted. Posting is now blocked until all lines are properly completed and posted.

hotfixes.title: Split rules did not create journal lines when reconciliation lines were applied only to bank account ledger entries.
hotfixes.summary: Split rules did not create journal lines when reconciliation lines were applied only to bank account ledger entries. Journal lines are now created correctly for split amounts.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The Correction and Document No.
hotfixes.summary: The Correction and Document No. columns are now visible by default in the Payment Journal and Direct Debit Journal . The columns follow standard Business Central behavior without requiring Show More Columns .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: For the first account statement import through Yapily, the import period started one day before the entered date.
hotfixes.summary: For the first account statement import through Yapily, the import period started one day before the entered date. The entered date is now used as the first day of the import period.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Payment entries did not allow End To End ID to be blank or use an alternative value required by some payment formats.
hotfixes.summary: Payment entries did not allow End To End ID to be blank or use an alternative value required by some payment formats. Bank End To End ID lets exported values differ without affecting the internal End To End ID .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Remittance templates with Single Instance and Line Break enabled generated invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods.
hotfixes.summary: Remittance templates with Single Instance and Line Break enabled generated invalid remittance information for single-line payment methods. The default activation template now uses a single-line format without Line Break .

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: In Approval Flow Lines , Never could not be selected as the notification option when an email address was present.
hotfixes.summary: In Approval Flow Lines , Never could not be selected as the notification option when an email address was present. Never can now be selected regardless of the E-mail field value.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Anti-money laundering approver reporting could include users who rejected or canceled a payment.
hotfixes.summary: Anti-money laundering approver reporting could include users who rejected or canceled a payment. It could also duplicate users in both approver fields. Reporting now considers approved entries from the current approval round. The second approver field is populated only when another user approved the payment.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Payment Suggestion Templates run through the Job Queue generated callback errors after each run.
hotfixes.summary: Payment Suggestion Templates run through the Job Queue generated callback errors after each run. Templates now run without job queue errors.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When payment journal lines were manually summarized after Suggest Vendor Payments , Send Remittance Advice was not selected on the summarized line.
hotfixes.summary: When payment journal lines were manually summarized after Suggest Vendor Payments , Send Remittance Advice was not selected on the summarized line. The field is now selected correctly during manual summarization.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The Reconciliation Test Report did not warn when applications summed to zero while Post Multi Appln.
hotfixes.summary: The Reconciliation Test Report did not warn when applications summed to zero while Post Multi Appln. as Sum. was enabled. A warning now identifies the affected reconciliation line.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Automatic matching could not find ledger entries when the bank account number contained special characters.
hotfixes.summary: Automatic matching could not find ledger entries when the bank account number contained special characters. Matching now handles these account numbers correctly.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The Some search rules are incomplete notification appeared when all search rules were complete.
hotfixes.summary: The Some search rules are incomplete notification appeared when all search rules were complete. The notification now appears only when a search rule is incomplete.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: In the Payment Reconciliation Journal , updating a child line's Statement Amount could increase group totals incorrectly.
hotfixes.summary: In the Payment Reconciliation Journal , updating a child line's Statement Amount could increase group totals incorrectly. Parent line amounts are now recalculated when a child line amount changes.

hotfixes.version: Continia Banking 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Restricted records in Payment Approvals were not always deleted because license checks were skipped.
hotfixes.summary: Restricted records in Payment Approvals were not always deleted because license checks were skipped. License checks are now enforced. A permission error is shown when access is insufficient.

hotfixes.title: You can now share a bank authentication with other companies in the same environment, allowing multiple companies to use the same bank connection with
hotfixes.summary: You can now share a bank authentication with other companies in the same environment, allowing multiple companies to use the same bank connection without repeating the authentication process. The sharing process includes setup, refresh, and revoke capabilities. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: Partner extensions can now determine whether a date is a bank closing day by using a new public codeunit.
hotfixes.summary: Partner extensions can now determine whether a date is a bank closing day by using a new public codeunit.

hotfixes.title: You can now share authentication entries across companies in the same Business Central tenant.
hotfixes.summary: You can now share authentication entries across companies in the same Business Central tenant. The Share Authentication wizard helps configure, refresh, and revoke shared authentications across eligible companies. For more information, see Managing tokens and certificates .

hotfixes.title: Cross-company authentication sharing is now controlled by the Allow Cross-Company Share setting on the Bank System page.

hotfixes.title: Adds the Curr.
hotfixes.summary: Adds the Curr. Code (Equivalent Value) field to the vendor and payment flow, enabling payments to be executed in a different currency than the one used in Business Central. The value flows through documents, journals, and exports, and is included in the pain.001 file. Enable the feature using Use Curr. Code (Equivalent Value) in Banking Export Setup (disabled by default). For more information, see Paying in a different currency using Curr. Code (Equivalent Value) .

hotfixes.title: Support has been added for rules that enable bank statement lines to be merged automatically.
hotfixes.summary: Support has been added for rules that enable bank statement lines to be merged automatically. The feature can be enabled on the Continia Feature Management page. For more information, see Introducing merge rules .

hotfixes.title: Support has been added for manually merging multiple bank statement lines.
hotfixes.summary: Support has been added for manually merging multiple bank statement lines. The feature can be enabled on the Continia Feature Management page. For more information, see Merging bank statement lines manually .

hotfixes.title: Adds a Reminder/Fin.
hotfixes.summary: Adds a Reminder/Fin. Charge Memo Matching setting to Banking Import Setup . When enabled, it matches transactions to issued reminders and finance charge memos and creates a Payment Application Proposal from related customer ledger entries, including fees. For more information, see Matching reminders and finance charge memos .

hotfixes.title: The job queue setup logic has been updated so that delegated users are no longer blocked from creating job queues.
hotfixes.summary: The job queue setup logic has been updated so that delegated users are no longer blocked from creating job queues. When a delegated user initiates job queue creation, the job queues are created with a status of on hold, consistent with the behavior in other Continia products.

hotfixes.title: Actions have been added to the Bank Transaction Lines subpage to set and remove the value in the Imported To Company field.
hotfixes.summary: Actions have been added to the Bank Transaction Lines subpage to set and remove the value in the Imported To Company field.

hotfixes.title: Improves extensibility of reconciliation posting by adding the CTS-PI Applied Payment Entry to events, making the table public, and moving its busines
hotfixes.summary: Improves extensibility of reconciliation posting by adding the CTS-PI Applied Payment Entry to events, making the table public, and moving its business logic to a codeunit.

hotfixes.title: AccessPay report imports now use a persistent 4‑hour rate‑limit cache to reduce polling and prevent duplicate requests.
hotfixes.summary: AccessPay report imports now use a persistent 4‑hour rate‑limit cache to reduce polling and prevent duplicate requests. The first import after upgrade uses a 15‑day lookback window to ensure no reports are missed. For more information, see Troubleshooting source files .

hotfixes.title: Extracts Posted DD Return Entry logic into a new codeunit and makes the InitPostedReturnEntryFromReturnDDEntry procedure publicly accessible to suppor
hotfixes.summary: Extracts Posted DD Return Entry logic into a new codeunit and makes the InitPostedReturnEntryFromReturnDDEntry procedure publicly accessible to support extensibility and automated testing.

hotfixes.title: Blob storage integration has been added to PSP agreements.
hotfixes.summary: Blob storage integration has been added to PSP agreements. You can set up and create a job queue to import files from Azure Blob storage to the file archive and process them to PSP headers automatically.

hotfixes.title: The PSP reconciliation process has been enhanced to automatically handle invoices with a posting date after the payment date.
hotfixes.summary: The PSP reconciliation process has been enhanced to automatically handle invoices with a posting date after the payment date. A new Matched Ledger Entries table has been introduced to track these entries. New setup options have been added to the PSP Agreement Reconciliation Setup page to control this behavior.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where CSV date parsing failed in non-English environments.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where CSV date parsing failed in non-English environments. Adds an English fallback for parsing dates and moves the Amount Format Rules table to the Base Application.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where pending verification entries remained after restoring approved bank account values.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where pending verification entries remained after restoring approved bank account values. Entries are now automatically removed when values are reverted, including partial and full restores.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where importing account statements via BANKSapi silently failed when a response could not be decoded as JSON.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where importing account statements via BANKSapi silently failed when a response could not be decoded as JSON. The raw response is now archived with Type set to Error on decode failure, the request entry is released, and the import flow proceeds to the next polling cycle.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where communication with SEB and SWEDBank could be sent without the company's BC Company Info ID, preventing the bank from matching the
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where communication with SEB and SWEDBank could be sent without the company's BC Company Info ID, preventing the bank from matching the request to the correct company agreement. Requests now correctly include the BC Company Info ID when it has been set for the company.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where AML Approver Reference exceeded bank limits due to GUID formatting.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where AML Approver Reference exceeded bank limits due to GUID formatting. The field is now stored as text across payment tables, and GUID-based fields are obsolete. Improves validation and inspection pages with clearer value display, highlights missing sequence numbers, and simplifies the Line Inspection menu.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where BANKSapi exports could mark journals as exported without a payment reference.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where BANKSapi exports could mark journals as exported without a payment reference. The export now rolls back changes and shows an error so the payment can be reviewed and resent.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where a single payment with a missing payment reference aborted the entire Update Status run for a BANKSapi journal.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where a single payment with a missing payment reference aborted the entire Update Status run for a BANKSapi journal. Such payments are now skipped during status polling and receive their status through the regular account statement import once a payment reference exists.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue in CSV processing where a double delimiter in the middle of a file caused an import failure.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue in CSV processing where a double delimiter in the middle of a file caused an import failure.

hotfixes.title: Fixed PSP search rules with the Additional Description setting.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed PSP search rules with the Additional Description setting.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue during the upgrade from version 27 where existing CSV import data contained amount values in unsupported formats, causing the upgrade t
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue during the upgrade from version 27 where existing CSV import data contained amount values in unsupported formats, causing the upgrade to fail. Unsupported amount format values are now skipped during the upgrade.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue in the version 27.5 CSV Port Amount Handling upgrade where the upgrade failed with an error stating that the record in table PSP Search
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue in the version 27.5 CSV Port Amount Handling upgrade where the upgrade failed with an error stating that the record in table PSP Search Rule Template already exists.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where the payment journal line amount wasn’t updated when the application changed.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where the payment journal line amount wasn’t updated when the application changed. The amount is now always recalculated when applying or removing entries (for example via Apply Entries or changes to Applies-to ID or Applies-to Doc. No. ), instead of only when the amount was zero.

hotfixes.title: Warning-level validation results no longer block payment journal export or the posting of purchase and sales invoices and journal lines.
hotfixes.summary: Warning-level validation results no longer block payment journal export or the posting of purchase and sales invoices and journal lines. Previously, warnings were incorrectly treated as errors. Repeated use of the Export action also caused warning entries to accumulate in the validation log. This has been corrected.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where validation error details pointed to the wrong table.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where validation error details pointed to the wrong table. Errors for missing Creditor Bank Country Code now correctly reference the Vendor Bank Account and Country/Region Code field.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where posting vendor payments with partially applied invoices failed when using summarized payments.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where posting vendor payments with partially applied invoices failed when using summarized payments. Partial payment split logic has been removed, and partial payments are now included in the summarized entry.

hotfixes.title: Fixes an issue where the mandate letter used Partner Type instead of the mandate.
hotfixes.summary: Fixes an issue where the mandate letter used Partner Type instead of the mandate. Adds a Mandate Type field to SEPA Direct Debit Mandate , now used to determine the correct letter. The field is pre-filled and can be changed on the Direct Debit Mandates page.

hotfixes.title: Adds new events that let partners apply custom filters when creating payment headers and split payments based on custom fields (for example, REMADV)
hotfixes.summary: Adds new events that let partners apply custom filters when creating payment headers and split payments based on custom fields (for example, REMADV), enabling flexible grouping of payment proposals.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where Payment Information ID and Payment Batch ID used Code type and forced uppercase, causing matching issues.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where Payment Information ID and Payment Batch ID used Code type and forced uppercase, causing matching issues. Replaced with Text fields that preserve casing and migrated existing data.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where import failed when values contained % .
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where import failed when values contained % . The character is now escaped and treated as a literal value.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the test report in the Payment Reconciliation Journal showed an incorrect warning ( The applied amount must be 0 ) for G/L or emp
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the test report in the Payment Reconciliation Journal showed an incorrect warning ( The applied amount must be 0 ) for G/L or employee entries. The report now handles these correctly.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where changing Account Type or Account No.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where changing Account Type or Account No. cleared Search Rule but not Split Rule . Both are now cleared together.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where an error occurred during upgrade of Banking Import due to incorrect field mapping in the data transfer logic for the Applied Paym
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where an error occurred during upgrade of Banking Import due to incorrect field mapping in the data transfer logic for the Applied Payment Entry and Payment Appl. Proposal tables. The field mappings in the upgrade codeunit have been corrected so that data is transferred correctly during the upgrade.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue during upgrade caused by incorrect field mapping for Applied Payment Entry and Payment Appl.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue during upgrade caused by incorrect field mapping for Applied Payment Entry and Payment Appl. Proposal . Field mappings have been corrected.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where imports failed when Yapily returned 0001-01-01T00
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where imports failed when Yapily returned 0001-01-01T00:00:00 for missing dates. These values are now treated as blank dates.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where importing PSP receipts failed due to currency validation when the balancing account had a currency.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where importing PSP receipts failed due to currency validation when the balancing account had a currency. The currency code is now set before validation.

hotfixes.title: Added new setting to have balancing per line if balance account per posting date is used.
hotfixes.summary: Added new setting to have balancing per line if balance account per posting date is used.

hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the direct debit mandate letter used the Partner Type on the Customer Card to determine whether to create a B2B or CORE letter. hotfixes.title: A new column mapping system replaces hardcoded dimension positions in the CSV Port.
hotfixes.summary: A new column mapping system replaces hardcoded dimension positions in the CSV Port. It introduces flexible CSV‑to‑field mapping, including support for document type values flowing to Gen. Journal Lines. See Setting up CSV Ports .

hotfixes.title: A new Setup CSV Port action has been added to the CSV Port page, providing a guided setup experience from the port page.
hotfixes.summary: A new Setup CSV Port action has been added to the CSV Port page, providing a guided setup experience from the port page.

hotfixes.title: Bank account verification now also covers vendor, customer, and Payment Information Setup records, including sensitive fields like Creditor No..
hotfixes.summary: Bank account verification now also covers vendor, customer, and Payment Information Setup records, including sensitive fields like Creditor No.. Verified values are reused across related records and auto‑approved. Unverified fields now block approval and export on key documents, including journals, invoices, sales documents, and payment suggestions. The Role Center and record pages highlight items that require attention.

hotfixes.title: You can now automatically match bank account ledger entries from CAMT.053 files with related CAMT.054 entries created during posting.
hotfixes.summary: You can now automatically match bank account ledger entries from CAMT.053 files with related CAMT.054 entries created during posting. Enable Sum Posting per Posting Date on the Banking Import Setup page when posting CAMT.054. The feature is available on the Continia Feature Management page. For Swiss localizations, default CAMT Reference templates are assigned automatically during activation. See Reconciling CAMT.054 entries from CAMT.053 .

hotfixes.title: Document type determination during application in the Bank Account Reconciliation and Payment Reconciliation Journal has been improved.
hotfixes.summary: Document type determination during application in the Bank Account Reconciliation and Payment Reconciliation Journal has been improved. The system now evaluates account type, amount sign, and original document type together. This ensures correct document types and prevents posting errors caused by mismatches, including for entries migrated from OPplus or Dynamo.

hotfixes.title: The Bank Account Setup wizard for Yapily, Bizcuit, and Rabobank now removes authentication entries created during incomplete setups while preserving e
hotfixes.summary: The Bank Account Setup wizard for Yapily, Bizcuit, and Rabobank now removes authentication entries created during incomplete setups while preserving existing entries. The Rabobank wizard also correctly marks the setup as finished when it closes automatically after validating credentials.

hotfixes.title: A confirmation dialog is now shown when you share authentication between related banks.
hotfixes.summary: A confirmation dialog is now shown when you share authentication between related banks. Confirming copies authentication details to the target bank and updates its active bank system and linked accounts accordingly.

hotfixes.title: Instructional text in the Bank Account Setup assisted guide has been clarified.
hotfixes.summary: Instructional text in the Bank Account Setup assisted guide has been clarified. The finish step no longer references a disabled Next button, and the Back button is consistently disabled.

hotfixes.title: A new Search in File Archive action has been added to the File Archive List page.
hotfixes.summary: A new Search in File Archive action has been added to the File Archive List page. The report scans the content of every archived file matching the specified date range and transaction type, and opens the File Archive List filtered to files whose content contains the search text. See Troubleshooting source files .

hotfixes.title: The AUDDIS payment status handling pipeline has been improved.
hotfixes.summary: The AUDDIS payment status handling pipeline has been improved. SEPA Direct Debit lifecycle messages (AUDDIS Arrival, Input, Withdrawal, Input Test, File Acceptance, File Rejection, and Submission Component History) can now be matched and updated through a dedicated bank-specific handler before falling through to the generic CAMT status processor.

hotfixes.title: A new Payment Information Setup capability has been introduced, allowing payment information to be managed and reused across customer, vendor, and emp
hotfixes.summary: A new Payment Information Setup capability has been introduced, allowing payment information to be managed and reused across customer, vendor, and employee records.

hotfixes.title: A new Complete Suggestion From Template action has been added to the Payment Suggestions page.
hotfixes.summary: A new Complete Suggestion From Template action has been added to the Payment Suggestions page. The action opens a template selection dialog and applies the filters and settings from the selected payment suggestion template, including Use Bank Account and Use Payment Method. The Excl. Account without Due Bal. field is automatically disabled when association is activated. The suggestion reports for vendor, customer, and employee payments preserve the template reference. See Working with the Paymen

hotfixes.title: Association and linking payments now respect the summarization configuration.
hotfixes.summary: Association and linking payments now respect the summarization configuration. Posting lines are grouped per account and applied using a shared Applies-to ID , rather than being posted as separate entries.

hotfixes.title: All Message Type values from Finnish vendor ledger entries are now correctly transferred through payment suggestion, payment journal, and payment entr
hotfixes.summary: All Message Type values from Finnish vendor ledger entries are now correctly transferred through payment suggestion, payment journal, and payment entry. New Message Type (FI) and Invoice Message fields have been added to the Payment Entry, Payment Entry Archive, Payment Ledger Entry, and Payment Suggestion Line tables. The previous Invoice Message (FI) field has been obsoleted, and its data is migrated automatically during upgrade.

hotfixes.title: The full range of Danish NemKonto payment methods (NKC, NKV, NKVP, NKVS, NKS) is now supported for vendors, customers, and employees.
hotfixes.summary: The full range of Danish NemKonto payment methods (NKC, NKV, NKVP, NKVS, NKS) is now supported for vendors, customers, and employees. New identification fields have been added: Social Security No. on Customer and Vendor, SE No. and P No. on Customer, Vendor, and Employee, and VAT Registration No. on Employee. The values are mapped to the corresponding Payment Entry creditor fields and included in the inhouse file structure during payment file creation.

hotfixes.title: Country/region matching during payment entry creation now uses the ISO Code field on the Countries/Regions page instead of the Code field.
hotfixes.summary: Country/region matching during payment entry creation now uses the ISO Code field on the Countries/Regions page instead of the Code field. Environments with custom country codes no longer receive false IBAN validation errors. The ISO Code field must be populated for the countries used in payment processing; in standard environments, ISO codes are present by default.

hotfixes.title: The payment suggestion now allows a discount amount higher than the originally posted Remaining Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: The payment suggestion now allows a discount amount higher than the originally posted Remaining Pmt. Disc. Possible on a ledger entry. The same mechanism used for reduced discount amounts applies: the field is temporarily updated to the new value, and the original is preserved so it can be restored when needed.

hotfixes.title: Three new publisher codeunits have been added to enable partner extensibility for payment validation and export blocking
hotfixes.summary: Three new publisher codeunits have been added to enable partner extensibility for payment validation and export blocking: CTS-PE Pmt. Sugg. Head Pub. (event OnAfterCheckPaymentSuggestionHead) , CTS-PE Gen. Jnl. Line Pub. , and CTS-PE Check Jnl. Line Bef. Exp. Pub . Partners can subscribe to these events to enforce custom validation rules and block payment exports without modifying the base application. See Extending Banking Export .

hotfixes.title: The internal extensibility surface for alternate payment entry data has been replaced by a single public publisher on CTS-CB Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: The internal extensibility surface for alternate payment entry data has been replaced by a single public publisher on CTS-CB Pmt. Entry Mgt. Publ. , backed by four scope-specific temporary buffer tables: CTS-CB Alt. Pmt. Account , CTS-CB Alt. Pmt. Creditor , CTS-CB Alt. Pmt. Creditor Bank , and CTS-CB Alt. Pmt. Debtor . hotfixes.summary: Two new fields, Document No. Matching and External Document No. Matching , have been added to the Banking Import Setup page in the General section. hotfixes.title: A new Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: A new Pmt. Recon. Doc.
