hotfixes.summary: Adds a custom PSP external reference type , allowing rules based on any table and field. During reconciliation, these rules automatically resolve and populate the correct customer number on journal lines.

hotfixes.title: A new option has been added to the Amount Format Rules in the CSV Port, allowing the type values that should always be imported to be selected, rather
hotfixes.summary: A new option has been added to the Amount Format Rules in the CSV Port, allowing the type values that should always be imported to be selected, rather than only the values to skip. A new Type Value Selection page supports the configuration. When a positive selection is used, additional values that appear in newer CSV files are automatically excluded.

hotfixes.title: The extended search functionality has been improved.
hotfixes.summary: The extended search functionality has been improved. A new Force Document Type option has been added to the PSP Agreement Reconciliation Setup page, providing more control over matching. Posting date matching now works more reliably with configured date tolerances, and amount matching falls back to LCY values when the original amounts do not match.

hotfixes.title: A permission error occurred when opening the Continia Payment page with entries, due to missing read access to a Document Capture table.
hotfixes.summary: A permission error occurred when opening the Continia Payment page with entries, due to missing read access to a Document Capture table. The required permission is now included when accessed through approval management.

hotfixes.title: A field type mismatch error occurred when Save as Template was used on customer, vendor, or employee cards, preventing templates from being saved.
hotfixes.summary: A field type mismatch error occurred when Save as Template was used on customer, vendor, or employee cards, preventing templates from being saved. Templates can now be created from entity cards and correctly include all Continia Banking fields such as Bal. Account No. , Payment Method Code , Cost Type , and external codes.

hotfixes.title: Opening journals or setup pages could trigger unexpected approval permission errors.
hotfixes.summary: Opening journals or setup pages could trigger unexpected approval permission errors. The ShowError parameter on the approval access check was incorrectly set to true, causing the check to throw an error instead of returning the result. The parameter has been corrected, and the return value from the module license check is now stored correctly.

hotfixes.title: Opening the Bank Account Setup page failed because the access check for the Direct Communication module did not return its result correctly.
hotfixes.summary: Opening the Bank Account Setup page failed because the access check for the Direct Communication module did not return its result correctly. The return value is now saved, and error handling on the approval access check has been improved.

hotfixes.title: A permission error was shown when the Manual Setup action was invoked from a setup page by a user without permissions for Continia Banking.
hotfixes.summary: A permission error was shown when the Manual Setup action was invoked from a setup page by a user without permissions for Continia Banking.

hotfixes.title: The PSP Agreement Setup page displayed notification banners for assisted setup and videos that were not related to PSP payment processing.
hotfixes.summary: The PSP Agreement Setup page displayed notification banners for assisted setup and videos that were not related to PSP payment processing. The unrelated notifications have been removed. The assisted setup and video links remain available on other, more relevant pages.

hotfixes.title: Notification banners and unrelated video links displayed on the PSP Agreement Setup page have been removed.
hotfixes.summary: Notification banners and unrelated video links displayed on the PSP Agreement Setup page have been removed.

hotfixes.title: Continia Banking PSP search rules and templates were missing in the demo app.
hotfixes.summary: Continia Banking PSP search rules and templates were missing in the demo app. Agreements such as the Klarna Agreement appeared empty, and all PSP templates were missing across payment service providers. The demo app referenced obsoleted PSP tables. It has been updated to use the current PSP tables, so PSP search rules and templates are now created correctly during demo data setup.

hotfixes.title: A race condition could cause payment exports to fail when a background session hadn’t yet committed a Request ID Entry.
hotfixes.summary: A race condition could cause payment exports to fail when a background session hadn’t yet committed a Request ID Entry. A retry mechanism now polls for the record with limited attempts and exits gracefully if it’s still unavailable. Applies to all supported bank integrations.

hotfixes.title: When an authentication was shared from one bank to a sibling bank in the same company, the operation silently did nothing.
hotfixes.summary: When an authentication was shared from one bank to a sibling bank in the same company, the operation silently did nothing. No confirmation was shown, the target bank's authentication fields were not copied, and the Active Bank System list and Bank Acc. Com . Setup on linked bank accounts were not configured. A confirmation dialog now appears, and on confirmation the target bank is populated correctly, the shared bank system is mirrored, and every linked bank account is configured for the shared

hotfixes.title: Opening the Bank System Setup wizard could fail with a hard error when a bank account referenced an asynchronous status entry that no longer existed o
hotfixes.summary: Opening the Bank System Setup wizard could fail with a hard error when a bank account referenced an asynchronous status entry that no longer existed on Continia Online. When this occurred, the following error occurred: * Status entry id '' was not found The wizard now silently recovers from this scenario. Orphaned local request entries are automatically marked as StatusEntryIdNotFound and skipped on subsequent polls. A telemetry event (0020, functional area Authentication) is emitted with EntryI

hotfixes.title: Closing a bank communication sub‑wizard (BANKSapi EBICS, BANKSapi, or Rabobank) with the close button previously discarded the setup.
hotfixes.summary: Closing a bank communication sub‑wizard (BANKSapi EBICS, BANKSapi, or Rabobank) with the close button previously discarded the setup. Both Finish and close now save the configuration.

hotfixes.title: Setting default communication for a bank account could fail with a The page has been updated error when the bank system had account statement communic
hotfixes.summary: Setting default communication for a bank account could fail with a The page has been updated error when the bank system had account statement communication configured. The account statement uniqueness enforcement is now deferred to run after the cursor loop completes, avoiding the version conflict while preserving the business rule.

hotfixes.title: The Bank Card page did not display bank-specific communication agreement groups (such as Signer ID/User No., Company ID, Certificate Holder, and Agree
hotfixes.summary: The Bank Card page did not display bank-specific communication agreement groups (such as Signer ID/User No., Company ID, Certificate Holder, and Agreement No.) when a bank was configured with only manual communication. The visibility logic now includes bothdirect and manual communication types, so the agreement field groups are correctly shown.

hotfixes.title: Structured remittance information was not generated during payment file creation because the MoreThanOneEntryFound parameter was always evaluated as f
hotfixes.summary: Structured remittance information was not generated during payment file creation because the MoreThanOneEntryFound parameter was always evaluated as false in the calling procedure. The var keyword has been added to the parameter on GetCustomerLedgerEntry and GetVendorLedgerEntry , so the value is now passed back to the caller. Structured remittance advice is now correctly included in the payment file when multiple ledger entries are found.

hotfixes.title: Regulatory reporting codes were included in payment export files even when the Regulatory Reporting field was set to Inactive in the payment validatio
hotfixes.summary: Regulatory reporting codes were included in payment export files even when the Regulatory Reporting field was set to Inactive in the payment validation. This could cause payment files to be rejected. For example, in domestic SE-to-SE BG payments, the code was still included despite the inactive setting. The regulatory reporting code is now correctly excluded from the payment file when regulatory reporting is Inactive.

hotfixes.title: Payments were created even when the vendor balance was 0 on the due date.
hotfixes.summary: Payments were created even when the vendor balance was 0 on the due date. A new Exclude Vendors without Due Balance option has been added to the Suggest Vendor Payments request page and to Payment Suggestion Templates. When enabled, vendors with a zero or positive overall balance are skipped. The default is off.

hotfixes.title: The Direct Debit Mandate ID was automatically filled on sales invoices without setting the corresponding customer bank account.
hotfixes.summary: The Direct Debit Mandate ID was automatically filled on sales invoices without setting the corresponding customer bank account. This has been corrected.

hotfixes.title: Remittance advice text generated from a Remittance Information Pattern could exceed the payment method’s maximum line length, and line breaks could in
hotfixes.summary: Remittance advice text generated from a Remittance Information Pattern could exceed the payment method’s maximum line length, and line breaks could introduce leading spaces. Lines are now truncated and marked with ..., and leading spaces after line breaks are removed.

hotfixes.title: The Update Posting Date function removed payment discount amounts from payment suggestion lines even when the new posting date still fell within the d
hotfixes.summary: The Update Posting Date function removed payment discount amounts from payment suggestion lines even when the new posting date still fell within the discount period. It is now possible to use a fixed Posting Date together with the Find Payment Discounts option, and the discount values are correctly recalculated and prefilled based on the specified posting date.

hotfixes.title: Opening a payment reference template that contained a Modulus 7-3-1 Control No.
hotfixes.summary: Opening a payment reference template that contained a Modulus 7-3-1 Control No. placeholder crashed the CTS-CB Banking Template page. When this occurred, the following error occurred: * The value "." can't be evaluated into type Integer A non-numeric input guard has been added to the Modulus 7-3-1 calculation, so placeholder characters are now handled gracefully. The Banking Template page opens and displays correctly, and affected records can be deleted.

hotfixes.title: When payment files were exported, the Name 2 field from the vendor or customer was not included in the generated banking export files.
hotfixes.summary: When payment files were exported, the Name 2 field from the vendor or customer was not included in the generated banking export files. The Creditor Name 2 and Debtor Name 2 fields are now included in the inhouse file generation.

hotfixes.title: Vendor ledger entries marked as On Hold were incorrectly included in the payment journal when the Create Payment action was used on the Vendor Ledger
hotfixes.summary: Vendor ledger entries marked as On Hold were incorrectly included in the payment journal when the Create Payment action was used on the Vendor Ledger Entries page. The general journal creation handling now respects the On Hold status, and a new Create Suggestion action provides a Continia Banking-specific payment suggestion workflow directly from the ledger entries.

hotfixes.title: When importing PSP payment files into the Cash Receipt Journal , lines with the same description but opposite signs were incorrectly grouped together.
hotfixes.summary: When importing PSP payment files into the Cash Receipt Journal , lines with the same description but opposite signs were incorrectly grouped together. When the amounts summed to 0, the grouped line could not be used to automatically settle the corresponding sales invoice and credit invoice separately. The grouping logic now keeps positive and negative amount lines separate when their sum would equal 0.

hotfixes.title: The Payment Allocation setup entry was displayed at the top level of the Manual Setup page instead of under Banking Export Setup .
hotfixes.summary: The Payment Allocation setup entry was displayed at the top level of the Manual Setup page instead of under Banking Export Setup . The entry has been moved to the correct location.

hotfixes.title: Approval functionality failed due to a reference to an obsoleted Document Capture table that is no longer available.
hotfixes.summary: Approval functionality failed due to a reference to an obsoleted Document Capture table that is no longer available. The record reference has been updated to point to the correct table, and permission checks in the Approval Management codeunit and the Applied Entries Part page have been enhanced.

hotfixes.title: Improved validation rules by adding scope to prevent ambiguity between payment entry and remittance fields.
hotfixes.summary: Improved validation rules by adding scope to prevent ambiguity between payment entry and remittance fields.

hotfixes.title: Yapily payment exports for UK/GB bank accounts returned without an IBAN were not matched, so accounts silently missed their Yapily Account ID and subs
hotfixes.summary: Yapily payment exports for UK/GB bank accounts returned without an IBAN were not matched, so accounts silently missed their Yapily Account ID and subsequent statement retrieval failed. UK/GB bank accounts are now matched on Bank Branch No. and Bank Account No. (sort code and account number) when no IBAN is present.

hotfixes.title: Improved captions and tooltips for payment suggestion filtering options.
hotfixes.summary: Improved captions and tooltips for payment suggestion filtering options.

hotfixes.title: Added template-based completion for payment suggestions and resolved conflicting settings.
hotfixes.summary: Added template-based completion for payment suggestions and resolved conflicting settings.

hotfixes.title: Replaced legacy extensibility with structured buffer-based approach.
hotfixes.summary: Replaced legacy extensibility with structured buffer-based approach.

hotfixes.title: The Substring transformation type could be selected on a transformation rule linked to a payment reference rule, even though the same functionality is
hotfixes.summary: The Substring transformation type could be selected on a transformation rule linked to a payment reference rule, even though the same functionality is available directly on the rule. A validation now prevents this selection and raises a field validation error if the Substring type is selected in this context.

hotfixes.title: Fixed localization handling for Change Statement ID action.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed localization handling for Change Statement ID action.

hotfixes.title: The Copy VAT Setup to Jnl.
hotfixes.summary: The Copy VAT Setup to Jnl. Line setting on the Payment Reconciliation Journal was not respected during posting. The setting is now applied correctly.

hotfixes.title: Processing direct debit returns failed when a partner Banking extension was installed alongside the Continia Banking module.
hotfixes.summary: Processing direct debit returns failed when a partner Banking extension was installed alongside the Continia Banking module. The customer ledger entry lookup now filters on the correct entry number, and the event binding of the CTS-PI DD Return Unapply Sub codeunit has been corrected so that it subscribes at the appropriate time.

hotfixes.title: When unapplying invoice and payment entries through Process Pending Direct Debit Returns in the Payment Reconciliation Journal or Bank Account Reconci
hotfixes.summary: When unapplying invoice and payment entries through Process Pending Direct Debit Returns in the Payment Reconciliation Journal or Bank Account Reconciliation , the required VAT adjustment reversal entries were not created. VAT entries and general ledger entries are now generated consistently, regardless of whether the unapply is performed manually or through direct debit return processing.

hotfixes.title: The Balance Last Statement field on the bank account reconciliation was incorrectly updated when bank account statements were imported.
hotfixes.summary: The Balance Last Statement field on the bank account reconciliation was incorrectly updated when bank account statements were imported. The field could be overridden with 0 when the imported file contained no balance data, and it was also modified when multiple statements were imported into the same reconciliation. The import process now preserves the Balance Last Statement value: balance fields are no longer overwritten when the file contains no balance data, and subsequent imports into the sam

hotfixes.title: When importing bank statement files without balance information (for example, CAMT.053 files without balance nodes), the Balance Last Statement field
hotfixes.summary: When importing bank statement files without balance information (for example, CAMT.053 files without balance nodes), the Balance Last Statement field on the Bank Acc. Reconciliation was incorrectly overridden with 0. The import logic now preserves existing balance values from the bank account when the file does not contain balance data. The fix applies to manual import, multiple statement import with aggregated periods, and automated import using job queues.

hotfixes.title: The statement date was not shown when bank account statements were imported without balance data.
hotfixes.summary: The statement date was not shown when bank account statements were imported without balance data. The import logic now correctly preserves existing balance field values when the imported file does not contain balance data.

hotfixes.title: Date and time values from imported bank files were stored with incorrect dates.
hotfixes.summary: Date and time values from imported bank files were stored with incorrect dates. ISO 8601 datetime strings without timezone indicators (for example, 2026-03-06T23:59:00) from CAMT.053 or CAMT.054 files were shifted by the session timezone offset, resulting in wrong booking dates. Datetime values from imported bank files are now parsed without applying the session timezone offset.

hotfixes.title: Bank transactions imported from Yapily could appear as duplicates on the Bank Account Reconciliation page, because Yapily's API returns a rolling wind
hotfixes.summary: Bank transactions imported from Yapily could appear as duplicates on the Bank Account Reconciliation page, because Yapily's API returns a rolling window of transactions that overlaps with previously imported data. The duplicate detection logic has been corrected: already-imported transactions are now identified and skipped, since the transaction hash used for duplicate detection is now available at the time the check is performed.

hotfixes.title: The label for the transactionHash value in the allow to import check on Yapily has been corrected.
hotfixes.summary: The label for the transactionHash value in the allow to import check on Yapily has been corrected.

hotfixes.title: Payment status import could match a disabled Bank Account Communication Setup when looking up the setup from the Payment Register, preventing the corr
hotfixes.summary: Payment status import could match a disabled Bank Account Communication Setup when looking up the setup from the Payment Register, preventing the correct fallback lookup from being used. The GetBankAccountCommSetupFromRegister procedure now filters on Enabled = true , so only active communication setups are considered.

hotfixes.title: A demo app setup limitation created only one authentication entry for multiple bank systems.
hotfixes.summary: A demo app setup limitation created only one authentication entry for multiple bank systems. The setup now iterates over all active bank systems and uses the provided bank system code directly.

hotfixes.title: Continia Banking Demo app (28.0.2) issues with data, setup, and authentication have been fixed, with updated BC 28 compatibility and translations.
hotfixes.summary: Continia Banking Demo app (28.0.2) issues with data, setup, and authentication have been fixed, with updated BC 28 compatibility and translations.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the PSP Agreement Setup page showed assisted setup and video notification banners that were not related to PSP payment processing
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the PSP Agreement Setup page showed assisted setup and video notification banners that were not related to PSP payment processing. The unrelated notifications have been removed, while the assisted setup and video links remain available on more relevant pages.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where payment status import could match a disabled bank account communication setup, preventing the correct fallback lookup.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where payment status import could match a disabled bank account communication setup, preventing the correct fallback lookup. This occurred when multiple communication setups existed for the same bank account and bank system code and one or more were disabled. Only active communication setups are now considered, ensuring the fallback lookup works as expected.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Bank Card page did not show bank-specific communication agreement groups for banks using manual communication, such as Nordea
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Bank Card page did not show bank-specific communication agreement groups for banks using manual communication, such as Nordea. The visibility logic only checked direct communication types, which hid required fields. The logic now supports both direct and manual communication types, so the required agreement fields are displayed correctly.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where setting default communication for a bank account could fail with a The page has been updated error when account statement communi
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where setting default communication for a bank account could fail with a The page has been updated error when account statement communication was configured on the bank system. The account statement uniqueness check now runs after the cursor loop completes, avoiding the version conflict while preserving the business rule.

hotfixes.title: Fixed a race condition where payment exports could fail when reading a request ID entry record that had not yet been committed by a background session
hotfixes.summary: Fixed a race condition where payment exports could fail when reading a request ID entry record that had not yet been committed by a background session. This could affect payment export, authentication confirmation, and status update flows across all supported bank integrations.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where sharing an authentication to a sibling bank in the same company did not trigger any action.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where sharing an authentication to a sibling bank in the same company did not trigger any action. No confirmation was shown, authentication fields were not copied, and related bank configurations were not applied. A confirmation dialog is now displayed, and upon confirmation the authentication details, active bank systems, and linked bank account setups are correctly copied to the target bank.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where date and time values from imported bank files were stored with incorrect dates.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where date and time values from imported bank files were stored with incorrect dates. ISO 8601 datetime values without time zone indicators from CAMT.053 or CAMT.054 files were incorrectly adjusted by the session time zone offset, resulting in wrong booking dates. Datetime values are now parsed exactly as provided in the file, without applying a time zone offset.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where bank transactions imported from Yapily could appear as duplicates on the Bank Account Reconciliation page.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where bank transactions imported from Yapily could appear as duplicates on the Bank Account Reconciliation page. Because the Yapily API returns overlapping transaction data, previously imported transactions could be re-imported. Duplicate detection has been corrected so existing transactions are identified and skipped during import.

hotfixes.title: Added a new option, Exclude Vendors With no Amount due , on the Suggest Vendor Payments request page.
hotfixes.summary: Added a new option, Exclude Vendors With no Amount due , on the Suggest Vendor Payments request page. When enabled, vendors whose overall balance shows they do not owe you money are skipped during payment suggestion. This prevents unnecessary payment lines from being created for vendors with a zero or positive balance. The option is also available in Payment Suggestion Templates . The default is off, so existing behavior is unchanged unless the option is enabled.

hotfixes.summary: Fixed a permission error on the Continia Payment page caused by missing read access to a Document Capture table when records were present. The required permission is now included.

hotfixes.summary: When creating a vendor using the Create Vendor guide in the document journal, the address is now formatted according to the order of the words recognized in the document. Previously, the address was always formatted according to Danish standards.

hotfixes.title: When a user changed the OCR settings on the Document Category Card , the following error could appear
hotfixes.summary: When a user changed the OCR settings on the Document Category Card , the following error could appear: It was not possible to retrieve the Continia File Service access token.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when recognizing a document, an error could occur if the recognized currency code was the same as the local currency (LCY).
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when recognizing a document, an error could occur if the recognized currency code was the same as the local currency (LCY). Now, the currency code is only populated in the Currency Code template header field if it differs from LCY – and if Fill-out LCY (a hidden field) is enabled in the Document Capture Setup .

hotfixes.title: This change only applies to the CH (Swiss) localization.
hotfixes.summary: This change only applies to the CH (Swiss) localization. Previously, when a vendor bank account was created using a QR code, certain account details were automatically populated from the bank directory based on the value in the Clearing No. field. As a result, the Suggested Swiss SEPA CT Export Payment Type field on the Vendor Bank Account Card was set to 2.2. Now, the Clearing No. field remains empty to ensure that the Suggested Swiss SEPA CT Export Payment Type is correctly set to 3.

hotfixes.title: When registering a document using the Force Register action, only the accounts configured through template header fields were applied in the created p
hotfixes.summary: When registering a document using the Force Register action, only the accounts configured through template header fields were applied in the created purchase invoice. The accounts entered through Accounts for Amounts were ignored, resulting in no lines being created for those amounts.

hotfixes.title: When a vendor had a single template that was blocked, the blocked template was still used when importing a new document – resulting in the following e
hotfixes.summary: When a vendor had a single template that was blocked, the blocked template was still used when importing a new document – resulting in the following error: The field Template No. of table Document contains a value (<Template No.>) that cannot be found in the related table (Template).

hotfixes.title: Previously, manually entering lowercase values in a template header or line field of type lookup could cause validation issues during registration.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, manually entering lowercase values in a template header or line field of type lookup could cause validation issues during registration. Now, all values in lookup fields are automatically converted to uppercase – ensuring that only validated values are stored.

hotfixes.title: If File Service was set as the document storage type on the Document Capture Setup page and a file with a filename exceeding 100 characters was import
hotfixes.summary: If File Service was set as the document storage type on the Document Capture Setup page and a file with a filename exceeding 100 characters was imported, document categories became inaccessible – and the following error message appeared: The length of the string is <Length>, but it must be less then or equal to 100 characters. Value: <File Name> To prevent this from occurring, the maximum filename length has been increased to the highest value a field can have.

hotfixes.title: In the Document Capture Setup and on the Purchase Approval page, the Allow Force Approval setting could not be disabled once it was enabled.
hotfixes.summary: In the Document Capture Setup and on the Purchase Approval page, the Allow Force Approval setting could not be disabled once it was enabled.

hotfixes.summary: When drilling down on the Approval Shared with this User field in the User Setup by Company page, the following error could appear: The length of the string is <Length>, but it must be less than or equal to 80 characters. Value: <Value>

hotfixes.title: Previously, the filtered view My Open Approvals on the cross-company dashboard in the Web Approval Portal incorrectly showed all approvals as being ow
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the filtered view My Open Approvals on the cross-company dashboard in the Web Approval Portal incorrectly showed all approvals as being owned by the same approver. Now, the Owner field correctly displays the original approval owner.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the import/export configuration data functionality on the Data subpage in the Set Up Document Capture guide only supported a two-level tre
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the import/export configuration data functionality on the Data subpage in the Set Up Document Capture guide only supported a two-level tree view. The subpage has now been updated to support a three-level tree view. Additionally, the Include field previously applied changes only to the selected record and its immediate child records. Now, selecting or deselecting it applies the change to all child levels (2nd and 3rd) of the selected record.

hotfixes.summary: When using the Export Attachments function with the Export Related Documents option enabled, drag-and-drop attachments from the following documents were not included: Unregistered documents Posted purchase invoices Posted credit memos

hotfixes.title: When creating a purchase contract using the Create Purchase Contract guide in the document journal or on the document card, contract lines were incorr
hotfixes.summary: When creating a purchase contract using the Create Purchase Contract guide in the document journal or on the document card, contract lines were incorrectly created if a purchase contract was already set on the document as an account type – or configured in Accounts for Amounts . Now, the Create Purchase Contract action is disabled if a purchase contract is already selected on the document or set in Accounts for Amounts .

hotfixes.title: The following approval functionality fields are now only visible on the Purchase Contracts page if purchase contract approval is enabled: Approval Sta
hotfixes.summary: The following approval functionality fields are now only visible on the Purchase Contracts page if purchase contract approval is enabled: Approval Status Approval Frequency Next Approval Date

hotfixes.title: When enabling Check for Attachment Before Posting in the Document Capture Setup or Expense Management Setup , attempting to post a payment journal lin
hotfixes.summary: When enabling Check for Attachment Before Posting in the Document Capture Setup or Expense Management Setup , attempting to post a payment journal line with a document type of payment or refund would result in the following error message: It is mandatory to have either an incoming document, a Document Capture file or an Expense Management attachment associated with a vendor-related general journal.

hotfixes.title: When sending an electronic documents depending on an XML structure extension, the code list values in the extending XML structure were not correctly f
hotfixes.summary: When sending an electronic documents depending on an XML structure extension, the code list values in the extending XML structure were not correctly filled out, causing the document to be invalid.

hotfixes.title: When opening the XML Structure References page from Continia eDocuments Setup > XML Structures > Code Lists , many duplicate records were displayed.
hotfixes.summary: When opening the XML Structure References page from Continia eDocuments Setup > XML Structures > Code Lists , many duplicate records were displayed. Now, the page only shows unique records. Additionally, the XML Structure References page is now non-editable.

hotfixes.title: When calculating the eBilling line item price, Base Quantity was previously derived from the sales line's Quantity (Base) field, and Price Amount was
hotfixes.summary: When calculating the eBilling line item price, Base Quantity was previously derived from the sales line's Quantity (Base) field, and Price Amount was calculated by multiplying Quantity (Base) by the Unit Price . Base Quantity is now always set to 1, and Price Amount directly reflects the unit price of a single item. This ensures consistent unit-based pricing in eBilling processes, simplifying calculations and aligning with expected billing standards.

hotfixes.title: It's now possible to send an XRechnung or A-NZ Peppol invoice or credit note with a tax amount of 0 (zero).
hotfixes.summary: It's now possible to send an XRechnung or A-NZ Peppol invoice or credit note with a tax amount of 0 (zero).

hotfixes.title: Previously, the Default Value column on the XML Structure View page contained many irrelevant values.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the Default Value column on the XML Structure View page contained many irrelevant values. It now displays only necessary data.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when Prices Including VAT was enabled in a sales invoice, credit memo, or purchase order, the generated eDocument was invalid.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when Prices Including VAT was enabled in a sales invoice, credit memo, or purchase order, the generated eDocument was invalid. Now, eDocuments created from sales invoices, credit memos, and purchase orders with VAT-inclusive pricing are correctly structured and valid.

hotfixes.summary: When sending a change for a purchase order containing lines with a VAT amount of 0 (zero), the electronic document failed validation in the Peppol Network – and the following error was displayed: Each Tax Category MUST have a TAX category rate, except if the order is not subject to TAX.

hotfixes.title: When sending a sales invoice with a line that includes a 100% line discount, the eDocument was previously created with a negative quantity for that li
hotfixes.summary: When sending a sales invoice with a line that includes a 100% line discount, the eDocument was previously created with a negative quantity for that line. The quantity in the eDocument is now correctly aligned with the posted sales invoice line, ensuring consistency between the invoice and the generated document.

hotfixes.title: When using the Mark as Unprocessed action on the Network Documents page, the eDocument is now reassigned to the document category specified in the par
hotfixes.summary: When using the Mark as Unprocessed action on the Network Documents page, the eDocument is now reassigned to the document category specified in the participation profile. This allows users to reprocess and import the document with a different category, providing greater flexibility in document handling.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when an item had a GTIN filled out, the generated eDocument incorrectly assigned the value 0088 to the Scheme ID attribute under the XML p
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when an item had a GTIN filled out, the generated eDocument incorrectly assigned the value 0088 to the Scheme ID attribute under the XML path //cac:Item/cac:StandardItemIdentification/cbc:ID/@schemeID . Now, the correct value (0160) is assigned.

hotfixes.summary: When Document Storage Type in Document Capture Setup was set to File Service and Process PDF files with XML Files on the document category was enabled, importing ZUGFeRD files could fail because the XML file path was not created when no TIFF file was present. The import now uses the correct temporary file path for XML/CXML files, so the MetaDoc file path is created and ZUGFeRD imports work as expected.

hotfixes.title: When an incoming XML document contained more than one embedded file, such as two PDF attachments, only the first file was attached in the Document Jou
hotfixes.summary: When an incoming XML document contained more than one embedded file, such as two PDF attachments, only the first file was attached in the Document Journal . This occurred when embedded files had no file name in the XML document. They were treated as duplicates and skipped. Each embedded file now receives a unique name. All files are available under XML Attachments in the Document menu on the Document Card .

hotfixes.title: The FA(3) KSeF document viewer now displays the invoice currency in the Do zapłaty and Do rozliczenia fields.
hotfixes.summary: The FA(3) KSeF document viewer now displays the invoice currency in the Do zapłaty and Do rozliczenia fields. Previously, these fields always displayed PLN , regardless of the invoice currency. This could result in incorrect currency information for foreign-currency invoices.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the DK prefix to 0184 (DK
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the DK prefix to 0184 (DK:DIGST) identifiers was automatically added when sending eDocuments, which caused deliveries to fail for participants whose registered identifier did not include the prefix. Now, when the Recipient Type is set to Other in Continia Customer Setup , the Recipient ID Value is used exactly as entered, that is, the DK prefix is no longer added automatically.

hotfixes.title: Previously, sending a sales invoice or credit memo with a fixed asset line could mark the eDocument as Not Valid .
hotfixes.summary: Previously, sending a sales invoice or credit memo with a fixed asset line could mark the eDocument as Not Valid . The generated line was missing a name and unit of measure. During eDocument generation, the line name now uses the fixed asset description. It falls back to the sales line description when needed. Unit of measure values use code list translations or the international standard code. They fall back to EA when unavailable.

hotfixes.title: Previously, exported electronic documents used the customer GLN in delivery details.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, exported electronic documents used the customer GLN in delivery details. This also occurred when a ship-to address had its own GLN. The ship-to GLN is now used when available. The customer GLN remains the fallback when no ship-to GLN exists.

hotfixes.title: When exporting XML documents, IssueDate previously used the posting date instead of the document date.
hotfixes.summary: When exporting XML documents, IssueDate previously used the posting date instead of the document date. IssueDate now defaults to the document date for eBilling and XML exports. An integration event can override this default.

hotfixes.summary: When the amount including VAT on a purchase allocation differs from the total amount including VAT on the corresponding purchase invoice due to rounding, the rounding difference is now automatically distributed proportionally across the allocation lines. This applies when Allow VAT Difference is enabled in Purchases & Payables Setup and the difference falls within the threshold defined by Maximum Allowed Difference Incl. VAT in General Ledger Setup .

Payments are now reported with their full amount, including VAT.

It's now exposed again as a global procedure, this time on the CDC CDN Document Mgt. codeunit, enabling extending apps to call it as before.

The following now applies: Having multiple comment lines in the business document could lead to multiple instances of the Note class in the xml file. This would be flagged as either a warning or error when sending the document. Comment lines were never exported on sales credit memos.

hotfixes.summary: Invalid credit memos could be generated if the Ship-to Name field in Company Information was not populated.

hotfixes.summary: The eDocument Status field was only available on posted service document cards, not on the Posted Service Invoices and Posted Service Credit Memos list pages. This meant that the status of a sent service invoice or service credit memo could only be checked by opening each posted document. The eDocument Status field has now been added to both list pages, where it shows the current status of the related eDocument. Selecting the status opens the related eDocuments, just as on the other posted docum

hotfixes.version: Continia Document Capture 2026 R1, Service Pack 5
hotfixes.title: In some cases, clicking the Documents to Import tile in the Document Capture role center caused the following error
hotfixes.summary: In some cases, clicking the Documents to Import tile in the Document Capture role center caused the following error: Sorry, the current permissions prevented the action. (TableData 6086229 CTS-CDN Document Modify: Continia Delivery Network).

hotfixes.version: Continia Document Capture 2026 R1, Service Pack 5
hotfixes.title: When an incoming XML document contained more than one embedded file (e.g.
hotfixes.summary: When an incoming XML document contained more than one embedded file (e.g.: two PDF attachments in an XML document), only the first file was attached to the document in the document journal. This occurred when embedded files didn't contain a filename in the XML document, and were therefore skipped as duplicates of the first one. Each embedded file is now given a unique name, and all of them are available under XML Attachments in the Document dropdown on the document card.

hotfixes.version: Continia Document Capture 2026 R1, Service Pack 5
hotfixes.title: Updated the jQuery library from version 2.1.4 to 3.7.1 to ensure Document Capture runs on a secure, and supported version.
hotfixes.summary: Updated the jQuery library from version 2.1.4 to 3.7.1 to ensure Document Capture runs on a secure, and supported version.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1, Service Pack 4, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When trying to send a lifecycle update document in the CDAR format for the PA France network, the following error was displayed: The sender role is mi
hotfixes.summary: When trying to send a lifecycle update document in the CDAR format for the PA France network, the following error was displayed: The sender role is missing for the document type Application Response in the network profile France CDAR.

hotfixes.title: For French invoices using Special Payer Type = Seller Agent , including USECASE-19A, UBL-FR output could swap the seller and agent.
hotfixes.summary: For French invoices using Special Payer Type = Seller Agent , including USECASE-19A, UBL-FR output could swap the seller and agent. The seller now remains in AccountingSupplierParty . The agent is added to AccountingSupplierParty/Party/AgentParty . PaymentMeans/PaymentMandate/PayerParty is no longer populated in this case.

hotfixes.title: On the eReporting Filters page, the Filter Expression column now displays readable field names rather than internal field numbers, such as Field70 .
hotfixes.summary: On the eReporting Filters page, the Filter Expression column now displays readable field names rather than internal field numbers, such as Field70 .

hotfixes.title: French eReporting Flow 10.2 now reports payments received from customers on international B2B sales invoices.
hotfixes.summary: French eReporting Flow 10.2 now reports payments received from customers on international B2B sales invoices. Vendor payments and vendor filters are no longer included. Payment reporting under Flow 10.2 is only required for sellers.

hotfixes.title: French eReporting now captures references correctly during release.
hotfixes.summary: French eReporting now captures references correctly during release. Settlements without general ledger entries are retained. Posting previews no longer register references. Captured references are limited to the selected reporting country's report types. Declarant Role now displays BY and SE .

hotfixes.title: You can now combine report types in an eReport Group .
hotfixes.summary: You can now combine report types in an eReport Group . Automatic reference processing then creates one shared eReport per period. All report types in a group must use the same period length. You cannot change a group while an associated eReport remains unsent.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the Capture Only Match setting on field rules was not enforced when processing eDocuments.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the Capture Only Match setting on field rules was not enforced when processing eDocuments. Fields could be populated when captured values did not match the rule's pattern, such as a six-digit order number.

hotfixes.title: Previously, entering the first letters in the Account Type field on the document header could cause autocomplete to select an incorrect value in the D
hotfixes.summary: Previously, entering the first letters in the Account Type field on the document header could cause autocomplete to select an incorrect value in the Document Journal .

hotfixes.title: Previously, a document registered through a General Journal with the G/L Documents category was marked as Registered without linking to the resulting
hotfixes.summary: Previously, a document registered through a General Journal with the G/L Documents category was marked as Registered without linking to the resulting G/L entry. The document was only available through the Registered filter in the Document Journal , not from the related General Ledger Entries .

hotfixes.title: When multiple vendors had the same VAT Registration No.
hotfixes.summary: When multiple vendors had the same VAT Registration No. , the vendor identified during document import could differ from the vendor identified by Recognize Fields .

hotfixes.title: Previously, description-only lines did not create comment lines when purchase documents arrived through the Continia Delivery Network.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, description-only lines did not create comment lines when purchase documents arrived through the Continia Delivery Network.

hotfixes.title: Previously, field recognition was not triggered after a document moved to another company during import or batch processing.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, field recognition was not triggered after a document moved to another company during import or batch processing. The document remained unrecognized in the receiving company's Document Journal .

hotfixes.title: Generated eDocument XML is now valid for invoices with a 100% invoice discount.
hotfixes.summary: Generated eDocument XML is now valid for invoices with a 100% invoice discount. The eDocument no longer remains in the Not Valid status.

hotfixes.title: When registering an incoming PEPPOL Order Response against a purchase order using a Document Capture template set to Update Order , the promised deliv
hotfixes.summary: When registering an incoming PEPPOL Order Response against a purchase order using a Document Capture template set to Update Order , the promised delivery date now updates Promised Receipt Date on the purchase order header and lines. You can also use Create Template Field to add the value to the template and purchase order.

hotfixes.title: Party sections for Dutch suppliers and customers now use the KVK or OIN value in Registration No.
hotfixes.summary: Party sections for Dutch suppliers and customers now use the KVK or OIN value in Registration No. consistently. If the value is blank or invalid, the related party identification elements are omitted from generated XML.

hotfixes.title: The eReporting XML structure configuration now generates files that validate against official French eReporting rules.
hotfixes.summary: The eReporting XML structure configuration now generates files that validate against official French eReporting rules.

hotfixes.title: When posting a document with a Seller Agent scenario flow, Scenario Hdr.
hotfixes.summary: When posting a document with a Seller Agent scenario flow, Scenario Hdr. Value now transfers independently of record coding values when it contains a special payer type. The Seller Agent special party is preserved and included in UBL-FR exports.

hotfixes.title: XML structures can no longer extend themselves, directly or indirectly.
hotfixes.summary: XML structures can no longer extend themselves, directly or indirectly. The XML Structure Code Extension field now validates circular extension chains and shows a clear error.

hotfixes.title: OIOUBL sales invoices and credit memos now require a resolvable contact identifier and name before posting.
hotfixes.summary: OIOUBL sales invoices and credit memos now require a resolvable contact identifier and name before posting. Salesperson data is no longer used as contact information. This behavior is consistent across formats.

hotfixes.title: Previously, on-premises installations could not configure authentication after selecting Azure Blob Storage as the Document Storage Type in the Set Up
hotfixes.summary: Previously, on-premises installations could not configure authentication after selecting Azure Blob Storage as the Document Storage Type in the Set Up Document Capture guide. The guide now shows the configuration status, provides access to authentication settings, and validates the settings before completion. For more information, see Setting up Azure Blob Storage .

hotfixes.title: Previously, receipt matching enforced the vendor shipment number when Match Vendor Shipment No.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, receipt matching enforced the vendor shipment number when Match Vendor Shipment No. was set to No , if the document header contained a value. Receipts that should match open purchase orders could remain unmatched.

hotfixes.title: Document lines now match posted purchase receipts and return shipments correctly when Base Unit Cost Matching is enabled and the purchase line uses a
hotfixes.summary: Document lines now match posted purchase receipts and return shipments correctly when Base Unit Cost Matching is enabled and the purchase line uses a non-base unit of measure. Matching against open purchase orders was unaffected.

hotfixes.title: When matching posted purchase receipts or return shipments with a non-base unit of measure, Direct Unit Cost (Base) (Order) and Matched Quantity could
hotfixes.summary: When matching posted purchase receipts or return shipments with a non-base unit of measure, Direct Unit Cost (Base) (Order) and Matched Quantity could display or validate incorrectly. This could cause false cost variances or prevent valid quantities from matching.

Identification fields and values: Header Table No.='0',Header Type='0',Document No.='',Document Line No.='0',Entry No.='0' .

hotfixes.summary: Previously, when sending an eDocument with the scenario framework installed, the document could fail validation.

hotfixes.summary: Several changes and improvements have been made to French (FR) eReporting, including how amounts and VAT are reported, how customer and vendor payments and their dates are determined, and which posted transactions are included in the declaration. The Reopen action is now only available for approved eReports, this action returns the eReport to the Ready for Approval status instead of New .

hotfixes.title: Previously, French UBL (FR UBL) invoices containing comment lines could fail validation with VAT category-related errors because the comment lines wer
hotfixes.summary: Previously, French UBL (FR UBL) invoices containing comment lines could fail validation with VAT category-related errors because the comment lines were exported without a TaxCategoryID .

hotfixes.title: Support for French (FR) functionality in Belgian (French) localizations has been improved.
hotfixes.summary: Support for French (FR) functionality in Belgian (French) localizations has been improved. The French configuration is now available in Belgian (French) localizations. Previously, standard FR UBL invoices could be rendered incorrectly by the stylesheet. The stylesheet now renders standard FR UBL invoices correctly.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, the payable amount on sales credit memos could be calculated as double its actual value, resulting in an invalid XML file. The payable amount is now calculated and exported correctly.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, the Scenario Flow field was not available on sales orders and purchase orders, preventing the correct French eInvoicing scenario from being assigned during posting. The Scenario Flow field is now available on both document types.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, users with only the CTS-CDN Basic permission set could not open the vendor card.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, opening the Display Documents page could result in the following error if one or more documents had an empty OCR-Processed Date field: The date is not valid. Page Display Documents has to close.

hotfixes.title: Previously, registering Czech advance letters could clear the Bank Account No.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, registering Czech advance letters could clear the Bank Account No. field when no vendor bank account was captured. Existing bank account information is now preserved during validation.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when a document was moved to another company, the Register Documents Automatically setting from the receiving company's template or docume
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when a document was moved to another company, the Register Documents Automatically setting from the receiving company's template or document category was not applied. As a result, the document was recognized but remained open instead of being registered. This affected documents moved automatically when Auto Move to Company was enabled on the document category and the destination company was identified through Company Identification Texts , as well as documents moved manually using Mo

hotfixes.title: Previously, when configuring custom columns from the Document Category page, the values in the added columns were not updated automatically for existi
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when configuring custom columns from the Document Category page, the values in the added columns were not updated automatically for existing documents. Column values are now updated consistently, regardless of whether the columns are configured from the Document Category page or the Document Journal .

hotfixes.title: The navigation functionality when opening documents from approval entries has been restored, enabling approvers to navigate to the next and previous d
hotfixes.summary: The navigation functionality when opening documents from approval entries has been restored, enabling approvers to navigate to the next and previous documents when opening a document from an approval entry (for example, the Purchase Approval Entries page).

hotfixes.title: Previously, updating eBilling header values from the scenario flow could clear existing values that were not included in the update.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, updating eBilling header values from the scenario flow could clear existing values that were not included in the update. Existing values are now preserved unless they are part of the scenario flow.

hotfixes.title: When exporting XML documents, the IssueDate value was previously taken from the posting date instead of the document date.
hotfixes.summary: When exporting XML documents, the IssueDate value was previously taken from the posting date instead of the document date. IssueDate now defaults to the document date for both eBilling and XML exports. An integration event is available to override the default IssueDate when needed.

hotfixes.title: Previously, French e-documents (CII-FR and UBL-FR) using the Factoring Company, Third Party, or Buyer's Agent scenario flows did not export the corres
hotfixes.summary: Previously, French e-documents (CII-FR and UBL-FR) using the Factoring Company, Third Party, or Buyer's Agent scenario flows did not export the corresponding payer party information. The payer party is now included in exported documents.

hotfixes.title: Previously, exporting a Peppol eDocument from a sales document could fail when the Order No.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, exporting a Peppol eDocument from a sales document could fail when the Order No. field was populated and the External Document No. field was left empty, resulting in the following error: The content model does not allow element cbc:SalesOrderID to appear as the first child .

hotfixes.title: Previously, the pre-posting validation for OIOUBL sales documents could incorrectly require the Sell-to Contact field to be populated, preventing vali
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the pre-posting validation for OIOUBL sales documents could incorrectly require the Sell-to Contact field to be populated, preventing valid documents from being posted. The pre-posting validation now uses the same contact resolution logic as the export process by checking Sell-to Contact No. , then the customer's primary contact, and finally the salesperson. An error is only reported when no contact name can be determined.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when using the Post and Send action to send sales orders or sales invoices as e-documents, the following error could occur: The document e
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when using the Post and Send action to send sales orders or sales invoices as e-documents, the following error could occur: The document exchange service is not enabled .

hotfixes.summary: When exporting the configuration using the Set Up Document Capture guide, the following error could occur: The length of the string is [(length)], but it must be less than or equal to 150 characters. Value: [(value)] This was caused by incorrect parsing of the exported configuration fields.

hotfixes.summary: Purchaser codes longer than 10 characters could previously result in the following error when using the Create Purchase Contract action in the Document Journal:

hotfixes.title: For documents registered through the GLDOC (G/L Documents) category, opening the file list through Find Entries on a posted purchase invoice and selec
hotfixes.summary: For documents registered through the GLDOC (G/L Documents) category, opening the file list through Find Entries on a posted purchase invoice and selecting Show File could result in the following error instead of displaying the document: An error occurred while trying to display the report.

hotfixes.title: Registering a purchase prepayment document could automatically post the related purchase invoice, even when the corresponding purchase order was still
hotfixes.summary: Registering a purchase prepayment document could automatically post the related purchase invoice, even when the corresponding purchase order was still pending approval. Prepayment invoices are no longer posted until the purchase order has been approved.

hotfixes.title: When an approval flow was in use and a document was forwarded without approval to an approval administrator with an unlimited (or sufficiently high) p
hotfixes.summary: When an approval flow was in use and a document was forwarded without approval to an approval administrator with an unlimited (or sufficiently high) purchase approval limit, the following error could occur: This invoice has not been approved by an approver that can approve the full amount ([amount]). You must approve and forward it to a second approver who can approve the full amount. Approval administrators with sufficient approval authority can now approve documents, even when they are not inc

hotfixes.version: Document Capture 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: When upgrading to version 28, companies with Use Cloud OCR enabled could experience an upgrade failure with the following error: Use Cloud OCR must be
hotfixes.summary: When upgrading to version 28, companies with Use Cloud OCR enabled could experience an upgrade failure with the following error: Use Cloud OCR must be equal to 'No' in Document Capture Setup: Primary Key=. Current value is 'Yes'. The issue occurred because the upgrade process attempted to migrate legacy IMAP credentials, even though these credentials are not used when Cloud OCR is enabled. The upgrade now skips this migration and completes successfully.

hotfixes.version: Document Capture 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When a GP to Business Central cloud migration was performed in environments with Continia apps installed, the migration could fail in some cases.
hotfixes.summary: When a GP to Business Central cloud migration was performed in environments with Continia apps installed, the migration could fail in some cases. This occurred because Continia added entries to the Migration Table Mapping table without first verifying whether the migration was a GP to Business Central or a Business Central to Business Central migration. Now, Continia checks the product ID before adding custom table mappings – ensuring that GP to Business Central migrations complete successfully.

hotfixes.version: Document Capture 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Previously, the DK prefix to 0184 (DK
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the DK prefix to 0184 (DK:DIGST) identifiers was automatically added when sending eDocuments, which caused deliveries to fail for participants whose registered identifier did not include the prefix. Now, when the Recipient Type is set to Other in Continia Customer Setup , the Recipient ID Value is used exactly as entered, that is, the DK prefix is no longer added automatically.

hotfixes.title: Document actions could remain disabled after changing the Status Filter and clearing filters in the document journal.
hotfixes.summary: Document actions could remain disabled after changing the Status Filter and clearing filters in the document journal.

hotfixes.title: When the Document Storage Type field in Document Capture Setup was set to File Service and Process PDF files with XML Files in the document category w
hotfixes.summary: When the Document Storage Type field in Document Capture Setup was set to File Service and Process PDF files with XML Files in the document category was enabled, importing ZUGFeRD files could fail because the XML file path was not created when no TIFF file was present. The import now uses the correct temporary file path for XML/CXML files so the MetaDoc file path is created and ZUGFeRD imports work as expected.

hotfixes.title: The following only applies to the Spanish (ES) localization.
hotfixes.summary: The following only applies to the Spanish (ES) localization. The duplicate vendor invoice number check in the document journal now filters vendor ledger entries by document date instead of posting date, aligning with standard Business Central functionality.

hotfixes.title: When capturing document data in the document journal, template scoring could cause a template with fewer matching search texts to be selected over a m
hotfixes.summary: When capturing document data in the document journal, template scoring could cause a template with fewer matching search texts to be selected over a more suitable template. The template with the highest number of matching search texts is now selected when using Recognize Fields .

hotfixes.title: Previously, when selecting Resource or Allocation Account in the Translate to Type document line field on the document card page, the following error
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when selecting Resource or Allocation Account in the Translate to Type document line field on the document card page, the following error message could be displayed: The type <Resource/Allocation Account> is not supported in this version of Business Central.

hotfixes.title: When opening the Purchase Approval Request Entries or Purchase Contract Approval Request Entries page from Approval Entries by Approver , functionalit
hotfixes.summary: When opening the Purchase Approval Request Entries or Purchase Contract Approval Request Entries page from Approval Entries by Approver , functionality introduced in Document Capture 28.0 unintentionally removed the filters on these pages. As a result, all approval entries were displayed regardless of status or due date. The filters are now applied correctly, ensuring that only open and/or overdue approval entries are shown.

hotfixes.title: Previously, XML attachments containing tab characters in the attachment element (for example, EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject) could not be opened after
hotfixes.summary: Previously, XML attachments containing tab characters in the attachment element (for example, EmbeddedDocumentBinaryObject) could not be opened after import.

hotfixes.title: When the amount including VAT on a purchase allocation differs from the total amount including VAT on the corresponding purchase invoice due to roundi
hotfixes.summary: When the amount including VAT on a purchase allocation differs from the total amount including VAT on the corresponding purchase invoice due to rounding, the rounding difference is now automatically distributed proportionally across the allocation lines. This applies when Allow VAT Difference is enabled in Purchases & Payables Setup and the difference falls within the threshold defined by Maximum Allowed Difference Incl. VAT in General Ledger Setup . This ensures that the total of the purchase a

hotfixes.title: When entering 0 in the Retention Period (Years) or GDPR Retention Period (Years) fields in Document Capture Setup , the following error could occur: T
hotfixes.summary: When entering 0 in the Retention Period (Years) or GDPR Retention Period (Years) fields in Document Capture Setup , the following error could occur: The value must be greater than or equal to [2/5].
