hotfixes.title: Previously, when the Setup Wizard was executed multiple times, it inadvertently overrode the Output Profile settings across all documents.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when the Setup Wizard was executed multiple times, it inadvertently overrode the Output Profile settings across all documents. This issue occurred regardless of the initial configuration, leading to unintended modifications in document handling. The problem arose when users attempted to reconfigure settings using the Setup Wizard , causing the existing Output Profile to reset to default values. This has now been fixed, ensuring that the Output Profile remains consistent and unchanged

hotfixes.title: When using the Embed PDF in E-Document functionality in Output Profiles , the following errors occurred
hotfixes.summary: When using the Embed PDF in E-Document functionality in Output Profiles , the following errors occurred: - When the Embed PDF in E-Document functionality was disabled in the same session, sometimes a PDF was still embedded in the E-Document. - When the E-Mail field in Output Profiles was set to Xml (e-doc) , the PDF document was sometimes still attached.

hotfixes.title: Added the ability to include the DO Output Profile field in draft documents, such as Sales Invoice .
hotfixes.summary: Added the ability to include the DO Output Profile field in draft documents, such as Sales Invoice . The DO Output Profile field was automatically populated with the code configured on the Document Output Customer/Vendor Card . When the DO Output Profile field was active on the draft page, users could override the Output Profile without altering the customer settings. The override was posted with the document and processed accordingly.

hotfixes.title: In Customer Statement Journal > Email All , the action failed to attach certain PDF reports.
hotfixes.summary: In Customer Statement Journal > Email All , the action failed to attach certain PDF reports.

hotfixes.title: When sending statements for the first time using the Enhanced Automatic Statements feature, the period dates for the statements were calculated incorr
hotfixes.summary: When sending statements for the first time using the Enhanced Automatic Statements feature, the period dates for the statements were calculated incorrectly.

hotfixes.title: When calculating the next sending date for Automatic Statements using weekday-based sending intervals, the date was sometimes calculated incorrectly.
hotfixes.summary: When calculating the next sending date for Automatic Statements using weekday-based sending intervals, the date was sometimes calculated incorrectly.

hotfixes.title: When an output profile was created with a specified E-Document Setup Code , the email action was incorrectly set to PDF and XML (e-doc) .
hotfixes.summary: When an output profile was created with a specified E-Document Setup Code , the email action was incorrectly set to PDF and XML (e-doc) . This resulted in the document being emailed by default, which was not the intended behavior. The email action has now been changed to Skip to prevent automatic emailing.

hotfixes.title: When users attempted to use the Copy E-Mail Template Line action in E-Mail Template Card , validation occasionally prevented the selection of a valid
hotfixes.summary: When users attempted to use the Copy E-Mail Template Line action in E-Mail Template Card , validation occasionally prevented the selection of a valid language/variant combination.

hotfixes.title: When an email address exceeding 80 characters was entered in the E-Mail field within E-Mail Recipients > , the displayed value was truncated to 80 cha
hotfixes.summary: When an email address exceeding 80 characters was entered in the E-Mail field within E-Mail Recipients > , the displayed value was truncated to 80 characters.

hotfixes.title: An issue was resolved where incorrect documents were embedded in an e-document when sending multiple documents in a batch.
hotfixes.summary: An issue was resolved where incorrect documents were embedded in an e-document when sending multiple documents in a batch.

hotfixes.title: In the Customer Statement Journal , the Email All action did not attach some PDF reports.
hotfixes.summary: In the Customer Statement Journal , the Email All action did not attach some PDF reports.

hotfixes.title: When sending statements for the first time using the Enhanced Automatic Statements feature, the period dates for the statements were calculated incorr
hotfixes.summary: When sending statements for the first time using the Enhanced Automatic Statements feature, the period dates for the statements were calculated incorrectly.

hotfixes.title: For some tenants, it would sometimes revert any setup changes to the Document Output Setup Card .
hotfixes.summary: For some tenants, it would sometimes revert any setup changes to the Document Output Setup Card .

hotfixes.title: When editing a signature, merge fields incorrectly showed as %fields instead of a merge tag.
hotfixes.summary: When editing a signature, merge fields incorrectly showed as %fields instead of a merge tag.

hotfixes.title: During recipient lookup where a field of type Guid is used the following error message is shown
hotfixes.summary: During recipient lookup where a field of type Guid is used the following error message is shown: The value <Guid> is longer then the max value 16 Trying to set filter on field <Field> table <Table> From Table no. : <Table no. > field no. _<Field no. > An additional check for the Guid type has been added.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where if multiple files was attached to an email, in rare cases, there could be artifacts in one of them.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where if multiple files was attached to an email, in rare cases, there could be artifacts in one of them.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where email logs did not appear in Posted Sales Invoice > Email Log after posting sales orders.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where email logs did not appear in Posted Sales Invoice > Email Log after posting sales orders. The email log transfer process now updates the Table No. field to match the posted document, ensuring logs remain visible.

hotfixes.title: When the Amount Rounding Precision (LCY) in the General Ledger Setup was set to more than two decimal places (for example, 0.00001), generating a Pepp
hotfixes.summary: When the Amount Rounding Precision (LCY) in the General Ledger Setup was set to more than two decimal places (for example, 0.00001), generating a Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 eDocument for a posted sales invoice or credit memo could result in an invalid document that failed schematron validation. The generated eDocument now uses the PayableRoundingAmount field to correctly handle rounding differences, ensuring that the document passes validation regardless of the configured rounding precision.

hotfixes.title: Handling of double-negative line amounts during invoice processing has been improved.
hotfixes.summary: Handling of double-negative line amounts during invoice processing has been improved. The generated Peppol XML now correctly reflects the intended positive line amount, ensuring accurate output.

hotfixes.title: When automatic statement generation processed customers with zero balance using Poster i perioden (entries in period), the following error occurred: R
hotfixes.summary: When automatic statement generation processed customers with zero balance using Poster i perioden (entries in period), the following error occurred: Rapporten kunne ikke oprettes som et Pdf dokument. Customer: 02459042. Error Code: ReportResultEmpty. Error Text: Rapporten kunne ikke genereres, fordi den var tom. Juster filtrene, og prøv igen. This has now been fixed, and the batch job continues processing remaining customers instead of stopping.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where documents attached only as XML were incorrectly marked as Handled if the email sending process was canceled or abandoned.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where documents attached only as XML were incorrectly marked as Handled if the email sending process was canceled or abandoned. Now, the Handled status is only applied after all actions in the output profile are completed, including successful XML distribution and email handover, preventing documents from being stuck and ignored.

hotfixes.title: Specific Document Output functions are now disabled when the trial period ends or the subscription is canceled.
hotfixes.summary: Specific Document Output functions are now disabled when the trial period ends or the subscription is canceled. Product activation status is now checked regularly before allowing access to these functions.

hotfixes.title: When canceling the Post and Send/Print dialog on sales orders with partial deliveries, previous invoices were incorrectly sent to the customer.
hotfixes.summary: When canceling the Post and Send/Print dialog on sales orders with partial deliveries, previous invoices were incorrectly sent to the customer. The operation is now properly aborted when the posting dialog is canceled, preventing duplicate invoices for partial deliveries.

hotfixes.title: If a customer was already correctly set up on the Document Output customer card with Recipient Type set to Other and both Receiver ID Type and Receive
hotfixes.summary: If a customer was already correctly set up on the Document Output customer card with Recipient Type set to Other and both Receiver ID Type and Receiver ID populated, running the Refresh List action on the eCandidates page created an eCandidate record with status Can Connect . The eCandidate record is now correctly created with status Connected .

hotfixes.title: On on-premises installations, the Use BC Print Queue option in the Document Output Setup was unavailable due to a visibility issue, preventing printin
hotfixes.summary: On on-premises installations, the Use BC Print Queue option in the Document Output Setup was unavailable due to a visibility issue, preventing printing via the print service. The option is now re-enabled, allowing printing via the print service.

hotfixes.title: In the Continia Delivery Network Onboarding setup guide, changing the country/region code to BE previously forced the Identification Type field to BE
hotfixes.summary: In the Continia Delivery Network Onboarding setup guide, changing the country/region code to BE previously forced the Identification Type field to BE:EN . With this update, BE:EN is still suggested, but the value can now be changed.

hotfixes.title: Fixed a runtime error during e-document export when using the CDN dispatcher, caused by validating export configuration fields on the document record
hotfixes.summary: Fixed a runtime error during e-document export when using the CDN dispatcher, caused by validating export configuration fields on the document record instead of the e-document send code record. Field validation now correctly references the e-document send code configuration, so the export no longer fails.

hotfixes.title: When sending a sales invoice via Peppol (e-document), the following error occurred
hotfixes.summary: When sending a sales invoice via Peppol (e-document), the following error occurred: De wijzigingen in de record Verkoopfactuur kunnen niet worden opgeslagen omdat sommige informatie op de pagina niet up-to-date is. The No. Printed field update now refreshes the sales invoice record before modifying it, so the record can be saved correctly.

hotfixes.title: In certain VAT Posting Setup configurations, OIOUBL electronic documents were generated with multiple TaxSubTotal elements using the same Tax Category
hotfixes.summary: In certain VAT Posting Setup configurations, OIOUBL electronic documents were generated with multiple TaxSubTotal elements using the same Tax Category IDs, causing validation errors when the document was sent. This has now been updated so that each Tax Category ID appears only once.

hotfixes.title: XML generation has been updated to use the company information contact details when no salesperson is specified on the document.
hotfixes.summary: XML generation has been updated to use the company information contact details when no salesperson is specified on the document.

hotfixes.title: When exporting a Peppol invoice where an invoice discount was applied to only some of the invoice lines, an invalid document could be generated in cer
hotfixes.summary: When exporting a Peppol invoice where an invoice discount was applied to only some of the invoice lines, an invalid document could be generated in certain cases. In these scenarios, the XML node cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:BaseAmount was calculated incorrectly.

hotfixes.title: When sending Peppol BIS3 sales credit memos and service credit memos using XML Export, the payment discounts are now supported.
hotfixes.summary: When sending Peppol BIS3 sales credit memos and service credit memos using XML Export, the payment discounts are now supported.

hotfixes.title: When a sales credit memo contained lines with both a negative quantity and a negative unit price, exporting it to PEPPOL XML produced inconsistent lin
hotfixes.summary: When a sales credit memo contained lines with both a negative quantity and a negative unit price, exporting it to PEPPOL XML produced inconsistent line and total amounts, resulting in a PEPPOL validation error. The total amounts in the XML now correctly match the line amounts.

hotfixes.title: Resolved an issue where the Issued Reminders tile on the Document Output dashboard displayed an incorrect document count.
hotfixes.summary: Resolved an issue where the Issued Reminders tile on the Document Output dashboard displayed an incorrect document count. The tile now accurately shows the number of unhandled documents by applying the same filtering criteria as used on the drilldown page ( Document Output -> Issued Reminders ).

hotfixes.title: Resolved an issue where the CDO Send Code was not populated on Posted Sales Shipment Headers when posting sales orders via Sales Orders -> Post .
hotfixes.summary: Resolved an issue where the CDO Send Code was not populated on Posted Sales Shipment Headers when posting sales orders via Sales Orders -> Post . Previously, the system assigned the output profile only to posted sales invoices, resulting in missing output profile information on posted sales shipments. The system now correctly assigns the output profile to both Posted Sales Invoices and Posted Sales Shipments , ensuring consistent document output functionality for all posted sales documents.

hotfixes.title: When canceling the dialog for Post and Send/Print on sales orders with partial deliveries, previous invoices were incorrectly sent to the customer.
hotfixes.summary: When canceling the dialog for Post and Send/Print on sales orders with partial deliveries, previous invoices were incorrectly sent to the customer. The operation is now properly aborted when canceling the posting dialog.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the Swedish Party Identification was inserted into the eDocument XML using an incorrect format.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the Swedish Party Identification was inserted into the eDocument XML using an incorrect format. It is now inserted in the correct format.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the Published in Registry setting on the Continia Delivery Network Participations page did not always reflect the actual publication statu
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the Published in Registry setting on the Continia Delivery Network Participations page did not always reflect the actual publication status. It now correctly indicates whether the participation has been published.

hotfixes.title: Exported ZUGFeRD XML sales documents previously included the same namespace declaration twice.
hotfixes.summary: Exported ZUGFeRD XML sales documents previously included the same namespace declaration twice.

hotfixes.title: Customer setup is now automatically inserted when a new customer is created using a customer template that includes an output profile.
hotfixes.summary: Customer setup is now automatically inserted when a new customer is created using a customer template that includes an output profile. Additionally, customer setup is inserted when the output profile is set directly from the Customer Cards list page.

hotfixes.title: Previously, using the Update Customers action on the Customer Cards page updated the output profile for the selected customers, but did not insert the
hotfixes.summary: Previously, using the Update Customers action on the Customer Cards page updated the output profile for the selected customers, but did not insert the customer setup. Users were required to manually open each customer card to complete the setup. This step is no longer needed – the customer setup is now inserted automatically when the Update Customers action is selected.

hotfixes.version: Document Output 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 3
hotfixes.title: Previously, when modifying or inserting lines in Sales Orders or Purchase Orders (sales lines or purchase lines), the Handled field on the document he
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when modifying or inserting lines in Sales Orders or Purchase Orders (sales lines or purchase lines), the Handled field on the document header was automatically reset. This behavior has been changed. The Handled field on Sales Orders and Purchase Orders will no longer be reset automatically when lines are modified or inserted. To reset the Handled status on a document, the new ResetDocumentHandledStatus procedure from codeunit 6175302 CDO Handled Fields Management must be used. This

hotfixes.version: Document Output 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 3
hotfixes.title: Fixed OAuth token expiry calculation that could cause token is expired errors when sending emails.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed OAuth token expiry calculation that could cause token is expired errors when sending emails. The system now uses the standard Business Central method for Unix timestamp conversion, ensuring accurate token lifetime validation.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 3
hotfixes.title: When sending a posted sales invoice eDocument through Document Output in SE localization, the system incorrectly used a combination of Bank Branch No.
hotfixes.summary: When sending a posted sales invoice eDocument through Document Output in SE localization, the system incorrectly used a combination of Bank Branch No. + Bank Account No. instead of the Plus Giro No. field. This caused the wrong value to be exported in the element cac:PaymentMeans/cac:PayeeFinancialAccount/cbc:ID , where the Plus Giro No. should have been used. This has been fixed, and the correct cac:PaymentMeans/cac:PayeeFinancialAccount/cbc:ID is now set in the eDocument.

hotfixes.version: Document Output 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the print PDF function did not display the report request page.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the print PDF function did not display the report request page. Users can now configure print settings before generating PDFs.

hotfixes.version: Document Output 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Customer Ledger Entry No.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Customer Ledger Entry No. was cleared on prepayment sales invoices, causing the Remaining Amount to incorrectly display as 0. The event subscriber for prepayment posting now properly preserves the ledger entry reference while resetting only the CDO tracking fields.

hotfixes.title: When saving email signatures after changing the selected email template in the merge fields FactBox, the application could previously crash.
hotfixes.summary: When saving email signatures after changing the selected email template in the merge fields FactBox, the application could previously crash.

hotfixes.title: When sales lines were added or modified on sales orders marked as CDO Handled , the flag was not reset, causing orders to remain incorrectly marked as
hotfixes.summary: When sales lines were added or modified on sales orders marked as CDO Handled , the flag was not reset, causing orders to remain incorrectly marked as handled. The CDO Handled flag now resets automatically when sales lines are changed.

hotfixes.title: When using the Open Email action with the eSeal feature enabled, an error occurred if the attached file was not a PDF
hotfixes.summary: When using the Open Email action with the eSeal feature enabled, an error occurred if the attached file was not a PDF: File should be PDF This has now been fixed, and the action works as expected regardless of the file type.

hotfixes.title: For Business Central version 14.29 and later, the version was not correctly detected, which prevented XML file downloads required for object merge ope
hotfixes.summary: For Business Central version 14.29 and later, the version was not correctly detected, which prevented XML file downloads required for object merge operations. This has been fixed, so the system now accurately recognizes both 'Dynamics NAV' and 'Business Central' version formats, ensuring that XML downloads function as expected for all supported versions.

hotfixes.title: The Set Background Pdf procedure previously did not trigger the correct event on on-premises installations, which could prevent expected customization
hotfixes.summary: The Set Background Pdf procedure previously did not trigger the correct event on on-premises installations, which could prevent expected customizations or integrations from executing. It now calls the appropriate event, ensuring consistent behavior between on-premises and cloud environments.

hotfixes.title: When a Customer No.
hotfixes.summary: When a Customer No. field was populated, the ZUGFeRD output profiles were not automatically populated for service invoices and service credit memos. The correct output profile is now automatically assigned when the Customer No. field is populated.

hotfixes.title: When converting sales quotes to orders or invoices, or purchase quotes to orders, the CDO Handled field was incorrectly retained from the original quo
hotfixes.summary: When converting sales quotes to orders or invoices, or purchase quotes to orders, the CDO Handled field was incorrectly retained from the original quote. This prevented the converted documents from being included in Document Output email tasks and filters. The CDO Handled field now resets correctly during conversion.

hotfixes.title: Automatic customer statement generation previously created unwanted draft journal lines for customers with a zero balance, even when the If customer h
hotfixes.summary: Automatic customer statement generation previously created unwanted draft journal lines for customers with a zero balance, even when the If customer has Balance condition was enabled. The process now correctly checks customer balances and only creates journal entries when a PDF statement is successfully generated.

hotfixes.title: Copied documents previously inherited the CDO Handled status from their source documents, causing them to maybe be incorrectly marked as handled and e
hotfixes.summary: Copied documents previously inherited the CDO Handled status from their source documents, causing them to maybe be incorrectly marked as handled and excluded from unhandled document lists. Copied documents now initialize with a clean CDO Handled state.

hotfixes.title: Previously, a permission issue prevented users with the CDO-ALL permission set from sending emails when using the Azure Application Setup .
hotfixes.summary: Previously, a permission issue prevented users with the CDO-ALL permission set from sending emails when using the Azure Application Setup . The CDO-ALL permission set now includes insert access to the Azure Application Setup table, enabling token refresh, for successful email sending with Azure authentication.

hotfixes.title: Previously, intermittent PDF signature failures could occur when certificate validation by the API service was unsuccessful.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, intermittent PDF signature failures could occur when certificate validation by the API service was unsuccessful. The system now automatically retries the signature operation if certificate validation fails and provides clearer error messages when certificate issues arise.

hotfixes.title: Previously, combining documents from list views could cause an infinite loop.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, combining documents from list views could cause an infinite loop. Additionally, merge fields in combined document file names displayed encoded values instead of the actual content. Merge field processing has now been made more robust to prevent errors during document combination, and file names correctly display the intended information.

hotfixes.title: When sending emails or printing PDFs for draft invoices from the Sales Invoice List or the Sales Invoice Card , the following error occurred: The tabl
hotfixes.summary: When sending emails or printing PDFs for draft invoices from the Sales Invoice List or the Sales Invoice Card , the following error occurred: The table IDs do not match.

hotfixes.title: The OnAfterCreateDocument event was not triggered during print operations, preventing partners from detecting when document creation was complete and
hotfixes.summary: The OnAfterCreateDocument event was not triggered during print operations, preventing partners from detecting when document creation was complete and from accessing the final blob field. The event is now raised as expected after print operations.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Previously, when attempting to connect multiple candidates from the eCandidates page using the Batch Connect action, the candidates were not connected
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when attempting to connect multiple candidates from the eCandidates page using the Batch Connect action, the candidates were not connected as expected in some cases.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When exporting an OIOUBL invoice containing a reverse VAT charge, the XML document failed to pass validation – and the following error was shown: [F-L
hotfixes.summary: When exporting an OIOUBL invoice containing a reverse VAT charge, the XML document failed to pass validation – and the following error was shown: [F-LIB402] The taxable amount on the Invoice when currency: 'DKK', Tax Category ID: 'ZeroRated' and Tax Scheme ID: '63', does not match the sum of taxable amounts (...).

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3
hotfixes.title: When copying a company in an on-premises installation and Continia eDocuments wasn't licensed, the following error was shown: Sorry, the current permi
hotfixes.summary: When copying a company in an on-premises installation and Continia eDocuments wasn't licensed, the following error was shown: Sorry, the current permissions prevented the action. (CodeUnit 6225608 CTS-CDN Env. Cleanup Subscr. Execute: BaseApplication)

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3
hotfixes.title: The MultiplierFactorNumeric node in eDocuments for the Document Output export functionality was previously formatted as an integer, which could result
hotfixes.summary: The MultiplierFactorNumeric node in eDocuments for the Document Output export functionality was previously formatted as an integer, which could result in invalid eDocuments. It is now correctly formatted as a decimal.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3
hotfixes.title: When sending an electronic document through Document Output, the following error could be shown
hotfixes.summary: When sending an electronic document through Document Output, the following error could be shown: It was not possible to perform the action with the current permissions. (TableData 6086229 CTS-CDN Document Network Document Modify: Continia Delivery Network). The necessary permissions are now assigned by default. Users who previously created a custom permission set with TableData 6086229 and modified permissions as a workaround can now remove this permission set.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3
hotfixes.title: Previously, if the VAT percentage value had a comma as the decimal separator (e.g.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, if the VAT percentage value had a comma as the decimal separator (e.g.: 25,5), the VAT amounts in the XML document were incorrectly calculated. Now, either a comma (,) or a dot (.) can be used as the decimal separator.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3
hotfixes.title: Non-invoiced lines were incorrectly included in the VAT breakdown section of the XML, even when they were not present in the lines section.
hotfixes.summary: Non-invoiced lines were incorrectly included in the VAT breakdown section of the XML, even when they were not present in the lines section.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 3
hotfixes.title: Previously, when exporting an e-document with Belgian payment discounts applied, a discrepancy could occasionally be observed between the discount sho
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when exporting an e-document with Belgian payment discounts applied, a discrepancy could occasionally be observed between the discount shown in Business Central and the one in the e-document.

hotfixes.title: Whenever template line reports were used with multiple reports and Show Request Page was enabled, the following error occurred during write transactio
hotfixes.summary: Whenever template line reports were used with multiple reports and Show Request Page was enabled, the following error occurred during write transactions: You cannot run the request page in a write transaction. The Show Request Page option is now automatically disabled when a template line report is executed within a write transaction. This prevents the error and ensures consistent processing of template lines with multiple reports.

hotfixes.title: When a URL merge field was inserted by another merge field in the Email Template editor, the merge field was not replaced with the expected value duri
hotfixes.summary: When a URL merge field was inserted by another merge field in the Email Template editor, the merge field was not replaced with the expected value during email generation. Instead, the merge field placeholder remained visible in the final email content. This has now been fixed, and all nested merge fields, including URL merge fields, are correctly resolved and replaced with their corresponding values when generating emails.

hotfixes.title: Fixed the following issues
hotfixes.summary: Fixed the following issues: When the Save PDF function was enabled on an email template, the request page was not displayed as expected. The request page now appears, allowing you to configure PDF saving options before sending emails. The Save PDF function did not generate PDF files correctly for documents that had an output profile assigned for eDocuments but no output profile for other document types. PDF generation now works as intended in these scenarios.

hotfixes.title: The font size value displayed in the email editor toolbar did not reflect the actual font size applied to the selected text.
hotfixes.summary: The font size value displayed in the email editor toolbar did not reflect the actual font size applied to the selected text. This has now been fixed, and the toolbar now correctly shows the current font size of the selected content.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2025 R1 Service Pack 1, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When sending invoices as OIOUBL electronic documents, the schematron validation failed if an invoice discount was applied.
hotfixes.summary: When sending invoices as OIOUBL electronic documents, the schematron validation failed if an invoice discount was applied. The following error was shown: [F-LIB402] The taxable amount on the Invoice when currency: 'DKK', Tax Category ID: 'StandardRated' and Tax Scheme ID: '63', does not match the sum of taxable amounts from the invoice or credit note lines, after adjusting for allowances (discounts) and charges (fees). A rounding difference of up to +/- 1 is allowed... Now, documents with combin

hotfixes.title: The OnAfterCreateDocument event, which previously did not trigger correctly when saving document PDFs, has now been fixed.
hotfixes.summary: The OnAfterCreateDocument event, which previously did not trigger correctly when saving document PDFs, has now been fixed. This ensures that any custom logic tied to this event will execute as expected after a document PDF is created and saved. Users relying on this event for post-processing tasks can now expect consistent behavior.

hotfixes.title: Support for Hide Standard Mail Actions and Hide Standard Print Actions has been expanded to additional pages extended by Document Output.
hotfixes.summary: Support for Hide Standard Mail Actions and Hide Standard Print Actions has been expanded to additional pages extended by Document Output. This enhancement allows users to customize their interface by hiding standard mail and print actions on these newly supported pages, providing a more streamlined and tailored user experience.

hotfixes.title: When using the Open Email action for documents associated with an output profile configured for printing, the system failed to generate a PDF document
hotfixes.summary: When using the Open Email action for documents associated with an output profile configured for printing, the system failed to generate a PDF document. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that a PDF document is correctly created when the Open Email action is used, regardless of the output profile settings.

hotfixes.title: When downloading an Email Template Line from Continia Online , the Dimension Code from the parent Email Template Header was not being assigned.
hotfixes.summary: When downloading an Email Template Line from Continia Online , the Dimension Code from the parent Email Template Header was not being assigned. This issue has been resolved, ensuring that the Dimension Code is now correctly inherited from the parent Email Template Header during the download process.

hotfixes.title: The validation process for Output Profiles on both Customer and Vendor records has been updated to ensure better compliance with Master Data Intercomp
hotfixes.summary: The validation process for Output Profiles on both Customer and Vendor records has been updated to ensure better compliance with Master Data Intercompany scenarios. This enhancement addresses the need for consistent and accurate data management across intercompany transactions, reducing potential discrepancies and improving data integrity. Users involved in intercompany operations will now experience more reliable validation checks, ensuring that the Output Profiles align correctly with the mast

hotfixes.title: When posting a partial Sales Invoice from a Sales Order , an incorrect Output Profile was assigned if the Bill-to Customer No.
hotfixes.summary: When posting a partial Sales Invoice from a Sales Order , an incorrect Output Profile was assigned if the Bill-to Customer No. differed from the Sell-to Customer No. This issue has been resolved to ensure that the correct Output Profile is now applied in such scenarios.

hotfixes.title: When the Use reports for email attachments checkbox was not selected, emails that did not contain any other PDF files were not sent.
hotfixes.summary: When the Use reports for email attachments checkbox was not selected, emails that did not contain any other PDF files were not sent. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that emails are sent even if they do not include additional PDF attachments.

hotfixes.title: Creating a new setup for the customer and changing the Output Profile to Zugferd caused CII invoices and credit memos to use the incorrect GuidelineSp
hotfixes.summary: Creating a new setup for the customer and changing the Output Profile to Zugferd caused CII invoices and credit memos to use the incorrect GuidelineSpecifiedDocumentContextParameter in the XML file.

hotfixes.title: The combine functionality has been enhanced to work on standard pages as well.
hotfixes.summary: The combine functionality has been enhanced to work on standard pages as well. Users can now utilize the combine feature directly within standard page interfaces, ensuring a more seamless and integrated experience.

hotfixes.title: A potential issue has been resolved that could occur during the reinstallation of the Document Output app, version 25 and later, in the same database
hotfixes.summary: A potential issue has been resolved that could occur during the reinstallation of the Document Output app, version 25 and later, in the same database after it had been previously removed. This issue was specific to on-premises installations and could prevent the app from being installed correctly.

hotfixes.title: In unhandled unposted document pages, such as Unhandled Sales Orders , executing the Print/Email All action previously resulted in the following error
hotfixes.summary: In unhandled unposted document pages, such as Unhandled Sales Orders , executing the Print/Email All action previously resulted in the following error: - The object has been run. Use the function CLEAR(Page) This issue occurred when attempting to print or email all documents simultaneously from these pages. The error has now been resolved, ensuring that the Print/Email All action functions correctly without triggering this message.

hotfixes.summary: The MultiplierFactorNumeric node in eDocuments for the Document Output export functionality was previously formatted as an integer, which could result in invalid eDocuments. It is now correctly formatted as a decimal.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, when attempting to connect multiple candidates from the eCandidates page using the Batch Connect action, the candidates were not connected as expected in some cases.

La mention relative à l’escompte ou à son absence (code AAB) est absente. Elle est obligatoire dans les notes (BG-3).

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Sales prepayments can now be included in eReporting.
hotfixes.summary: Sales prepayments can now be included in eReporting. Posted prepayment invoices are reported as document type 386 , while posted prepayment credit memos are reported as document type 503 . For foreign business customers, prepayment invoices are reported in F10.1 and the corresponding payments in F10.2. For domestic consumers, prepayment invoices are reported in F10.3 and the corresponding payments in F10.4. The final invoice is reported for the remaining sales amount after deducting the prepayme

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Previously, French eReporting transmissions could be rejected during validation by the receiving platform, and transmissions without a receiver identi
hotfixes.summary: Previously, French eReporting transmissions could be rejected during validation by the receiving platform, and transmissions without a receiver identifier could not be sent. The FR report XML has been corrected for the IssueDateTime format, seller and buyer identification, including the seller's tax representative, and the transmission type used when a report is resubmitted. These transmissions are now accepted and can be sent successfully.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: The Issue Date is now correctly populated for referenced invoices in credit notes, preventing validation errors during document sending.
hotfixes.summary: The Issue Date is now correctly populated for referenced invoices in credit notes, preventing validation errors during document sending.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: When sending a sales credit memo using the French CII format, the generated XML incorrectly used Document Type Code 380 (invoice) instead of 381 (cred
hotfixes.summary: When sending a sales credit memo using the French CII format, the generated XML incorrectly used Document Type Code 380 (invoice) instead of 381 (credit memo) because the document type could be overwritten by default scenario flows. To reduce scenario configuration conflicts for invoices and credit memos, the REGULARINVOICE and REGULARCREDITMEMO scenarios have been merged into REGULARDOCUMENT .

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: PA France participants could not receive plain Peppol BIS 3 invoices and credit memos because the four PA France network profiles for Peppol BIS Billi
hotfixes.summary: PA France participants could not receive plain Peppol BIS 3 invoices and credit memos because the four PA France network profiles for Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 and Peppol BIS Self-Billing 3.0 were not mapped to any XML structure. These profiles are now mapped to their Peppol BIS 3 XML structures and listed under each structure’s supported network profiles, without duplicating mappings or raising errors if the profiles aren’t present.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: The required ICD-FR SchemeID is now correctly populated when a Delivery Location Identifier is present, ensuring compliance with French validation rul
hotfixes.summary: The required ICD-FR SchemeID is now correctly populated when a Delivery Location Identifier is present, ensuring compliance with French validation rules and preventing document rejection during submission.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Improved the reliability of the receiving capabilities check, ensuring endpoint information is always determined independently for each customer.
hotfixes.summary: Improved the reliability of the receiving capabilities check, ensuring endpoint information is always determined independently for each customer.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 5, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Previously, when upgrading to CDN 28.5, the enum 6086245 CTS-CDN Onboarding Wiz. Step was missing and caused an error
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when upgrading to CDN 28.5, the enum 6086245 CTS-CDN Onboarding Wiz. Step was missing and caused an error: The metadata object Enum 6086245 was not found.

hotfixes.title: Fixed issue where the Combine to One Document feature only processed the first record per customer when using Print/Email All with multiple customers
hotfixes.summary: Fixed issue where the Combine to One Document feature only processed the first record per customer when using Print/Email All with multiple customers in the filtered view. All records for each customer are now properly combined into single documents and sent in one email per customer.

hotfixes.title: Added three new extension events ( OnBeforeResetHandledOnSalesLineUpdate , OnBeforeResetHandledOnPurchLineUpdate , OnBeforeResetHandledOnServLineUpdat
hotfixes.summary: Added three new extension events ( OnBeforeResetHandledOnSalesLineUpdate , OnBeforeResetHandledOnPurchLineUpdate , OnBeforeResetHandledOnServLineUpdate ) that let you suppress the automatic Handled -field reset when a header field change cascades to Sales , Purchase , or Service lines. Standard behavior is unchanged: if no subscriber is bound, Handled still resets as before for all three document types.

hotfixes.title: When the statement email template’s open-documents output was set to a single PDF, clicking Open Email on the Document Output Customer Card could fail
hotfixes.summary: When the statement email template’s open-documents output was set to a single PDF, clicking Open Email on the Document Output Customer Card could fail for customers with many open documents, with the following resulting error: Could not perform post request to https://EUN-pdfapi.continiaonline.com/api/v1.0/pdf/merge.json — Status code: 422 �— Message: Combine - LoadFromStream1 caused an error. Status: GenericError, Page: 0. This has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: When selecting multiple posted sales invoices and using the standard Send action to send them as eDocuments, the following error occurred: You can not
hotfixes.summary: When selecting multiple posted sales invoices and using the standard Send action to send them as eDocuments, the following error occurred: You can not call this function with this variable type. This has now been fixed, and multiple selected documents are now sent correctly in one action.

hotfixes.title: The eDocument Status field was only available on the posted service document cards, not on the Posted Service Invoices and Posted Service Credit Memos
hotfixes.summary: The eDocument Status field was only available on the posted service document cards, not on the Posted Service Invoices and Posted Service Credit Memos list pages. This meant that the status of a sent service invoice or service credit memo could only be checked by opening each posted document. The eDocument Status field has now been added to both list pages, where it shows the current status of the related eDocument. Selecting the status opens the related eDocuments, just as on the other posted d

hotfixes.title: When sending a sales invoice or sales credit memo, any comments on the business document are included into the OIOUBL xml file in the Note field in th
hotfixes.summary: When sending a sales invoice or sales credit memo, any comments on the business document are included into the OIOUBL xml file in the Note field in the document header. This release fixes two issues in this regard: Having multiple comment lines in the business document could lead to multiple instances of the Note class in the xml file. This would be flagged as either a warning or error when sending the document. Comment lines were never exported on sales credit memos.

hotfixes.title: When you chose the assist edit on the eDocuments Scenario Flow field on a posted document, such as a Posted Sales Invoice and the scenario flow carrie
hotfixes.summary: When you chose the assist edit on the eDocuments Scenario Flow field on a posted document, such as a Posted Sales Invoice and the scenario flow carried no special payer type, the following error occurred: The eDocument Scenario Header Value does not exist. Identification fields and values: Source Table ID='<Table ID>',System ID='<System ID>'

hotfixes.title: When a CDN subscription to Post + Send sent an eDocument immediately, subsequent email jobs attempted to process it again and created a duplicate, fai
hotfixes.summary: When a CDN subscription to Post + Send sent an eDocument immediately, subsequent email jobs attempted to process it again and created a duplicate, failed eDocument log entry. The system now detects already-sent eDocuments and skips re-sending/logging them during email job processing.

hotfixes.title: The eDocuments activity group is only shown if Document Capture or Document Output is activated.
hotfixes.summary: The eDocuments activity group is only shown if Document Capture or Document Output is activated.

hotfixes.title: Invalid credit memos could be generated if the Ship-to Name field in Company Information was not populated.
hotfixes.summary: Invalid credit memos could be generated if the Ship-to Name field in Company Information was not populated.

hotfixes.title: When opening Show Error Details in the Document Output log for entries created by a user with a different language setting, the following error occurr
hotfixes.summary: When opening Show Error Details in the Document Output log for entries created by a user with a different language setting, the following error occurred: 'Factuur' is not an option. The existing options are: Invoice,Credit Memo . Error details now display correctly regardless of the language of the user who created the log entry.

hotfixes.title: When using the Open Email action for documents where the output profile had email set to Skip , nothing happened and no error was shown.
hotfixes.summary: When using the Open Email action for documents where the output profile had email set to Skip , nothing happened and no error was shown. Open Email now opens the email preview and allows sending the email using the associated template, regardless of the Skip setting.

hotfixes.title: When sending emails using the Azure App or Azure User E-Mail sending method, the following error could intermittently occur: - InvalidAuthenticationTo
hotfixes.summary: When sending emails using the Azure App or Azure User E-Mail sending method, the following error could intermittently occur: - InvalidAuthenticationToken - Lifetime validation failed, the token is expired. Document Output now determines the token expiry directly from the sign-in response, so sending is no longer affected by time zone or daylight saving changes, and an isolated extra sign-in on a mailbox’s first send after installing the update is expected.

hotfixes.title: For ZUGFERD documents, the UTF8-BOM was not stripped as intended.
hotfixes.summary: For ZUGFERD documents, the UTF8-BOM was not stripped as intended. The UTF8-BOM is now correctly removed during processing.

hotfixes.title: There was an issue causing CrossDomainAcknowledgementAndResponse eDocuments with status 212 to not be linked to the correct business document when imp
hotfixes.summary: There was an issue causing CrossDomainAcknowledgementAndResponse eDocuments with status 212 to not be linked to the correct business document when imported.

hotfixes.title: Previously, documents in French eReporting Flow 10.3 were assigned to the period of their document date.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, documents in French eReporting Flow 10.3 were assigned to the period of their document date. They now belong to the period of their posting date. A payment for a period that had already been reported was sent in Flow 10.2 and Flow 10.4 as a correction that pointed back to the earlier report; it is now sent as a new first report IN . When a reporting period was corrected more than once, only the first correction was reported as a correction CO , and from the second correction onwards

hotfixes.title: When a new document was created with Copy Document , or with the Correct and Cancel actions on a posted invoice, the coding values of the eDocument sc
hotfixes.summary: When a new document was created with Copy Document , or with the Correct and Cancel actions on a posted invoice, the coding values of the eDocument scenario were not created for the resulting credit memo or invoice. The new document showed a scenario in eDocument Scenario Flow , but choosing AssistEdit next to the field opened nothing, and the document could be posted without its mandatory coding values.

hotfixes.title: The following only applies to the French (FR) localization.
hotfixes.summary: The following only applies to the French (FR) localization. Previously, the VAT declared for a payment in Flow 10.2 and Flow 10.4 was selected by posting date, so the declared amount could be missing or counted twice when the payment date differed from the invoice date, or when several payments settled the same invoice on the same date. The VAT is now matched to the individual payment application, and unapplying a payment declares the VAT taken back as a negative amount, so that a payment and it

hotfixes.title: The sender identity of an eReport is no longer configured manually.
hotfixes.summary: The sender identity of an eReport is no longer configured manually. The eReporting PA Identifier fields have been removed from the eReporting Setup page and the Sender fields from the eReport Card , as a fixed sender identity is now applied to every eReport.

hotfixes.title: The following only applies to the French (FR) localization.
hotfixes.summary: The following only applies to the French (FR) localization. Previously, the amounts reported for payments in the F10.2 and F10.4 eReports were too low, because only the VAT part of each payment was included instead of the full amount paid. Payments are now reported with their full amount, including VAT.

hotfixes.title: Invalid XMP metadata could be generated in ZUGFeRD PDF files.
hotfixes.summary: Invalid XMP metadata could be generated in ZUGFeRD PDF files.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the XML structure for French UBL credit notes was mapped to the wrong network profile, which caused the following error when sending credi
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the XML structure for French UBL credit notes was mapped to the wrong network profile, which caused the following error when sending credit notes: You're trying to send an electronic document to Customer <Customer No.>, but you're not registered to send this type of document. Your participation: PA France - <Participation Identifier> Electronic document: French UBL Credit Memo (EXTENDED-CTC-FR)

hotfixes.title: Previously when sending a CDAR response (accepted/rejected) from a posted purchase invoice, the response document was misconfigured, causing the respo
hotfixes.summary: Previously when sending a CDAR response (accepted/rejected) from a posted purchase invoice, the response document was misconfigured, causing the response to never reach the intended receiver.

hotfixes.title: When a sales or service invoice or credit memo was sent as an XML document and a discount was entered in Line Discount % on the lines, the discount pe
hotfixes.summary: When a sales or service invoice or credit memo was sent as an XML document and a discount was entered in Line Discount % on the lines, the discount percentage was missing from the exported document, only the discount amount was included. The percentage was read from Line Discount Calculation , which stays empty on posted documents when the discount is entered as a percentage. The line discount percentage is now exported for PEPPOL BIS3, XRechnung and OIOUBL documents, together with the base amou

hotfixes.title: Resolved an issue that prevented document header comments to be exported correctly in the follow combinations of XML format and business document type
hotfixes.summary: Resolved an issue that prevented document header comments to be exported correctly in the follow combinations of XML format and business document type: OIOUBL: sales credit memo, service invoice, and service credit memo CII: sales credit memo, service invoice, and service credit memo Peppol: service invoice The change is only relevant for XML Export (not eDocuments)

hotfixes.summary: When trying to send a lifecycle update document in the CDAR format for the PA France network, the following error was displayed: The sender role is missing for the document type Application Response in the network profile France CDAR.

hotfixes.title: For FR invoices using Special Payer Type = Seller Agent (including USECASE-19A), the UBL-FR output incorrectly swapped the seller and agent by placing
hotfixes.summary: For FR invoices using Special Payer Type = Seller Agent (including USECASE-19A), the UBL-FR output incorrectly swapped the seller and agent by placing the agent in AccountingSupplierParty and the seller in PaymentMeans / PaymentMandate / PayerParty , and it did not emit AccountingSupplierParty / Party / cac:AgentParty . The seller now remains in AccountingSupplierParty , the agent is emitted in AccountingSupplierParty / Party / AgentParty , and PaymentMeans / PaymentMandate / PayerParty is no lo

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: Previously, on the eReporting Filters page, the Filter Expression column displayed filter conditions using internal field numbers (for example, Field7
hotfixes.summary: Previously, on the eReporting Filters page, the Filter Expression column displayed filter conditions using internal field numbers (for example, Field70 ). Filter expressions are now shown using the readable field names, making the configured filters easier to review.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: The French eReporting Flow 10.2 reports payments received from customers on international B2B sales invoices.
hotfixes.summary: The French eReporting Flow 10.2 reports payments received from customers on international B2B sales invoices. Vendor payments and the vendor filters are no longer part of Flow 10.2, as payment reporting under Flow 10.2 is an obligation of the seller only and is not required for purchases.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: You can now combine several report types into an eReport Group so that automatic reference processing collects them into a single shared eReport for a
hotfixes.summary: You can now combine several report types into an eReport Group so that automatic reference processing collects them into a single shared eReport for a period, instead of creating a separate eReport for each Report Type . All report types in a group must share the same period length, and a group cannot be changed while an eReport that uses it has not yet been sent.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: The Franch eReporting feature now correctly captures references for release.
hotfixes.summary: The Franch eReporting feature now correctly captures references for release. Settlements without general ledger entries are no longer lost, posting previews no longer register references, and captured references are limited to the report types of the selected reporting country. The Declarant Role now displays as BY and SE .

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: When registering an incoming PEPPOL Order Response against a purchase order using a Document Capture template set to Update Order , the supplier’s pro
hotfixes.summary: When registering an incoming PEPPOL Order Response against a purchase order using a Document Capture template set to Update Order , the supplier’s promised delivery date was captured but not applied to the purchase order’s Promised Receipt Date on the header or lines. Registration now updates the purchase order’s Promised Receipt Date from the response’s promised delivery period. Furthermore, the possibility to Create Template Field on the template and apply it to the purchase order has been add

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: When posting an invoice with a 100% invoice discount, the generated eDocument XML was invalid and left the eDocument in status “not valid.” The XML ge
hotfixes.summary: When posting an invoice with a 100% invoice discount, the generated eDocument XML was invalid and left the eDocument in status “not valid.” The XML generation now correctly handles 100% invoice discounts so the exported file validates successfully.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue that could cause incorrect scheme IDs to be specified in party sections for Dutch suppliers and customers.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue that could cause incorrect scheme IDs to be specified in party sections for Dutch suppliers and customers. The Party Identification and Party Legal Entity elements now consistently use the KVK or OIN number stored in the Registration No. field. If the Registration No. is blank or does not contain a valid KVK or OIN number, the corresponding party identification elements are no longer included in the generated XML file.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: When posting a document with a Seller Agent Scenario Flow, the special payer was dropped because the Scenario Hdr.
hotfixes.summary: When posting a document with a Seller Agent Scenario Flow, the special payer was dropped because the Scenario Hdr. Value was not moved to the posted document, so the UBL-FR export omitted the special-party block. When posting, Scenario Hdr. Value is transferred independently of any Record Coding Values (and only when it contains a Special Payer Type ), ensuring the Seller Agent special party is preserved through posting and included in the export.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: An XML structure could previously be set to extend itself, directly or through an indirect loop, causing the combined structure to fail when built.
hotfixes.summary: An XML structure could previously be set to extend itself, directly or through an indirect loop, causing the combined structure to fail when built. The XML Structure Code Extension field is now validated on entry, and any circular chain is rejected with a clear error.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: Fixed the eReporting XML structure configuration to ensure generated files validate successfully against the official French eReporting validation rul
hotfixes.summary: Fixed the eReporting XML structure configuration to ensure generated files validate successfully against the official French eReporting validation rules.

hotfixes.version: Continia Delivery Network 2026 R1 Service Pack 4
hotfixes.title: OIOUBL sales invoices and credit memos now require a resolvable contact ( Identifier and Name ) to post.
hotfixes.summary: OIOUBL sales invoices and credit memos now require a resolvable contact ( Identifier and Name ) to post. Salesperson is no longer used as for contact information. This has been unified between all formats.

hotfixes.title: Output Profiles can now be renamed without causing errors.
hotfixes.summary: Output Profiles can now be renamed without causing errors.

hotfixes.title: Some users could experience performance issues in the Role Center when working with a large number of posted sales shipments.
hotfixes.summary: Some users could experience performance issues in the Role Center when working with a large number of posted sales shipments. We have applied additional filtering to improve performance and resolve these issues.

hotfixes.title: When running the Document Output assisted setup for companies with a large history of posted documents, the setup could hang or fail with an "another
hotfixes.summary: When running the Document Output assisted setup for companies with a large history of posted documents, the setup could hang or fail with an "another session is updating" error due to a long database lock during migration. This has now been fixed, and the setup completes quickly and reliably without holding a long lock.

hotfixes.title: When a document had multiple attachments with the same file name, sending electronic documents failed with the following error: record already exists
hotfixes.summary: When a document had multiple attachments with the same file name, sending electronic documents failed with the following error: record already exists / Der Datensatz … existiert bereits Attachments with duplicate names are now embedded correctly, with a number added to distinguish them.

hotfixes.title: When opening Continia Solution Management on on-premises installations where Document Output was installed but not licensed or activated, users withou
hotfixes.summary: When opening Continia Solution Management on on-premises installations where Document Output was installed but not licensed or activated, users without Document Output permissions got a permissions error: Die aktuellen Berechtigungen haben die Aktion leider verhindert. (CodeUnit 6175299 CDO Functions Execute: Continia Document Output) This has now been fixed, and Continia Solution Management opens correctly regardless of which Continia permission sets are assigned.

hotfixes.title: When you ran Copy Document on purchase or sales documents, the following error could occur and the copy was aborted
hotfixes.summary: When you ran Copy Document on purchase or sales documents, the following error could occur and the copy was aborted: The changes to the Purchase Header record cannot be saved because some information on the page is not up-to-date. Close the page, reopen it, and try again. This has now been fixed, and Copy Document no longer fails in companies where Document Output is installed but not activated.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, when applying a Related Field ID in Source Field Mappings for eDocument business term codes in the scenario framework, the following error could occur: Microsoft.Dynamics.Nav.Runtime.NavKeyRef variable not initialized.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when sending an eDocument with the scenario framework installed, the document could fail validation.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when sending an eDocument with the scenario framework installed, the document could fail validation.

hotfixes.summary: Several changes and improvements have been made to French (FR) eReporting, including how amounts and VAT are reported, how customer and vendor payments and their dates are determined, and which posted transactions are included in the declaration. The Reopen action is now only available for approved eReports, this action returns the eReport to the Ready for Approval status instead of New .

hotfixes.summary: Previously, French UBL (FR UBL) invoices containing comment lines could fail validation with VAT category-related errors because the comment lines were exported without a TaxCategoryID .

hotfixes.title: Support for French (FR) functionality in Belgian (French) localizations has been improved.
hotfixes.summary: Support for French (FR) functionality in Belgian (French) localizations has been improved. The French configuration is now available in Belgian (French) localizations. Previously, standard FR UBL invoices could be rendered incorrectly by the stylesheet. The stylesheet now renders standard FR UBL invoices correctly.

hotfixes.version: Document Output 2026 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 1

hotfixes.summary: Previously, the payable amount on sales credit memos could be calculated as double its actual value, resulting in an invalid XML file. The payable amount is now calculated and exported correctly.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, the Scenario Flow field was not available on sales orders and purchase orders, preventing the correct French eInvoicing scenario from being assigned during posting. The Scenario Flow field is now available on both document types.

hotfixes.version: Document Output 2026 R1 Service Pack 3, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Previously, users with only the CTS-CDN Basic permission set could not open the vendor card.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, users with only the CTS-CDN Basic permission set could not open the vendor card.

hotfixes.title: Previously, updating eBilling header values from the scenario flow could clear existing values that were not included in the update.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, updating eBilling header values from the scenario flow could clear existing values that were not included in the update. Existing values are now preserved unless they are part of the scenario flow.

hotfixes.title: When exporting XML documents, the IssueDate value was previously taken from the posting date instead of the document date.
hotfixes.summary: When exporting XML documents, the IssueDate value was previously taken from the posting date instead of the document date. IssueDate now defaults to the document date for both eBilling and XML exports. An integration event is available to override the default IssueDate when needed.

hotfixes.summary: Previously, French e-documents (CII-FR and UBL-FR) using the Factoring Company, Third Party, or Buyer's Agent scenario flows did not export the corresponding payer party information. The payer party is now included in exported documents.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the pre-posting validation for OIOUBL sales documents could incorrectly require the Sell-to Contact field to be populated, preventing vali
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the pre-posting validation for OIOUBL sales documents could incorrectly require the Sell-to Contact field to be populated, preventing valid documents from being posted. The pre-posting validation now uses the same contact resolution logic as the export process by checking Sell-to Contact No. , then the customer's primary contact, and finally the salesperson. An error is only reported when no contact name can be determined.

hotfixes.title: In version 25, the default template groups were missing, and templates were no longer assigned to any group.
hotfixes.summary: In version 25, the default template groups were missing, and templates were no longer assigned to any group. Default template groups and template assignments are now restored, and the release procedure now includes verifying and updating the template version in code after comparing the latest Blob Storage templates across localizations.

hotfixes.title: When posting sales or service invoices and credit memos for customers configured with Send on Posting , documents could be handled by both the auto-se
hotfixes.summary: When posting sales or service invoices and credit memos for customers configured with Send on Posting , documents could be handled by both the auto-send path and DocHandle , risking duplicate sends or missed handling due to unpredictable event subscriber execution order. This has now been fixed by applying the suppression logic inline where the events are raised, so the two paths are mutually exclusive and third-party extensions can’t disrupt it.

hotfixes.title: When finishing the Document Output assisted setup guide, permission errors occurred on posted sales documents ( Sales Shipment , Sales Invoice , and S
hotfixes.summary: When finishing the Document Output assisted setup guide, permission errors occurred on posted sales documents ( Sales Shipment , Sales Invoice , and Sales Credit Memo ) for users without direct write access to the posted sales tables. The assisted setup guide now correctly marks historical posted documents as Handled regardless of the user's own table permissions.

hotfixes.title: Previously, when using the Post and Send action to send sales orders or sales invoices as e-documents, the following error could occur: The document e
hotfixes.summary: Previously, when using the Post and Send action to send sales orders or sales invoices as e-documents, the following error could occur: The document exchange service is not enabled.

hotfixes.summary: In Document Output 27.3.7 and later, a custom E-Document File Name configured on email template lines was not applied to XML attachments, so a random GUID-based file name was used and ZUGFeRD invoices could be rejected. This has now been fixed, and the configured file name is correctly applied to XML attachments.

hotfixes.summary: When Document Output was installed but not activated, you got a Document Output permission error in the Document Capture Role Center. This has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: Previously, the customer GLN was used in the delivery details of exported electronic documents, even when the document contained a ship-to address wit
hotfixes.summary: Previously, the customer GLN was used in the delivery details of exported electronic documents, even when the document contained a ship-to address with its own GLN. The GLN from the ship-to address is now used when available, ensuring that goods are delivered to the correct location. The customer GLN is used only as a fallback when no ship-to address is specified or when the ship-to address does not contain a GLN.

hotfixes.title: Previously, sending a sales invoice or credit memo containing a fixed asset line could result in the eDocument being marked as Not Valid because the g
hotfixes.summary: Previously, sending a sales invoice or credit memo containing a fixed asset line could result in the eDocument being marked as Not Valid because the generated eDocument line was missing a name and unit of measure. During eDocument generation, the line name is now populated from the fixed asset description, falling back to the sales line description when the fixed asset description is empty. Unit of measure information is resolved from configured code list translations or the unit of measure's in

hotfixes.summary: When you used the Send eDocument action with an output profile configured to export only to a folder (with Send Through Network disabled), the following error occurred: - There is no Participation within the filter. Filters: CDN GUID: {00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000} This has now been fixed, and the action exports the XML to the configured folder without attempting a Continia Delivery Network send.

hotfixes.title: When importing eDocuments configuration files through the Set Up eDocuments for Document Output or Set Up Document Output guide, all data was previous
hotfixes.summary: When importing eDocuments configuration files through the Set Up eDocuments for Document Output or Set Up Document Output guide, all data was previously marked as Include by default, even when the corresponding records already existed in the database. Existing records are now excluded by default, and only data that does not already exist in the database is marked as Include .

hotfixes.title: The setup status for eDocument sending now correctly reflects when Document Output has been activated but not fully configured.
hotfixes.summary: The setup status for eDocument sending now correctly reflects when Document Output has been activated but not fully configured. When attempting to send an eDocument, users are prompted to complete the Document Output Setup before eDocuments can be sent.

hotfixes.summary: In the Continia Delivery Network Onboarding setup guide, changing the country/region code to BE previously forced the Identification Type field to BE:EN . With this update, BE:EN is still suggested, but the value can now be changed.

hotfixes.summary: When upgrading on large databases, the upgrade could time out due to unnecessary bulk updates of document records when setting up default output profiles. The upgrade now avoids these bulk updates when setting up default output profiles.

hotfixes.summary: When opening the Document Output Manual setup in certain languages, it could fail because translated titles exceeded the allowed length. The setup page now correctly handles long translations.

hotfixes.summary: Documents in the Document Output Queue were sent outside the configured time window when an associated Email Template job restricted sending to a specific window. hotfixes.title: When connecting a customer using the Connect eCandidates guide on the eCandidates page, selecting an output profile without a configured sender profil
hotfixes.summary: When connecting a customer using the Connect eCandidates guide on the eCandidates page, selecting an output profile without a configured sender profile could result in the following error: The selected Output Profile <Output Profile> is not configured for eDocuments. Please select a different Output Profile. Now, a sender profile is no longer required on the output profile when connecting eCandidates.

hotfixes.title: When eDocument processing failed (create, validate, or send), subsequent post-processing steps still executed and incorrectly updated document counter
hotfixes.summary: When eDocument processing failed (create, validate, or send), subsequent post-processing steps still executed and incorrectly updated document counters, print flags, inserted CDO File records, and triggered delivery finalization. When an eDocument error occurs, the dispatcher now exits gracefully, so these post-processing steps are skipped.

hotfixes.title: When the Amount Rounding Precision (LCY) in the General Ledger Setup was set to more than two decimal places (for example, 0.00001), generating a Pepp
hotfixes.summary: When the Amount Rounding Precision (LCY) in the General Ledger Setup was set to more than two decimal places (for example, 0.00001), generating a Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 eDocument for a posted sales invoice or credit memo could result in an invalid document that failed schematron validation. The generated eDocument now uses the PayableRoundingAmount field to correctly handle rounding differences, ensuring that the document passes validation regardless of the configured rounding precision.

hotfixes.summary: When using merge fields %4 (last statement code) and %7 (next statement code) in customer statement templates, statement numbers were inconsistent between the generated file name and the email body. Statement numbers now remain consistent across document outputs by using session-based merge field caching.

hotfixes.title: When sending documents using templates that merge many/large PDF attachments, the queue stopped and documents were not sent when the merged file excee
hotfixes.summary: When sending documents using templates that merge many/large PDF attachments, the queue stopped and documents were not sent when the merged file exceeded the size limit, causing the following error: The data does not represent a valid JSON token/. The merge handling now prevents this failure for oversized merged attachments, so that document sending no longer stops the queue.

hotfixes.summary: When you clicked No in the Post and Send/Print confirmation dialog for service invoices, service credit memos, and service orders, the document was still sent or printed. The document is now only sent when posting is confirmed and successfully completed.

hotfixes.title: When using email templates with a specific report ID configured, request pages could appear during write transactions.
hotfixes.summary: When using email templates with a specific report ID configured, request pages could appear during write transactions. This has now been fixed, and the IsInWriteTransaction() check is applied consistently across all report execution paths.

hotfixes.summary: When importing bank transactions where the transaction amount was 0 but the bank currency amount was not zero, expenses were created with a 0 amount when a currency was specified.
