hotfixes.summary: When the VAT Amount field was configured on expenses, dimension values entered manually in the Expense Portal or Expense App could be overwritten by default dimensions during synchronization with Business Central . Manually entered dimension values are now retained, while default dimensions continue to be applied only to dimensions that have not been set by the user.

hotfixes.version: Expense Management 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: User-defined dimensions no longer risk being replaced by default dimensions during upgrade.
hotfixes.summary: User-defined dimensions no longer risk being replaced by default dimensions during upgrade. Moreover, the dimension upgrade process has also been significantly optimized.

hotfixes.version: Expense Management 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When exporting delegated users from Business Central , the system did not consistently prioritize Microsoft 365 email addresses.
hotfixes.summary: When exporting delegated users from Business Central , the system did not consistently prioritize Microsoft 365 email addresses. Microsoft 365 email addresses are now correctly prioritized and sent to Continia Online during the export process.

hotfixes.version: Expense Management 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When working with Expense Report subdocuments, page actions would run incorrectly against a different record that was created in another session.
hotfixes.summary: When working with Expense Report subdocuments, page actions would run incorrectly against a different record that was created in another session. Now, page actions for subdocuments only run on saved lines, ensuring that attachments and related data are added to the correct record.

hotfixes.version: Expense Management 2026 R1, Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: The half-day meal allowance was previously granted for Per Diems with an absence of exactly 8 hours.
hotfixes.summary: The half-day meal allowance was previously granted for Per Diems with an absence of exactly 8 hours. The calculations have been adjusted so the minimum absence threshold must be exceeded before an allowance is granted.

hotfixes.version: Expense Management 2026 R1, Service Pack 1, hotfix 2
hotfixes.title: Previously, whenever a new expense had no OCR receipt data, the VAT Prod.
hotfixes.summary: Previously, whenever a new expense had no OCR receipt data, the VAT Prod. Posting Group was not inherited from the Expense Type . The configured posting group from Posting Setup is now correctly applied to both expenses and expense allocations.

hotfixes.version: Expense Management 2026 R1, Service Pack 1, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Error handling has been improved during dimension upgrades on expense documents and bank transactions.
hotfixes.summary: Error handling has been improved during dimension upgrades on expense documents and bank transactions.

hotfixes.title: The Export Users , Send Welcome Email , and Continia Hub actions were unintentionally removed from the Home tab on the Continia User Setup page.
hotfixes.summary: The Export Users , Send Welcome Email , and Continia Hub actions were unintentionally removed from the Home tab on the Continia User Setup page. These actions have now been restored.

hotfixes.title: File size is now limited to 150 MB when adding attachments to expenses and mileages in Business Central .
hotfixes.summary: File size is now limited to 150 MB when adding attachments to expenses and mileages in Business Central .

hotfixes.title: It was possible to add values to Field Types in the type option, even when the field type was a system field.
hotfixes.summary: It was possible to add values to Field Types in the type option, even when the field type was a system field. This is no longer possible.

hotfixes.title: When a Per Diem with project information on the header had destinations with mixed project assignments, the posted amount to the project ledger was in
hotfixes.summary: When a Per Diem with project information on the header had destinations with mixed project assignments, the posted amount to the project ledger was incorrect and could be doubled. The project ledger now reflects the correct amounts per destination.

hotfixes.title: When posting a Per Diem with project details, the description on project ledger entries did not use the configured value.
hotfixes.summary: When posting a Per Diem with project details, the description on project ledger entries did not use the configured value. Project ledger entries now use the Per Diem Posting Description from Expense Management Setup , aligning with the description used for G/L entries.

hotfixes.title: When allocation lines were created, they did not inherit the Country Code from the expense header, which could result in missing or incorrect VAT mapp
hotfixes.summary: When allocation lines were created, they did not inherit the Country Code from the expense header, which could result in missing or incorrect VAT mapping. Allocation lines now inherit the header Country Code when they are created. Furthermore, changes to the header Country Code are propagated to existing allocation lines that are blank or still contain the previous value.

hotfixes.title: During upgrade, errors could occur in the conversion of Expense Management dimensions.
hotfixes.summary: During upgrade, errors could occur in the conversion of Expense Management dimensions.

hotfixes.title: When posting a purchase invoice created from an expense, where the business vendor ( Vendor No.
hotfixes.summary: When posting a purchase invoice created from an expense, where the business vendor ( Vendor No. ) was also linked to a Continia User Setup record, the payment posting could fail due to a record version conflict. This left the expense in an Awaiting status and created an open purchase invoice ledger entry.

hotfixes.title: When a Return Trip field type was configured as non-editable on an expense, and the expense was updated from Business Central running in a non-English
hotfixes.summary: When a Return Trip field type was configured as non-editable on an expense, and the expense was updated from Business Central running in a non-English language, the expense could get stuck in the expense inbox during synchronization due to the following error: _The Field Name RETURN TRIP is a system field and cannot be imported as an extra field.

hotfixes.title: When importing bank transactions where the transaction amount was 0, but the bank currency amount was non-zero, expenses were created with a 0 amount
hotfixes.summary: When importing bank transactions where the transaction amount was 0, but the bank currency amount was non-zero, expenses were created with a 0 amount when a currency was specified. This occurred because the currency code had not yet been mapped to LCY, preventing fallback amount population. The amount is now correctly populated from the bank currency amount when the currency code maps to LCY via the Bank Currency Map .

hotfixes.title: Allocation line dimensions entered in the app or portal were overwritten during synchronization with Business Central .
hotfixes.summary: Allocation line dimensions entered in the app or portal were overwritten during synchronization with Business Central . Due to an issue in the inbox transfer process, allocation dimensions were not fetched correctly, and header dimensions were applied instead. Allocation lines now retain user-defined dimensions after synchronization.

hotfixes.title: When running the Tax Report – Expense Management with taxable mileage enabled, the total was incorrect because the taxable amount was included twice i
hotfixes.summary: When running the Tax Report – Expense Management with taxable mileage enabled, the total was incorrect because the taxable amount was included twice in the calculation. The mileage total now correctly reflects the actual reimbursement amount.

hotfixes.title: When Enable Taxable Per Diem was enabled in Expense Management Setup , unchecking a meal on the last day of a Per Diem with sub-rate calculation deduc
hotfixes.summary: When Enable Taxable Per Diem was enabled in Expense Management Setup , unchecking a meal on the last day of a Per Diem with sub-rate calculation deducted double the expected amount. Meal deductions on sub-rate days are now calculated correctly.

hotfixes.title: The Per Diem Overview factbox displayed an incorrect daily meal allowance amount when using the Last Day Only sub-rate method, showing a lower total t
hotfixes.summary: The Per Diem Overview factbox displayed an incorrect daily meal allowance amount when using the Last Day Only sub-rate method, showing a lower total than indicated. The total now correctly includes the last day’s daily meal allowance.

hotfixes.title: When running the Tax Report – Expense Management or Status Report – Expense Management with taxable Per Diem enabled, the total was incorrect because
hotfixes.summary: When running the Tax Report – Expense Management or Status Report – Expense Management with taxable Per Diem enabled, the total was incorrect because the taxable amount was included twice in the calculation. The Per Diem total now correctly reflects the actual reimbursement amount.

hotfixes.title: When using the Danish language in the Business Central client and filtering approval entries by Document Type on the Approval Entries - Expense Manage
hotfixes.summary: When using the Danish language in the Business Central client and filtering approval entries by Document Type on the Approval Entries - Expense Management page, the following error occurred when attempting to approve documents: Titlen Bilagstype er tvetydig mellem flere felter i tabellen Godkendelsespostering - Expense Management

hotfixes.title: When forwarding or delegating Expense Management documents for approval, the expected approval comments (for example, Forwarded without approval: user
hotfixes.summary: When forwarding or delegating Expense Management documents for approval, the expected approval comments (for example, Forwarded without approval: userX > userY ) were not created. The delegation history now appears correctly in the approval comments.

hotfixes.title: When expense payment entries were created for applied vendor documents, the applied document entry incorrectly used expense dimensions instead of the
hotfixes.summary: When expense payment entries were created for applied vendor documents, the applied document entry incorrectly used expense dimensions instead of the document’s own dimensions. This sometimes lead to posting errors due to missing mandatory dimensions. The applied document entry now uses the dimensions from the applied document.

hotfixes.title: The Employee Reimbursed field in Expense Report is now automatically cleared when any sub-document payment is unapplied.
hotfixes.summary: The Employee Reimbursed field in Expense Report is now automatically cleared when any sub-document payment is unapplied.

hotfixes.title: In the Canada (CA) localization , when a Tax Group Code was configured on an Expense , submitting or re-submitting the expense with Allocations caused
hotfixes.summary: In the Canada (CA) localization , when a Tax Group Code was configured on an Expense , submitting or re-submitting the expense with Allocations caused Business Central to update the allocations in Continia Online with blank Tax Group Code values. This issue has now been fixed. The correct Tax Group Code is preserved during submission and synchronization.

hotfixes.title: Expenses sent to Document Capture that were rejected did not create ledger entries when posted, which could result in missing accounting entries.
hotfixes.summary: Expenses sent to Document Capture that were rejected did not create ledger entries when posted, which could result in missing accounting entries. The system now tracks rejected documents, prevents posting without ledger entries, and warns users when reopening previously rejected documents to help avoid duplicate postings. When a payment cannot be posted to the applied document, a more specific error message is now shown, clarifying whether the open vendor ledger entry does not exist; the applied

hotfixes.title: When transferring expenses or mileages with attachments between companies using the Move To Company functionality, the attachments are now correctly t
hotfixes.summary: When transferring expenses or mileages with attachments between companies using the Move To Company functionality, the attachments are now correctly transferred and remain accessible in the destination company. Previously, when both companies were configured with Azure Blob Storage, the attachments became inaccessible after the transfer.

hotfixes.title: When opening the User Setup by Company page, the Vendor No.
hotfixes.summary: When opening the User Setup by Company page, the Vendor No. field now correctly loads the value from the Continia User Setup table.

hotfixes.title: When selecting values on the Mileage Reimbursement and Per Diem Reimbursement pages, the opened page did not apply the filters from the selected colum
hotfixes.summary: When selecting values on the Mileage Reimbursement and Per Diem Reimbursement pages, the opened page did not apply the filters from the selected columns. Drilldowns now display only the entries that match the selected column.

hotfixes.title: When Enable Multiple Accommodation Types was disabled, it was possible to create multiple Per Diem Posting Setup entries for the same country within a
hotfixes.summary: When Enable Multiple Accommodation Types was disabled, it was possible to create multiple Per Diem Posting Setup entries for the same country within a Per Diem Group . This is no longer possible.

hotfixes.title: The Settlement Line No.
hotfixes.summary: The Settlement Line No. was sometimes incorrect for Per Diems attached to Expense Reports.

hotfixes.title: When multiple accommodation types were enabled in setup and selected on a Per Diem , all detail lines were posted to the same account.
hotfixes.summary: When multiple accommodation types were enabled in setup and selected on a Per Diem , all detail lines were posted to the same account. Detail lines are now posted to different posting accounts based on the selected accommodation type.

hotfixes.title: When posting a Per Diem in a foreign currency using the legacy posting path ( Posting Grouping Method set to blank in Expense Management Setup ), the
hotfixes.summary: When posting a Per Diem in a foreign currency using the legacy posting path ( Posting Grouping Method set to blank in Expense Management Setup ), the vendor ledger entry was not posted in the Per Diem currency but in the local currency.

hotfixes.title: In the Danish (DA) localization , per diem hourly ratio calculations have been corrected to apply rounding rules to the total trip hours rather than i
hotfixes.summary: In the Danish (DA) localization , per diem hourly ratio calculations have been corrected to apply rounding rules to the total trip hours rather than individual time segments, ensuring compliance with Danish tax regulations.

hotfixes.summary: When an Expense Report was created in the Expense App and synchronized in Business Central before it was saved or submitted in the Expense App , the following error occurred and the changes were lost: You are updating a document that has a newer version in Continia Online. Synchronize all documents before updating. Note that changes you last did will be lost.

hotfixes.summary: We have identified an isuse that could lead to a duplicated ledger entry for an expense in the case where, in the same split of a second, 2 users would have posted it. The default setup file is therefore no longer containing dimension fields. This solves an issue where default dimensions were added by the setup file, but the dimension codes wouldn't actually match the dimensions in the system. hotfixes.summary: On G/L accounts with Build Open Entries enabled, some entries were not marked as open, and no detailed entries were created when posted by users missing required permission sets. hotfixes.summary: G/L account name translations were saved incorrectly for account numbers longer than 10 characters, causing translated names to be lost or applied to the wrong account. This has now been fixed, and existing translations are automatically migrated when updating to this version.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 10, hotfix 1

hotfixes.summary: In some scenarios, documents other than invoices and credit memos are requested to be added to a new factoring proposal. The possibility to filter on specific document types was removed in a previous release. This change has been reverted and now makes it possible to filter on different document types again.

hotfixes.title: The Customer - Open Entries report can now group and subtotal customers by their Continia Finance Association, with correct totals and grouping even w
hotfixes.summary: The Customer - Open Entries report can now group and subtotal customers by their Continia Finance Association, with correct totals and grouping even when an association has no active license, is deleted, or has no open entries. The Group Association Customers option is now shown on the report screen print.

hotfixes.title: When a payment was applied and split between linked customer and vendor accounts, the linked vendor/customer field and the Apply Linked Vendor/Custome
hotfixes.summary: When a payment was applied and split between linked customer and vendor accounts, the linked vendor/customer field and the Apply Linked Vendor/Customer action disappeared from the Apply Customer Entries and Apply Vendor Entries pages. This has been fixed.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 9, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When you pasted 700 or more document numbers in Search and Apply with Excel for a customer with many open entry candidates, the transaction could brea
hotfixes.summary: When you pasted 700 or more document numbers in Search and Apply with Excel for a customer with many open entry candidates, the transaction could break and return a blank page when you clicked Close , so nothing was applied. This has now been fixed.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 9, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Resolved a Just-In-Time (JIT) field load error that could occur when posting customer, vendor, bank account, or G/L account entries, triggered by the
hotfixes.summary: Resolved a Just-In-Time (JIT) field load error that could occur when posting customer, vendor, bank account, or G/L account entries, triggered by the Last Posting at update logic. The update now uses a separate, fully loaded record instance to read and write the field, avoiding conflicts with the partially loaded record used for filtering.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 9, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: When importing Gen.
hotfixes.summary: When importing Gen. Jnl. Lines via a CSV port using Overwrite lines and changing the journal batch name, all Gen. Jnl. Lines were deleted. The overwrite logic now only affects the targeted journal batch, so other journal batches are not touched.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 9, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Fixed a caching bug in LicenseInformation.GetLicenseInfo() where a failed or slow license check never set LicenseRead , causing the full Continia Core
hotfixes.summary: Fixed a caching bug in LicenseInformation.GetLicenseInfo() where a failed or slow license check never set LicenseRead , causing the full Continia Core license/permission chain to re-run on every call (not just once per session).

hotfixes.title: Extended search now shows the applied amount, payment discount amount, and balance amount instead of only the amount.
hotfixes.summary: Extended search now shows the applied amount, payment discount amount, and balance amount instead of only the amount. This has been corrected in Apply Customer Entries , Apply Vendor Entries , and CTS-CFI Apply G/L Entries .

hotfixes.title: When trying to create an association per number series without using AssistEdit on the No.
hotfixes.summary: When trying to create an association per number series without using AssistEdit on the No. field, an error occurred. This has been fixed.

hotfixes.title: When applying a customer payment to both the customer and the linked vendor, the applied linked vendor posting was forgotten when you clicked OK or pr
hotfixes.summary: When applying a customer payment to both the customer and the linked vendor, the applied linked vendor posting was forgotten when you clicked OK or pressed ESC, and the applied mark remained but the amount was not retained. Customer/vendor settling now works independently of extended payment discounts.

hotfixes.title: When exporting from the CSV port card, configured decimal and thousand separators were ignored, and the output always followed the selected region for
hotfixes.summary: When exporting from the CSV port card, configured decimal and thousand separators were ignored, and the output always followed the selected region format. This has now been fixed, and the export uses the configured separator settings.

hotfixes.title: When opening the General Journal page with Continia Finance disabled, the CTS-CFI General Journal page extension caused errors.
hotfixes.summary: When opening the General Journal page with Continia Finance disabled, the CTS-CFI General Journal page extension caused errors. This has been fixed.

hotfixes.title: When opening, editing, or exporting financial reports to Excel using Account Schedule lines with the Separate Receivables and Payables feature, perfor
hotfixes.summary: When opening, editing, or exporting financial reports to Excel using Account Schedule lines with the Separate Receivables and Payables feature, performance was extremely slow (up to 30+ seconds per cell) and repeated on every refresh. Performance is now improved for these reports, including refreshes in Account Schedule Overview .

hotfixes.title: When running a financial report, G/L account groups with Balance position set to Asset Group or Liabilities Group returned different totals than posti
hotfixes.summary: When running a financial report, G/L account groups with Balance position set to Asset Group or Liabilities Group returned different totals than posting accounts with Balance Position set to Assets Group , causing grouped lines like Bank 1 + 2 to show inconsistent amounts. The report calculation now treats these balance position groupings consistently so the same accounts produce the same totals.

hotfixes.title: When inserting a new fixed asset, the number was not automatically assigned even if Ext.
hotfixes.summary: When inserting a new fixed asset, the number was not automatically assigned even if Ext. Fixed Asset Template Nos. was set up in Extended Fixed Asset Setup , and you had to select No. Series manually. Number series are now considered when inserting a new fixed asset, so the number is assigned automatically.

hotfixes.title: When directly importing into the general journal, existing records were overwritten only if Existing records was set to Replace , even when overwrite
hotfixes.summary: When directly importing into the general journal, existing records were overwritten only if Existing records was set to Replace , even when overwrite was enabled. Overwrite is now handled separately from Existing records .

hotfixes.title: When you opened installments from posted sales and purchase invoices, the correct link to the ledger entry number was not used, and installment lines
hotfixes.summary: When you opened installments from posted sales and purchase invoices, the correct link to the ledger entry number was not used, and installment lines were missing Collection data fields such as payment method. This has now been fixed, and installments opened from posted invoices use the correct ledger entry link and populate the collection information.

hotfixes.title: When an underpayment was posted with Continia Finance activated, the remaining amount was incorrectly shown on the payment entry instead of the invoic
hotfixes.summary: When an underpayment was posted with Continia Finance activated, the remaining amount was incorrectly shown on the payment entry instead of the invoice entry as in standard Business Central. The remaining amount is now written to the invoice entry to match standard behavior.

hotfixes.title: The Document Receipt Date column has been added to the IC General Journal page.
hotfixes.summary: The Document Receipt Date column has been added to the IC General Journal page. You can now change the Document Receipt Date when Purch. VAT Next Month is enabled.

hotfixes.title: When enabling the option in Extended Financial Report Setup for vendor ledger entries, the External Document No.
hotfixes.summary: When enabling the option in Extended Financial Report Setup for vendor ledger entries, the External Document No. field in vendor ledger entries could not be edited. Editing External Document No. now works correctly when the vendor ledger entry option is selected.

hotfixes.title: When opening a financial report that used dynamic column headlines, the headlines showed placeholders and did not update when the period changed unles
hotfixes.summary: When opening a financial report that used dynamic column headlines, the headlines showed placeholders and did not update when the period changed unless the column definition was reselected. Dynamic headlines now render correctly on first open and update automatically when the period changes.

hotfixes.title: When exporting report 71565805 to Excel, the Balance Account Type column was missing, causing the remaining column headlines to be misaligned.
hotfixes.summary: When exporting report 71565805 to Excel, the Balance Account Type column was missing, causing the remaining column headlines to be misaligned. The Excel export now includes the Balance Account Type column so all headlines appear correctly.

hotfixes.title: The Number of selected Lines value for exporting proposals was incorrect for lines split by VAT, because it showed the sum of all lines instead of onl
hotfixes.summary: The Number of selected Lines value for exporting proposals was incorrect for lines split by VAT, because it showed the sum of all lines instead of only the VAT-split lines. The flow field now applies the correct filter so it calculates only the relevant VAT-split lines based on the selected option.

hotfixes.title: When G/L Open Entries was enabled in multiple companies, migration did not set the Open flag on G/L entries in companies other than the one where migr
hotfixes.summary: When G/L Open Entries was enabled in multiple companies, migration did not set the Open flag on G/L entries in companies other than the one where migration was executed, leaving entries neither open nor closed. Migration now correctly sets the Open boolean for G/L entries across all companies with G/L Open Entries enabled.

hotfixes.title: When exporting Customer - Open Entries to Excel, several report options (including Print Totals per Posting Group , Incl.
hotfixes.summary: When exporting Customer - Open Entries to Excel, several report options (including Print Totals per Posting Group , Incl. Comments , Group Association Customers , and Show Application ) were missing or not applied. The Excel export now includes and applies these options correctly.

hotfixes.title: The CTS-CFI Basic permission set incorrectly included the G/L Account , G/L Item , Customer , and Vendor tables, which bypassed standard security filt
hotfixes.summary: The CTS-CFI Basic permission set incorrectly included the G/L Account , G/L Item , Customer , and Vendor tables, which bypassed standard security filters. These table permissions are now removed from CTS-CFI Basic , and required access is provided through other CFI permission sets.

hotfixes.title: When posting a sales or purchase invoice with installments and no payment discount, posting failed with an error.
hotfixes.summary: When posting a sales or purchase invoice with installments and no payment discount, posting failed with an error. Posting now correctly leaves Pmt. Discount Date blank for installment invoices without a discount, so the invoice posts successfully.

hotfixes.title: When Check Source Curr.
hotfixes.summary: When Check Source Curr. Consistency was enabled in General Ledger Setup , creating installment payments could fail with an error. The consistency handling is now corrected so installment payments complete successfully with this setting enabled.

hotfixes.title: When applying discounts on open entries from an association, Pmt.
hotfixes.summary: When applying discounts on open entries from an association, Pmt. Discount to Apply was not recognized even when it was set (including when Ignore Pmt. Discount Date was enabled). Discounts on association open entries are now handled correctly.

hotfixes.title: When you used extended application with a tolerance in Cash Receipts Journal or General Journals , the Currency Code was incorrectly deleted for under
hotfixes.summary: When you used extended application with a tolerance in Cash Receipts Journal or General Journals , the Currency Code was incorrectly deleted for underpayments and overpayments. This has now been fixed, and the Currency Code is retained.

hotfixes.title: In CSV ports, amount formatting settings on the port were overwritten by the regional settings in Business Central, which could cause incorrect decima
hotfixes.summary: In CSV ports, amount formatting settings on the port were overwritten by the regional settings in Business Central, which could cause incorrect decimal values when importing German CSV files under an English (United Kingdom) region code. This has now been fixed, so the port’s amount formatting settings are used instead of the regional settings.

hotfixes.title: Under certain circumstances, the extended application falsely created additional lines.
hotfixes.summary: Under certain circumstances, the extended application falsely created additional lines. This issue has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: The Fixed Asset under construction field on the Fixed Asset page was not considered in fixed asset report calculations.
hotfixes.summary: The Fixed Asset under construction field on the Fixed Asset page was not considered in fixed asset report calculations. It is now correctly included in the calculation of fixed asset reports.

hotfixes.title: The Document Receipt Date was added to the Fixed Asset G/L Journal .
hotfixes.summary: The Document Receipt Date was added to the Fixed Asset G/L Journal . It is editable, and you can display it by personalizing the page.

hotfixes.title: The reclassification of fixed assets through partial disposals was incorrect on the Extended Fixed Assets Reports page.
hotfixes.summary: The reclassification of fixed assets through partial disposals was incorrect on the Extended Fixed Assets Reports page. This issue has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: It was possible to delete a factor with existing factoring proposals and active exported factoring proposals.
hotfixes.summary: It was possible to delete a factor with existing factoring proposals and active exported factoring proposals. This has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: A missing permission for the newly introduced Factoring VAT Key Mapping table has been added to the Continia Finance permission sets.
hotfixes.summary: A missing permission for the newly introduced Factoring VAT Key Mapping table has been added to the Continia Finance permission sets.

hotfixes.title: When reversing transactions with the same Document No.
hotfixes.summary: When reversing transactions with the same Document No. in a G/L register while using the G/L Open Entries module, the following error occurred: Positive must be equal to 'No' in G/L Entry: Entry No.=3357. Current value is 'Yes'. This has now been fixed.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: Using the Applies-to Doc.
hotfixes.summary: Using the Applies-to Doc. No. field in general journals while having the Extended application activated led to a signifcant performance loss, especially when customers had a large number of open entries. This issue has now been solved.

hotfixes.version: Continia Finance 2025 R1 Service Pack 2, hotfix 1
hotfixes.title: In some situations, license checks in on-premises installations of Continia Finance weren't correct, causing faulty behavior and errors in the executi
hotfixes.summary: In some situations, license checks in on-premises installations of Continia Finance weren't correct, causing faulty behavior and errors in the execution of Business Central standard or third-party code. This has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: Fixed an issue where the Document Date was incorrectly assigned on sales and purchase documents when multilevel payment discounts were configured.
hotfixes.summary: Fixed an issue where the Document Date was incorrectly assigned on sales and purchase documents when multilevel payment discounts were configured. The Document Date now reflects the correct value in scenarios involving multiple payment discount levels.

hotfixes.title: The Open Entries and Due Open Entries tiles on the Role Center displayed incorrect values due to calculation errors.
hotfixes.summary: The Open Entries and Due Open Entries tiles on the Role Center displayed incorrect values due to calculation errors. The underlying calculation logic has been corrected, and the tiles now show accurate entry counts.

hotfixes.title: When using Duplicate in Depreciation Book in general journals together with Use Duplication List and Post Copies Automatically in the Extended Fixed A
hotfixes.summary: When using Duplicate in Depreciation Book in general journals together with Use Duplication List and Post Copies Automatically in the Extended Fixed Asset Setup , the posting preview showed an error. The issue occurred during the preview process, preventing users from validating postings before completion. The posting preview now works correctly in this scenario.

hotfixes.title: When using an additional reporting currency for installments that differed from the invoice currency, inconsistency errors occurred during processing.
hotfixes.summary: When using an additional reporting currency for installments that differed from the invoice currency, inconsistency errors occurred during processing. The issue has been resolved, and installments now handle reporting currencies correctly regardless of the invoice currency.

hotfixes.title: Allocations on fixed assets did not function correctly for all posting options, resulting in incorrect allocation behavior during posting.
hotfixes.summary: Allocations on fixed assets did not function correctly for all posting options, resulting in incorrect allocation behavior during posting. The issue has been resolved, and allocations now work as expected across all posting options.

hotfixes.title: When using Account Groups in Continia Financial reports with the Detailed Export option enabled, the Excel export did not include the expected detaile
hotfixes.summary: When using Account Groups in Continia Financial reports with the Detailed Export option enabled, the Excel export did not include the expected detailed data. The export now correctly contains all details as specified by the Detailed Export setting.

hotfixes.title: The reports Extended Financial Report , Ext.
hotfixes.summary: The reports Extended Financial Report , Ext. Financial Report 11 Columns , and Ext. Financial Report 15 Columns displayed incorrect data or a filter error when a date filter was applied, due to an incorrect assignment of the date filter. The date filter is now assigned correctly, ensuring accurate filtering and report results.

hotfixes.title: Date formats in CSV imports and exports were previously misinterpreted when the date string began with the year.
hotfixes.summary: Date formats in CSV imports and exports were previously misinterpreted when the date string began with the year. This caused incorrect date values to be processed in all such cases. Date parsing now correctly recognizes and handles year-first date formats in CSV ports.

hotfixes.title: The reports Extended Financial Report , Ext.
hotfixes.summary: The reports Extended Financial Report , Ext. Financial Report 11 Columns , and Ext. Financial Report 15 Columns displayed incorrect data when certain settings were used, including Show system accounts , Show opposite sign , and various totaling types. These issues affected the accuracy of report output depending on the selected options. All related settings now function correctly, and the reports display accurate data as expected.

hotfixes.title: Changes have been made to support installing Continia Finance in the Italian localization.
hotfixes.summary: Changes have been made to support installing Continia Finance in the Italian localization. It is now possible to complete the installation process without localization-related issues when using the Italian version of Business Central.

hotfixes.title: The permission set CFI-ALL has been replaced by CTS-CFI Basic when setting up users.
hotfixes.summary: The permission set CFI-ALL has been replaced by CTS-CFI Basic when setting up users. CFI-ALL is now obsolete and should no longer be assigned. Existing user setups should be updated to use CTS-CFI Basic to ensure continued access and compatibility.

hotfixes.title: When Continia Finance was installed in a BE environment, attempting to use the EB Payment Journals page resulted in the following error: The vendor do
hotfixes.summary: When Continia Finance was installed in a BE environment, attempting to use the EB Payment Journals page resulted in the following error: The vendor does not exist This issue has been resolved. You can now use EB Payment Journals in BE environments with Continia Finance installed without encountering this error.

hotfixes.title: The CTS-CFI FA BOOK VALUE dataset in the Fixed Asset report has been aligned with the OPP FA BOOK VALUE dataset from the OPplus report.
hotfixes.summary: The CTS-CFI FA BOOK VALUE dataset in the Fixed Asset report has been aligned with the OPP FA BOOK VALUE dataset from the OPplus report. This ensures consistency in data output between the two reports, allowing users to compare and reconcile fixed asset values accurately across both reporting tools.

hotfixes.title: An issue has been resolved on the customer/vendor application page where additional and misleading lines appeared when multiple lines shared the same
hotfixes.summary: An issue has been resolved on the customer/vendor application page where additional and misleading lines appeared when multiple lines shared the same document number. This issue has been addressed to ensure accurate line display. Additionally, a problem was fixed where extra empty lines appeared when the application selection was initiated without selecting any lines to apply. This ensures that only relevant lines are displayed during the application process.

hotfixes.title: When account groups were used in financial reports, the account schedule calculation did not adhere to the Show Opposite Sign setting in the row defin
hotfixes.summary: When account groups were used in financial reports, the account schedule calculation did not adhere to the Show Opposite Sign setting in the row definition. This issue has been resolved, ensuring that the account schedule calculation now correctly reflects the Show Opposite Sign configuration when account groups are utilized.

hotfixes.title: On the Open G/L Accounts page, it wasn't possible to manually edit or enter amounts in the Amount to Apply column.
hotfixes.summary: On the Open G/L Accounts page, it wasn't possible to manually edit or enter amounts in the Amount to Apply column. The visibility and editability of this column has now been fixed.

hotfixes.title: Additional data is now accessible in the FactBox, providing users with enhanced financial insights.
hotfixes.summary: Additional data is now accessible in the FactBox, providing users with enhanced financial insights. To activate this feature, navigate to Extended Financial Reports Setup > Ledger Entry Views and enable the Show Extended Data Factbox option. This enhancement allows users to view more comprehensive data directly within the FactBox, improving the analysis and decision-making process.

hotfixes.title: Whenever the Customer Open Entries report was printed, every second page appeared blank.
hotfixes.summary: Whenever the Customer Open Entries report was printed, every second page appeared blank. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that all pages of the report display the correct information without any blank pages.

hotfixes.title: The Open G/L Accounts page's Apply Partial Payment function previously did not operate correctly.
hotfixes.summary: The Open G/L Accounts page's Apply Partial Payment function previously did not operate correctly. This issue has been resolved. Now, when you use the Apply Partial Payment function, the system accurately calculates and sets the balancing amount in the Amount to Apply column, ensuring correct partial payment application.

hotfixes.title: The issue where installment plan lines could not be deleted in the General Journals , Sales Journals , and Purchase Journals pages has been resolved.
hotfixes.summary: The issue where installment plan lines could not be deleted in the General Journals , Sales Journals , and Purchase Journals pages has been resolved. This problem occurred when the Enable Data Check option was activated in the General Ledger Setup .

hotfixes.title: In the on-premises version, new functionality in the Installments module incorrectly triggered a license check.
hotfixes.summary: In the on-premises version, new functionality in the Installments module incorrectly triggered a license check. This issue caused customers who did not have the Installments module to encounter a license error. This has now been resolved, ensuring that the license check is not performed for customers without the Installments module.

hotfixes.title: Updated NPM packages
hotfixes.summary: To maintain security and reliability, we updated several NPM packages to their latest supported versions, including a package for which a security vulnerability was identified. These updates help ensure the platform remains secure and up to date.

hotfixes.title: Improved Feedback for Unconfigured CE Users
hotfixes.summary: Users accessing Raptor from CE who have not yet been configured in the platform now receive a clearer notification explaining the issue. The message has been aligned with the experience already available for FO users, helping both users and administrators more quickly understand and resolve access-related problems.

hotfixes.title: Timeout Resilience Improvements
hotfixes.summary: Following a series of timeout-related incidents in our production environment, we implemented both infrastructure and application-level improvements to increase platform resilience. The issue could, under specific circumstances, cause processing for an individual tenant to become stalled. To address this, we increased database capacity and enhanced the application's error-handling and recovery mechanisms. As a result, processes can now automatically recover from temporary database resource conte

hotfixes.title: MCP Server Activation Fix
hotfixes.summary: Resolved an issue where the MCP Server feature flag was not always applied correctly. In some cases, users received a message indicating that the MCP Server was disabled, even though it was enabled for their tenant. The feature flag is now consistently evaluated, ensuring MCP Server availability is correctly reflected to users.

hotfixes.title: Viewer Reliability Improvements
hotfixes.summary: The document viewer has been enhanced to provide a more reliable user experience when rendering issues occur. When possible, additional diagnostic information is now displayed to help identify the cause of rendering failures, such as corrupted PDF files. In addition, automatic retry mechanisms have been introduced to recover from temporary communication or connectivity issues, reducing the likelihood of interrupted document viewing sessions.

hotfixes.title: Multiple Go Back clicks required
hotfixes.summary: We improved browser navigation when viewing emails in the Document Warehouse Viewer embedded in D365 Finance & Operations. Returning to the previous page using the browser's Back button now requires only a single click, resulting in a smoother and more intuitive navigation experience.

hotfixes.title: Prevent invalid queries
hotfixes.summary: We improved validation within the Advanced Search interface. Search criteria must now be fully configured before a search can be executed. For example, when filtering on a numeric field using conditions such as _"is less than"_, a value must be provided before the search can be started. The Search button now remains disabled until all configured filters contain valid values, helping prevent incomplete or invalid search requests.

hotfixes.title: Improved Stability When Switching Between Records
hotfixes.summary: We have improved the handling of rapid record navigation to ensure documents are always displayed correctly. Previously, quickly switching between records could in rare cases result in mismatched document content being shown. With this enhancement, document loading is now more robust and consistently aligned with the selected record, providing a more reliable and accurate user experience.

hotfixes.title: URL Handling and Tenant Context Improvement
hotfixes.summary: URLs can now include a `tenant-id` parameter. This parameter is intended for use in scenarios where an authentication token is not present, such as links included in emails. By explicitly providing the tenant context, this enhancement prevents incorrect context resolution and ensures that data is not mistakenly accessed or processed across different tenants. Full details on using this parameter are available in our documentation under Developers > Embedding Raptor .

hotfixes.title: Performance and Stability Improvements
hotfixes.summary: Following our previous release, a subset of customers experienced errors caused by database throughput limits being reached. This issue was traced back to a performance enhancement that increased the speed of synchronization jobs, which in turn raised the load on our database beyond expected levels. To address this, we have introduced additional control mechanisms that allow us to better regulate and throttle the workload generated by background services. These improvements ensure a more balance

hotfixes.title: Count of selected documents could be off in the main document view
hotfixes.summary: The count indicator on the main document list was not always rerendered when the selection changed. This should now be fixed.

hotfixes.title: Result count off for large data sets
hotfixes.summary: For larger datasets the count of matching documents would be incorrect because the system did a fetch using the filter and ignoring continuation tokens. We changed this to an actual count directly on the database as this was the intended behaviour in the first place.

hotfixes.title: Fixed regression - raptor plugin with context and explicit tags
hotfixes.summary: When you integrate raptor you can pass in a context object, and some explicit tags. This context is mapped to a tag, and we used to filter on all tags, but in a previous release this behaviour changed, and only the context tag itself was used as filter. Now we are again adding the explicit tags as well.

hotfixes.title: Fix links to documentation
hotfixes.summary: Some info buttons on the configuration page linked to a page that was moved to a different location, the url's have been updated.

hotfixes.title: Extended monitoring of document viewer
hotfixes.summary: The monitoring of the client-side document viewer was extended to allow easier debugging of some connection related issues reported by clients.

hotfixes.title: Date field displaying wrong value
hotfixes.summary: When a date field was added on a document through the API in the wrong format (e.g. dd/MM/yyyy), the date picker would assumeit to be MM/dd/yyyy in some cases. A best-effort check was made to parse these values to the correct format. Note that the API always expects date fields in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

hotfixes.title: .MSG emails not working in modern Outlook
hotfixes.summary: When clicking the 'Mail' button in the Document Warehouse, an .MSG file would be downloaded with the selected documents attached. In recent versions of Outlook, an error occurs when trying to send these .MSG files. As a future-proof solution, we switched to the .EML format. Users might have to adjust their default application for opening .EML files.

hotfixes.title: Viewer update - not all lines rendered
hotfixes.summary: Some Word documents did not render all the lines in the tables. The viewer was updated to fix this problem.

hotfixes.title: Show thumbnail after upload new document
hotfixes.summary: When uploading a document the thumbnail in the document details section was not displayed immediatly. This should now be the case.

hotfixes.title: Move annotations on PDF
hotfixes.summary: Since our last release annotations on documents could no longer be moved. This is no again possible. (Note that changes are not saved.) This allows users to view text that may be hidden below an annotation.

hotfixes.title: Missing attachment in RTF emails
hotfixes.summary: Some emails with a body type of "RTF" (rich text format) had inline attachments that were not displayed in the attachments bar of our viewer. This should now be fixed.

hotfixes.title: Fix viewer in FireFox
hotfixes.summary: When loading documents in FireFox the viewer was stuck in a loading states for 10+ seconds. This should be resolved with this release.

hotfixes.title: Command C / Control C
hotfixes.summary: Viewer buttons command c or control c did not work inside a iframe.

hotfixes.title: Prevent adding roles to external systems
hotfixes.summary: Using the API it was possible to assign a template to an external system. This makes no sense, and does not do anything, except resulting in strange empty records in the UI. We added a check to only allow valid users to external systems, and return a Bad Request error in case the operation is called with incorrect parameters.

hotfixes.title: Clicking a timestamp field could crash the UI
hotfixes.summary: In certain situations clicking a timestamp field could result in a UI crash. Additional checks have been added to prevent this from happening.

hotfixes.title: Default tenant not working
hotfixes.summary: In rare cases users with multiple tenants assigned to them could not select a default tenant. This should now be fixed.

hotfixes.title: User filter failed for special characters
hotfixes.summary: When filtering users on the admin pages you could not specify a filter for names that contained special characters like é, this should now be fixed.

hotfixes.title: Swagger "about" url pointed to a 404 page
hotfixes.summary: In swagger we had an "about" url that pointed to a page that was removed, resulting in a 404 page.

hotfixes.title: Infrastructure update - Ingress Controller
hotfixes.summary: This update contains no functional changes.

hotfixes.title: strengthen viewer url's
hotfixes.summary: When users load a document in the cache this generated temporary private url's that should be considered private access tokens to those documents. But these URL's would be the same every time the user load the same document in the cache. This results in a potential attack vector. We now add a variable security segment to those url's that will change in time and will prevent the usage of older url's should those become in any way compromised. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N

hotfixes.title: Corrected date in created column
hotfixes.summary: When looking at the "date created" column in the document viewer you may have a different date then the one shown in the document detail section. This is because we did not convert UTC to local time when displaying the timestamp in the table column. When a document was uploaded near midnight this could result in a 1 day mismatch.

hotfixes.title: UBL Viewer not showing invoice lines
hotfixes.summary: Some invoices did not show invoice lines in our ubl viewer.

hotfixes.title: Users with lots of roles experienced broken UI
hotfixes.summary: The user interface would not load any documents for users with many roles assigned to them (200+).

hotfixes.title: Drag and drop attachments from Outlook to Raptor gives error
hotfixes.summary: New Outlook versions changed the drag-and-drop data structure, which caused upload errors. Raptor now supports the new structure.

hotfixes.title: Print with maximum quality
hotfixes.summary: Print quality was reduced in the previous release. Printing now uses the maximum quality setting.

hotfixes.title: Revert to old Document Viewer

Because we cannot yet resolve this final issue, we have reverted to the previous version until a proper solution is available.

hotfixes.title: Show large CAD files
hotfixes.summary: The CAD viewer now shows a "download" button for CAD files over 20MB. Before large files could not be viewed because we do not download large files automatically, and users did not have an option to start the download manually. Be aware that CAD files are rendered in the browser, and bigger files will take a while to load. Remark: the CAD viewer is still in preview and has to be enabled by 9altitudes on a tenant before it can be used.

hotfixes.title: E-platform - Allow to set a template to the original email.
hotfixes.summary: When invoices are retrieved from Tungsten, it is possible to put the original email in the raptor document warehouse. E-Platform now allows to configure a fixed template to be assigned to this email.

hotfixes.title: Remove deleted sharepoint sites
hotfixes.summary: When removing a SharePoint site that was deleted already in SharePoint an error occurred and the site remained visible in Raptor. This was because we tried and failed to delete the subscription to this site. We now catch and ignore this error, as it just means the site was already removed. And then proceed with also removing the record in Raptor.

hotfixes.title: Search component not showing tags
hotfixes.summary: When opening the web app directly in the administration page, and opening a security filter with multiple tags, it was possible that the tags were not displayed. Giving the impression that the filter was empty. The tags are now loaded and displayed correctly.

hotfixes.summary: SFTP Setup and non-certificate support

hotfixes.title: Telemetry newFromEventIdName method is obselete
hotfixes.summary: This method is removed

hotfixes.title: Re-processing failed DMF import (non excel) in the queue not working
hotfixes.summary: Re processing for DMF import after a fail is now possible. (This means you can edit the import file in the queue and reprocess it).

hotfixes.title: Manual Reprocessing when max amount of retry not possible
hotfixes.summary: The bug that blocked manually processing of messages that reached their max retries in the queue has been resolved.

hotfixes.title: Name of exported files when multiple data entities in one project is wrong
hotfixes.summary: A bug causing names and extensions for DMF export entities to be wrong when multiple entities are included in one export project has been resolved.

hotfixes.title: Process out event looping and queue
hotfixes.summary: A bug causing an infinite loop has been resolved.

hotfixes.title: Retry count issues
hotfixes.summary: A bug regarding retry counts has been solved.

hotfixes.title: Label changes
hotfixes.summary: Some spelling mistakes are resolved.

hotfixes.title: Message content changes can not be saved
hotfixes.summary: It is now possible to save changes made to message content in the queue.

hotfixes.title: File not moved to FailDirectory of SuccessDirectory when using SAS Credential
hotfixes.summary: The bug when import from a fileshare while using SaS is fixed.

hotfixes.title: API Connection failed on ER OUT processor
hotfixes.summary: The bug for ER OUT in combination with API connector is resolved.

hotfixes.title: Authorization types (API, Storage account, ...) Not cleared when changing connector type
hotfixes.summary: The connector is not taking unrelated columns into account to generate the displayed view.

hotfixes.title: Parent Path Error when directory doesn't exist (ER - OUT handler in combination with a Fileshare)
hotfixes.summary: This bug is resolved by creating the complete directory path on the fly (if it doesn't already exist).

hotfixes.title: failed XML (import or export) can sometimes not be reprocessed
hotfixes.summary: The issue that blocked the reprocessing has been resolved.

hotfixes.title: Label printing through processor not working from document routing
hotfixes.summary: Label printing through processor not working from document routing

hotfixes.title: issues with the processors which were using the "Use Queue" parameter
hotfixes.summary: The bug is fixed where in some cases the queue parameter was automatically set to No while Yes was needed.

hotfixes.title: 9A Smart Connect missing label for license report usage
hotfixes.summary: The bug where some labels were missing for license report usage is fixed

hotfixes.title: Empty error message when error is thrown in event processing
hotfixes.summary: The bug is fixed where empty error messages was thrown in the event processing.

hotfixes.title: Strange behaviour when DMF import
hotfixes.summary: The strange behaviour when performing the DMF import is fixed: Files are moved to the correct folder On failed, the state in the queue is changed to Error

hotfixes.title: When DMF import process message is in error in the queue, and the same processor is triggered, its runs infinitely
hotfixes.summary: This bug is fixed. Note: Using the queue in combination with DMF import/export of excel files is not possible.

hotfixes.title: Auto Create directories if not exist in DMF export
hotfixes.summary: When a directory is specified in the directory path of the processor that doesn't exist, it is now created on the fly.

hotfixes.title: When reprocess an failed DMF export message (non excel) The name of the export file is wrong
hotfixes.summary: The bug where the name of the export file on reprocessing a failed DMF export record in the queue was wrong is solved.

hotfixes.title: Filter on top of page is not working when a view is saved with another sort by column
hotfixes.summary: The bugs with the filter on top of the page are solved.

hotfixes.title: File share SAS credentials fail on instantiation
hotfixes.summary: The bug that SAS credentials fails on instantiation for a fileshare is solved.
